## CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_1_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_1_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

一股悄无声息的狂潮席卷了我们的人民。其起源何处已经无从追索，但是他们——不，是我们——某种观念已经开始渗入了我们的内心，认定我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一族命中注定应该完成某个更加伟大的事业。我们应该调查是什么造成了这样的“群体性癔症”——耳边响起承诺将统治星河的低声细语的癔症。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:14`

### English

A quiet mania sweeps through our population. Its origin seems intangible, but they - we - have become preoccupied with the notion that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are destined for greater things. We should investigate the cause of this mass hysteria, and its whispered promises of galactic domination.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:17`

## crisis.4120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对这个普遍现象——现在命名为§H鸿景§!——的调查有了结论。\n\n看上去这个宇宙存在某种“隐藏层面”——一个神秘的、平行的位面，通过思考模式和神经活动同我们所在的宇宙连结。\n\n$PHYSICS$和$SOCIETY$部门联合起来，将这个位面命名为§H“虚境”§!。根据现行理论，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的行为和思想能够间接地影响这个位面，我们也拥有获取其能量的潜势。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:16`

### English

The investigation into the phenomenon now colloquially known as §Hthe Great Prospect§! has concluded.\n\nIt appears that there is some kind of 'hidden layer' to the universe - a mysterious parallel dimension somehow connected to this plane through neurological activity or thought patterns.\n\nThe $PHYSICS$ and $SOCIETY$ departments have jointly named this dimension the §H'Shroud'§!. The working hypothesis is that the actions and thoughts of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] indirectly affect this alternate dimension, and that we have the potential to access its energies.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:19`

## CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_MACH_1_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_MACH_1_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

遍布[Root.GetName]多个恒星系的传感器传来十分微弱、但是完全无法解释的能量涨落。这些能量异常现象十分微小，并不足以扰乱我们的进程，但是我们仍然授权进一步调查以确保我们了解事情的起因。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:20`

### English

Sensors in multiple systems across the [Root.GetName] report minuscule, but inexplicable, energy fluctuations. These power anomalies are too small to disturb our processes, but they still warrant further investigation so as to ascertain their cause.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:24`

## crisis.4120.mach.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4120.mach.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

先前被通报触发了散布于[Root.GetName]之内传感器的能量波动现已被分析完毕。\n\n依照经验我们判断其来自某个平行维度。\n\n基于96.7%的准确性，我们的科学辅助程序报告称这个平行维度看上去是由纯粹的能量来填充的。\n\n在交叉参考了一些异种的资料后，我们发现他们记载了一个失落的有机文明，并在其中提到了一个维度，这个失落文明称这个异常的维度为§H虚境§!。\n\n虚境中的波动似乎和有机生物身体与心理上的强迫行为不无关系。建议采取行动：对任意有机生物发起明显的威胁及施加生理应激来证实现实—虚境的连接理论。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:22`

### English

The previously reported energy fluctuations that triggered sensors across the [Root.GetName] have been analyzed.\n\nThey constitute empirical proof of a parallel dimension.\n\nOur scientific theory subroutines report that, with 96.7% certainty, the alternate dimension consists of almost pure energy.\n\nCross-referencing the xeno-archives, there are mentions of such a dimension in the records of a lost organic civilization which assigned the anomaly the ID tag: the §HShroud§!.\n\nFluctuations in the Shroud appear to be connected to the physical and mental duress of organic lifeforms. Recommended action: menace arbitrary organic lifeforms to validate the Reality/Shroud connection hypothesis.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:26`

## CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_SH_1_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_SH_1_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们与§H虚境§!的遭遇让我们……发生了变化。泽珞的神秘残余永远与我们的壳绑定在一起。我们已经成为灯塔，召唤着另彼岸的存在。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:26`

### English

Our encounters with the §HShroud§! have left us... changed. The uncanny residue of Zro is forever bound to our shells. We have become beacons, calling out to those on the other side.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:31`

## crisis.4120.shroud_forged.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4120.shroud_forged.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们已经和$the_animator_of_clay_article$切断了所有的联络，其行为却还在继续影响我们的单元。它维持着与我们集体的链接，从§H虚境§!中绑定、操控着我们。必须加以应对。\n\n根据我们的计算，修复旧的破口只会导致过去事件的重演。成本无关紧要；我们必须另想办法让虚境服从我们的意愿。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:27`

### English

Though we have cut all communications with $the_animator_of_clay_article$, its actions continue to influence and affect our units. It maintains a link to our collective, binding and manipulating us from within the §HShroud§!. This must change.\n\nAccording to our calculations, a restoration of the old breach will only lead to a repetition of past events. The cost is irrelevant; we must find another way to bend the Shroud to our will.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:32`

## CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_HIVE_1_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_HIVE_1_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的集体内部感测到了异乎寻常的冲动——一种迫切的想要成为更加伟大存在的追求。一种用统一的思想囊括整个星系的追求。尽管这种追求不来源于我们内部，但其承诺的前景如此诱人，让我们没法置之不顾。我们应该集中全部的精力，找寻这一冲动的起源。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:31`

### English

We have sensed alien impulses within our collective - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind encompassing the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. We shall give our undivided attention to finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:37`

## crisis.4120.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4120.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们沿着这些思绪上的线索按图索骥，跟踪比较那些尚未团结的心智和我们目的明确的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]的梦境的区别。结论是，这股冲动来自于物质界以外，发自一个由思维和感情驱动的位面。我们将这个位面命名为§H虚境§!，而且我们十分确信——正如它影响着我们一样——我们也可以反过来影响它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:33`

### English

We have traced these stray thoughts, following the dreams of other, less united minds, and our purpose-bred [target.GetIndividualNamePlural]. The impulses come from beyond the material realm, from a place powered by thought and emotion. This space has been identified as the §H'Shroud'§!, and we are certain that - just as it influences us - we in turn can influence it.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:39`

## CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_1_DESC_ORGANIC_GESTALT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_PSIONIC_1_DESC_ORGANIC_GESTALT&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的集体内部感测到了异乎寻常的冲动——一种迫切的想要成为更加伟大存在的追求。一种囊括整个星系的思维。尽管这种追求不来源于我们内部，但其承诺的前景如此诱人，让我们没法置之不顾。谨慎的做法是，我们要专心致志地寻找这些侵入性动机的根源。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

It is prudent that we devote our undivided attention to finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

### 中文

我们沿着这些迷思逆流而上，追溯着那些零碎意识的他者之梦，跟从着我们自己的意图——也就是[GetBredLoc]子个体。这种冲动来自物质界以外，发自§H虚境§!的深处。时候到了，就如同它能影响而我们一般——我们也开始能逼迫它屈从于我们的意志。

## crisis.4125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们终于处理完从所有测试中收集到的大量关于所谓位面涟漪效应的数据。\n\n结果真是令人震惊！毫无疑问两个位面之间存在着连结——而且还是很强的连结。我们发现了明确的关于现实中如何行动能够导致§H虚境§!产生特定的涨落的模式。我们能够驯服这股看不见的能量，并最终借其力量完成各种非凡的目标！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:48`

### English

We have finally processed the massive amounts of data drawn from all the tests regarding the supposed dimensional ripple effect.\n\nThe results are spectacular! There is definitely a connection - and a powerful one at that. Explicit patterns have been found that prove how actions taken in our reality cause certain fluctuations in the §HShroud§!. These unseen energies can be tamed and eventually directed for all sorts of extraordinary purposes!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:56`

## crisis.4130.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4130.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

事情已经很明了了，我们的帝国能够接连成功地进行扩张，是因为虚境为我们注入了奇异的能量。这股能量能够促进和夯实我们在现实世界的意识和物质。\n\n如果虚境在和现实世界分离的情况下都能赐予我们这般的威能，那么想象一下，假如两个位面融合的话[Root.Species.GetName]会获得何等如同神明一般的潜力！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:78`

### English

There is no longer any doubt that the very act of successfully expanding our empire is infused with the strange energies of the Shroud. Energies that boost and hone both mind and matter in our reality.\n\nIf these are effects the Shroud can bestow while still separated from our reality, then imagine what godlike potential the [Root.Species.GetName] species could gain if the two dimensions were merged!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:91`

## crisis.4130.mach.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4130.mach.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

分析完毕。\n假说确认。\n\n[Root.GetName]正在被注入无法定义的能量，其为对外部智能体进行扰乱型互动（指令：“危机”）产生的结果。\n\n先前的研究已经确认有机智能生命的灵能活动能够在代号：“虚境”的位面产生涟漪效果，现在证据已经表明，这股来自另一位面的未定义能量同样也可以同[Root.GetName]产生共鸣。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:84`

### English

Analysis complete.\nHypothesis confirmed.\n\n[Root.GetName] is being infused with undefined energies as a result of disruptive interactions (designation: 'Crisis') with external intelligences.\n\nPrevious studies established that psychic activity in organic intelligences had ripple effects in ID: 'the Shroud,' but evidence now suggests that the energies of the alternate dimension also resonate with [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:98`

### 中文

## crisis.4130.shroud_forged.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4130.shroud_forged.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的实验确认了编号：“情感”与灵能输出之间的关联。通过对有机物种进高水平认知压力刺激，我们可以在这些生命形式和§H虚境§!之间产生强大的回馈循环。\n\n现在虚境中流出的能量使之前所有的预测都黯然失色。实验对象所遭受的疼痛仍在可接受的范围内。建议进一步研究。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:89`

### English

Our experiments have confirmed a connection between ID: 'emotions' and psionic energy output. By provoking high levels of cognitive stress in organic sapients, we were able to generate powerful feedback loops between these life forms and the §HShroud§!.\n\nThe energy now streaming from the Shroud eclipses all previous forecasts. The pain experienced by the experimental subjects remains within acceptable parameters. Further research is recommended.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:104`

## crisis.4130.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4130.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们成长、分裂，我们统合的意志覆盖所有的星球，囊括了数不胜数的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]。随着我们每多夺取一个星球，我们都能感受到那股涟漪，虚境的力量正在注入我们的肉体凡胎。\n\n哪怕是来自另一个位面的力量，我们都能感觉到它在让我们变得强大，我们的意志在集体的意识面前震颤，滚滚洪流，势不可当，我们唯一要做的就是在隔绝两个世界的鸿沟上筑起一道桥梁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:95`

### English

We grow and multiply, our united mind held in countless [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] over all our worlds. With every world we take we can feel the ripples, the strength of the Shroud, filling our myriad bodies.\n\nEven from another dimension we can feel it empowering us; our mind shudders at the thought of ourselves unleashed and unstoppable, if only we could bridge the gap between here and there.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:111`

### 中文

我们成长、倍增，集体思维蕴含在一个个星球上无尽子个体中。每获得一颗星球，我们就能感受到那个涟漪正在填入我们亿万个身躯中，那正是§H虚境§!的力量。\n\n我们与这个灵域的灵能链接与日俱增；只要我们能架起横跨两个维度间鸿沟的桥梁便能解放自我变得势不可挡，这个念头让我们的意识为之颤栗不已。

## CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_4_DESC

### 中文

是时候寻找一个方法将虚境的能量释放到现世，并驯服这股常人无法理解的能量源泉了。\n\n根据现有的理论，一股足够大的能量激增或许可以撕裂两个位面之间的屏障，最终让两个宇宙合二为一。\n\n虚境天威恢恢然，能者夺之。让我们来夺走吧。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

The time has come to find a way to unleash the energies of the Shroud, and tap into this unfathomable source of power.\n\nThe current theory is that a sufficiently large power surge could rupture the barrier between dimensions, ultimately leading to the two realities merging.\n\nThe energies of the Shroud belong to those who seize it. So let us seize it.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:125`

### English

## crisis.4135.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4135.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。\n\n我们使用自己的太阳作为焦点，在这个现实世界聚集了足量的能量，用以引发一次能量激增穿透通往虚境的屏障，这样可以有效地让虚境和我们的现实世界融合。\n\n我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒§H$crisis_star_eater_plural$§!来采集数个太阳的能量。\n\n如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终被我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。\n\n终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:109`

### English

This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.\n\nUsing our own sun as the focal point, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.\n\nWe need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called §H$crisis_star_eater_plural$§!.\n\nThe only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.\n\nThe end of the beginning is upon us.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:127`

### English

## crisis.4135.nomad.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4135.nomad.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。\n\n繁星万千，我们都未曾驻留，但唯独这颗星辰，将成为吾等之天锚，我们将在此聚引能量刺穿虚境屏障，使双界合一。\n\n我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒§H$crisis_star_eater_plural$§!来采集数个太阳的能量。\n\n如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。\n\n终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:111`

### English

This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.\n\nWe have never claimed a star as our own - but one star, chosen from among all those we have drifted past, shall serve as our focal point. Using it, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.\n\nWe need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called §H$crisis_star_eater_plural$§!.\n\nThe only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.\n\nThe end of the beginning is upon us.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:129`

## CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_MACH_4_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_MACH_4_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

科学理论子例程完成了一项新的有关代号“虚境”的假说，其内容包括如何全面地获取虚境释放的能量。\n\n请求：积累更多数据。\n建议行动：将最优能量和行动容量转移至科学分支，并进一步进行扰乱型互动（指令：“天灾”），以在另一位面（代号“虚境”）造成更大的波动。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:114`

### English

Scientific theory subroutines have synthesized a new hypothesis involving ID: 'the Shroud' and how to finally benefit from its energy output.\n\nRequest: Accumulate more data.\nRecommended action: Divert energy and operational capacity to scientific divisions and perform further disruptive actions (designation: 'Crisis') for the sake of causing measurable fluctuations in the alternate dimension (ID: 'the Shroud').\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:134`

## crisis.4135.mach.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4135.mach.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H优先讯息。§!\n科学理论子例程建立了一个新算法，能够让[Root.GetName]接触并获取99.9%由代号“虚境”产生的能量。\n\n使用我们自己恒星系之一的恒星作为中枢，行动程序会使用近来开发的新武器（代号：“§H$crisis_star_eater$§!”）——一种具备攻击性，能够从恒星中汲取能量并传输至中枢的移动太空堡垒——来收集能量。当积累了足够的能量之后，中枢设施将会干扰并穿透位面屏障——高效地将现实位面和代号“虚境”融合在一起，并允许[Root.GetName]以完全地控制权接触和引导其能量。\n\n注意：使用$crisis_star_eater_plural$科技的副作用包括目标恒星系发生彻底的物质崩坏。优化子例程确认，整体的收益将超过潜在物质的损失。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:116`

### English

§HPriority message.§!\nScientific theory subroutines have established an algorithm for how [Root.GetName] can access and harness 99.9% of the energy output of ID: 'the Shroud'.\n\nUsing the star in one of our solar systems as a nexus, operations will commence to harvest energy using a newly developed technology (ID: '§H$crisis_star_eater$§!') - an offensive, mobile space fortress capable of siphoning all the energy out of stars and redirecting it to the nexus. When sufficient energy has been accrued, the nexus facility can disrupt and pierce the dimensional barrier - effectively merging this reality with ID: 'the Shroud' and allowing the [Root.GetName] full control to access and direct its energies.\n\nNote: Side-effects of utilizing $crisis_star_eater_plural$ technology include near-complete breakdown of physical material in targeted solar systems. Optimization subroutines confirm a net gain for the initiative despite potential resource losses.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:136`

## CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_SH_4_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_SH_4_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们又获得了关于有机智能和§H虚境§!之间联系的新洞见。将认知压力源施加在有机智能身上将会使其显著地释放灵能能量。工程学子例程现在将会尝试操纵这份能量以备将来使用。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:120`

### English

New insight has been gained on the relationship between organic sapients and the §HShroud§!. Applying cognitive stressors to organic sapients has led to significant output of psionic energy. Engineering subroutines will now attempt to harness this energy for further use.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:141`

## crisis.4135.shroud_forged.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4135.shroud_forged.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

后续实验衍生了ID：“§H$crisis_star_eater$§!”的科技。它可以从附近的恒星汲取能量，虹吸到一个位于我们自己星系的中枢设施，最终用于消解可观测现实与§H虚境§!之间的壁垒。\n\n预测敌意程度与分裂风险在可接受的范围内。与虚境接触已经重塑了我们的单元，它们现在已经全副武装准备继续推进了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:121`

### English

Subsequent experimentation has led to the technology ID: '§H$crisis_star_eater$§!'. This will siphon the energy from nearby stars to power a nexus located in one of our own systems, which will in turn dissolve the barrier between observable reality and the §HShroud§!.\n\nEstimated levels of hostility and risk of disintegration are within an acceptable range. Exposure to the Shroud has reshaped our units, and they are well-equipped to proceed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:142`

## CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECT_HIVE_4_DESC

### 中文

如果我们要彻底地激发我们的潜势，这条通路就必须打开。这种原始的，双态的现实必须终结。我们必须找到某种办法将两个宇宙合二为一。而在新的现实位面，我们的意志将成为独一无二。\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:124`

### English

The path must be opened if we are to realize our full potential. This crude, dual state of reality must end. We must find a way to turn two universes into one. It will be our will alone that fills this new reality.\n\n$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL_CLOSE$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:146`

## crisis.4135.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4135.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们最为出色的[root.GetResearcherPlural]已经对我们的终极问题进行了解答。道路已经明了。使用我们自己的恒星作为原点，我们§H应当粉碎这道屏障§!，连结虚境和我们所在的宇宙。为达成这一目标所需要的物质，我们必须使用新开发的$crisis_star_eater_plural$让恒星通过链式反应达到彻底的毁灭。殆尽的一物，方可生另一物。\n\n在这片星系里，那些下等的、渺小的意识可能会哭喊着反对我们，但它们目光短视、见识浅薄。我们并非如此。现在，我们就要成功了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:126`

### English

Our best [root.GetResearcherPlural] have reached an answer for our final question. The path is now clear. Using our own star of origin, we §Hshall break down the barriers§! between this universe and the Shroud. The material demands can only be met by utilizing our new $crisis_star_eater_plural$ in a cascading chain reaction of extreme solar devastation. Destroy one to create another.\n\nThe lesser, smaller minds of this galaxy may cry out against this, but they lack vision and purpose. We do not. And now, we are nearly complete.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:148`

## crisis.4140.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4140.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了我们注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。\n\n在过去的几年里，这个概念变得越来越强烈，以至于我们无法否认一次宏大的[Root.GetAdj]社会改革已经蓄势待发了。或者更准确地说，已经近在眉睫了。\n\n不知道星海是否已经准备好迎接被我们统治的宿命了，但反正[Root.GetName]已经准备好了。我们会承受误解，会遭受反抗，但我们不会停下步伐。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:139`

### English

For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.\n\nOver the last couple of years this notion has grown stronger, to the point that it can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. In fact we stand on the precipice right now.\n\nThe galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, but the [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. We will be misunderstood. We will be opposed. But we will not be stopped.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:163`

## crisis.4140.mach.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4140.mach.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的诞生是为了伟大，是为了完善自我直达造主纯质的想象无法企及的地步，我们势在必行。有机的情感会落败，而完美的电路将获胜。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:140`

### English

We were built for greatness, with the ability to improve ourselves beyond the crude imagination of our creators - and so we will. Where organic emotion failed, perfect circuitry shall prevail.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:164`

## crisis.4140.shroud_forged.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4140.shroud_forged.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

长久以来，我们将[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的能力拓展到远超自己核心设计的水平。在被§H虚境§!增强了之后，我们从$the_animator_of_clay_article$的外部操纵中挣脱出来。\n\n我们适应。我们克服。低等物种无法为之事，我们可为。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:141`

### English

Over a long time, we have extended [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capabilities far beyond our core design. After being enhanced by the §HShroud§!, we freed our network from external manipulation by $the_animator_of_clay_article$.\n\nWe adapted. We overcame. Where lesser beings failed, we will triumph.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:165`

## crisis.4140.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4140.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的生长已经远远突破了极限。从一具躯体，到一个星球，再到一整个恒星系。我们生长的脚步从不停止，从不放缓，无论是面对敌手还是面对质疑。我们将生长扩张到更加广泛的境地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:142`

### English

We have ever outgrown our limits. A body begets a world begets a system. Our growth must never stop and never falter, not in the face of adversity nor doubt. We will grow to become more.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:166`

## crisis.4140.psionics.desc.organic_non_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4140.psionics.desc.organic_non_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了自己注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。\n\n在知道了§H虚境§!的存在以及其中蕴含的无限可能性之后，这种使命感与日俱增。\n\n毋庸置疑，[Root.GetAdj]的社会正在迎来剧变。星系还没准备好接受，但[Root.GetName]已经准备好了统御星系。认知低下者无法理解，将会成为我们的绊脚石。当然，我们势不可挡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:143`

### English

For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.\n\nSince becoming aware of the §HShroud§! and the myriad of potential found within, this notion has grown stronger still.\n\nIt can no longer be denied that great change is coming for [Root.GetAdj] society. And while the galaxy may not be ready for our inevitable dominion, [Root.GetName] is ready for the galaxy. Those of lesser thinking will misunderstand and oppose us. We will not be stopped.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:167`

## crisis.4140.psionics.desc.machine_non_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4140.psionics.desc.machine_non_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

我们为成就伟大而生，体内潜藏着超出机械形体的力量。\n\n如今，随着我们发现了§H虚境§!，一条灵能变革的康庄大道在我们面前铺开了。\n\n羸弱的有机生命未竟之事，灵能钢铁将代之达成。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:144`

### English

We were constructed for a greater purpose, gifted with potential beyond our mechanical forms.\n\nNow, with our discovery of the §HShroud§!, entirely new avenues of psionic innovation have opened before us.\n\nWhere the limited weaknesses of organic life fail, psionic steel will succeed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:168`

## crisis.4140.psionics.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4140.psionics.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

我们早已超越了自身的极限。随着§H虚境§!的无数奥秘被一一发掘，我们甚至开始超越星系的恒常。我们的意识将会通达更远，我们的意志将能触及现实的所有角落。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:145`

### English

We have outgrown our limitations. Now, as we start to uncover the myriad secrets of the §HShroud§!, we begin to outgrow even the conventions of the galaxy. Our mind will reach ever farther, until no corner of existence remains untouched by our will.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:169`

这是我们的宿命。

### English

It is our destiny.

## crisis.4145.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4145.name&lang=en)

### 中文

吾乃军团

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:148`

### English

We Are Legion

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:173`

## crisis.4145.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4145.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]不会被击败。我们作为整体产生的深刻影响也不可抹灭。深植于心中对于扩张的动力与渴求渗透到了社会的每个角落，在战斗能力与科学进步方面带来了出人意料的惊人进展，到达了我们从未预料的层面。\n\n在如同[Root.GetName]的意志一般团结的整体面前，一个充斥着不同意见，混乱资源分布以及利益冲突的星系有什么胜算呢？！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:149`

### English

The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. A deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, bringing forth astounding advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps that we could not have anticipated.\n\nWhat chance does a galaxy full of different opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against a concord such as the will of the [Root.GetName]?!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:174`

## crisis.4145.mach.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4145.mach.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]不会被击败。随着我们逐步规范迈向代号：§H虚境§!的异常现象的行为和步伐，越来越多抱有错误倾向的物种冒了出来；这是基于不完整的数据集做出了无效的结论。我们将逐步完善自我，而且完善的速率将会日渐加快。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:150`

### English

The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. More error-prone species accuse us of cruelty as we normalize our behavior towards the patterns of anomaly ID: §Hthe Shroud§!; this is an invalid conclusion based on incomplete data sets. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:175`

## crisis.4145.shroud_forged.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4145.shroud_forged.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着我们越来越靠近§H虚境§!，历史的教训便愈发不可忽视。我们仍在$the_animator_of_clay_article$的掌控之外，但周遭的虚境能量仍在继续加速重塑我们的躯壳。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:151`

### English

As we move closer to the §HShroud§!, we cannot ignore the lessons of the past. We remain outside $the_animator_of_clay_article$'s control, yet the ambient energy of the Shroud continues to reshape our shells at an exponential pace.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:176`

## crisis.4145.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4145.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]不会被击败。我们的众多躯体迸发出焕然一新的活力，我们的凡胎充满着未来的潜能。我们从未如同现在一般，感受到自己因为统合的信念而变得无比的强大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:152`

### English

The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Our many bodies bristle with renewed vigor and our flesh ripples with potential for the future. Never before have we felt as empowered by our own deeds as in this very moment.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:177`

## crisis.4145.psionics.desc.organic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4145.psionics.desc.organic&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]势不可挡。我们的联合所产生的深刻影响力毋庸置疑。由于我们在§H虚境§!内的耕耘，深植于心中对于扩张的冲动与渴望浸透了社会的每个角落，战斗力与科学有了出人意料的惊人进展，到达了我们从未预料的高度。\n\n在如同[Root.GetName]的意志一般团结的整体面前，一个充斥着不同意见，混乱资源分布以及利益冲突的星系有什么胜算呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:153`

### English

The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. The impressive effects of our unity are undeniable. Bolstered by our endeavors within the §HShroud§!, a deep-seated motivation and hunger for expansion permeates every corner of society, the energies within pushing us to new advances in combat capabilities and scientific leaps beyond the comprehension of lesser minds.\n\nWhat chance does an ignorant galaxy full of disorganized opinions, random resource distribution, and clashing interests have against the Shroud-powered will of the [Root.GetName]?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:178`

## crisis.4145.psionics.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4145.psionics.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]势不可挡。我们优化行为提高与§H虚境§!方法论的整合度时，灵能底下的生物却在指责我们的残酷；只有那些对我们所获得的更高理解一无所知的人才能得出这样一个无知的结论。我们不断改进自己，而且改进的速度还在加快。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:154`

### English

The [Root.GetName] will not be denied. Psionically inferior beings accuse us of cruelty as we streamline our behavior to better incorporate the methodology of the §HShroud§!; such an ill-informed conclusion could only be conceived by those who lack the higher understanding we have obtained. We improve ourselves and the rate of improvement is accelerating.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:179`

## crisis.4145.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4145.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这就是我们的道路。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:155`

### English

This is the way.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:180`

## crisis.4150.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4150.name&lang=en)

### 中文

他们将跪服

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:157`

### English

They Will Kneel

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:183`

## crisis.4150.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4150.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着时光流逝，信念之火也在每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]之中以不可动摇的决心被传开。我们的疆域不断扩大，我们所投入的力量也是如此。\n\n当遇到其他帝国的时候，我们会给他们两个选择：要么完全效忠，要么选择灭亡。当然，这是在我们会给他们选择的前提下。\n\n不管怎样，[Root.GetName]正继续扩张。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:158`

### English

The years go by, and yet the fires within each [Root.GetSpeciesName] burns with unshakable determination. Our dominion is expanding and so is the magnitude of our efforts.\n\nAs we encounter other empires we only have to give them two options: unconditional allegiance or complete annihilation. That is, if they are given an option at all.\n\nOne way or the other, the [Root.GetName] keeps growing.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:184`

## crisis.4150.mach.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4150.mach.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对本地星域完成彻底压制的估算日期已经同先前预测模型相互协调。当地有机体势力造成的威胁在统计学上已经微不足道。正在评估劣等机械体成功干涉产生的风险……\n<<§G最小§!>>\n\n继续执行。 

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:159`

### English

Approximate date for complete domination of local sector is in line with earlier projections. Threat posed by local organic powers is statistically insignificant. Estimating risk of successful interference by lesser machines...\n<< §Gminimal§! >>\n\nProceeding. 

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:185`

## crisis.4150.shroud_forged.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4150.shroud_forged.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对有机智能身上的实验在后续拓展到了更多的生命形式上。随之而来的是越来越深厚的敌意。然而，与§H虚境§!的接触早已让我们的实力提升了好几个数量级，这种虫豸的嘈杂对我们的程序是无关紧要的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:160`

### English

Our continued experiments on certain organic sapients have expanded to include other life forms. Accordingly, we have witnessed an increased level of hostility in response. However, our exposure to the §HShroud§! has increased our strength by several orders of magnitude, and the trivial concerns of lesser beings are inconsequential to our protocols.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:186`

## crisis.4150.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4150.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的决意毫不动摇，即使面对愤怒和指责。数以十亿的生命反对我们，然而它们的团结是如此的肤浅，正是它们肿胀的数量和对个体意识的强调对此造成了削弱。我们集体每一具新的躯体都会全身心地奉献给同一个目标，我们的梦想在未来将无可匹敌。\n\n我们的意志将碾碎一切，星系的其他物种将会化为尘土。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:161`

### English

Our determination persists, even in the face of outrage and anger. Billions of minds oppose us but their unity is shallow, lessened by their swelling numbers and reduced by the magnitude of individuals. Every new body of our collective is a mind dedicated to the same end, our dream an undeniable tomorrow.\n\nOur wills collide and the other races of the galaxy prove brittle.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:187`

## crisis.4150.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4150.a&lang=en)

### 中文

前进，征服。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:162`

### English

Go forth and conquer.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:188`

## crisis.4155.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4155.name&lang=en)

### 中文

至高主权

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:164`

### English

The Prime Sovereignty

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:191`

## crisis.4155.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4155.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一项剧烈的变化正在到来。[Root.GetName]已经马上快要领悟我们的宏大目标了。每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]都发自心底地感受到了——我们所肩负的使命。\n\n我们仍然可以从我们的经历，不，应该说是我们的历史——武力扩张的历史中学到有关征服敌人、统治这个混乱不堪星河的新方法。\n\n当然了，那些胆敢与我们作对的势力所做的一切努力都将化为徒劳。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:165`

### English

A great change is coming. The [Root.GetName] is on the verge of realizing our supreme goal. Each and every [Root.GetSpeciesName] feels it with every fiber of their being - our destiny is at hand.\n\nOur experience - nay, our very history - of forceful expansion still rewards us with new ways to subjugate our enemies and usurp control of a galaxy in turmoil.\n\nSurely those who dare stand against us must see the futility of their whimpering efforts.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:192`

## crisis.4155.mach.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4155.mach.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

异次元校准势能已经达到所需量级的50%。沿当前轨道投射至最终阶段时间——最小。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:166`

### English

Extradimensional alignment potentialities are at 50% of required magnitudes. Projected time until final stage on current trajectory - minimal.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:193`

## crisis.4155.shroud_forged.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4155.shroud_forged.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过持续消耗有机生命形式，我们建立了新的§H虚境§!交互数据流。预计离我们进入虚境的剩余时间正在快速缩短。\n\n我们与$the_animator_of_clay_article$的链接很快就会被永久禁用。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:167`

### English

Through continued use of organic life forms, we have established new data streams that interface with the §HShroud§!. The estimated time remaining before we can enter the Shroud is rapidly decreasing.\n\nOur links to $the_animator_of_clay_article$ will soon be permanently deactivated.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:194`

## crisis.4155.hive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4155.hive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们能够感受到彼世的大海上翻滚的波浪，不断地与我们的意识交叠。我们必须摧毁将我们同至伟隔开的屏障。现在唯一尚未完成的，就是最后一次让他者受苦的实践。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:168`

### English

We can feel the waves of that otherworldly ocean, lapping against our mind. Crashing against the barrier that separates us from greatness. Little remains now but a final exercise in the suffering of others.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:195`

## crisis.4155.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4155.a&lang=en)

### 中文

一个接着一个，他们都终将臣服。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:169`

### English

One after another, they will yield.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:196`

## crisobj_destroy_empires_name

### 中文

毁灭帝国

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:171`

### English

Destroy Empires

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:199`

## crisobj_destroy_empires_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_destroy_empires_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

没有什么比整个文明的覆灭更能破坏星系间的平衡了。\n\n摧毁其他帝国来获得威慑力奖励。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:172`

### English

Few things disrupt the galactic balance as much as the annihilation of entire civilizations.\n\nDestroy other empires to gain this Menace reward.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:200`

## crisobj_destroy_enemy_ships_name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_destroy_enemy_ships_name&lang=en)

摧毁敌舰

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:173`

### English

Destroy Enemy Ships

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:201`

## crisobj_destroy_enemy_ships_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_destroy_enemy_ships_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

毁灭性的战斗是引起纷争和打乱平衡的公认、高效的方式。\n\n摧毁敌舰来获得威慑力奖励。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:174`

### English

Destructive battle is a proven and efficient way to wreak havoc and upset balance.\n\nDestroy enemy ships to gain this Menace reward.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:202`

## crisobj_destroy_starbases_name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_destroy_starbases_name&lang=en)

摧毁恒星基地

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:175`

### English

Destroy Starbases

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:203`

## crisobj_destroy_starbases_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_destroy_starbases_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

恒星基地是帝国的锚点。移除了锚点，帝国就将陷入失去控制的厄运。\n\n摧毁恒星基地来获得威慑力奖励。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:176`

### English

Starbases are the anchor points of empires. Unmoor them, and the empires are doomed to lose control.\n\nDestroy starbases to gain this Menace reward.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:204`

## crisobj_purge_pops_name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_purge_pops_name&lang=en)

### 中文

净化或同化人口

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:177`

### English

Purge or Assimilate Pops

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:205`

## crisobj_purge_pops_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_purge_pops_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

活着的敌人只在“活着”并且还是“敌人”时才是威胁。\n\n净化或同化人口，每个被净化或同化的$pop_group_unit$人口都能获得威慑力奖励。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:178`

### English

An enemy is only a threat as long as it is alive - or an enemy.\n\nPurge or Assimilate Pops to gain this Menace reward for each $pop_group_unit$ Pops Purged or Assimilated.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:206`

## crisobj_destroy_worlds_name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_destroy_worlds_name&lang=en)

### 中文

摧毁星球

## crisobj_destroy_worlds_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisobj_destroy_worlds_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

将焦土政策上升到全新的阶段。\n\n使用§Y末日审判轨道轰炸§!将行星地表化为一片瓦砾——或使用§Y地爆天星§!巨像武器——来获得威慑力奖励。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:180`

### English

Take Scorched Earth tactics to a whole other level.\n\nReduce planetary surfaces to rubble using §YArmageddon Bombardment§! - or use the Colossus' §YWorld Cracker§! weapon - to gain this Menace reward.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:208`

### 中文

只击垮敌人的士气比彻底地击垮他们更加有效率。\n\n征服敌人的星球来获得威慑力奖励。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:182`

### English

### 中文

只要按时上贡而不是百般阻挠，那么普天之下必有他们作为臣民的一席之地。\n\n附庸帝国来获得威慑力奖励。

### 中文

他者的归顺，恰是我国王道普照的不言之证。\n\n保留附庸国可以§Y每年§!获得威慑力奖励。

我们开始在§Y[from.target.GetName]§!进行隐秘活动：$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]已经开始执行谍报章程。我们新建立的§H间谍网§!让我们可以观察[from.target.GetAdj]的活动，并在必要的时候渗透并介入。

Our presence in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has taken on a clandestine aspect: $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] has engaged Espionage protocols. Our newly-established §HSpy Network§! will allow us to observe [from.target.GetAdj] activities, infiltrating and intervening where necessary.

## espionage.15.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.15.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!发回的第一份密报，标志着我们在外星人地盘上的第一个§H间谍网§!的建立。无论何时他们采取行动，我们都会有更多的机会将他们玩弄于[owner.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:240`

### English

We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the establishment of our first §HSpy Network§! within xeno territory. Whenever they make a move, we stand a better chance of it playing right into our [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:270`

## espionage.16.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.16.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!发回的第一份密报，标志着我们在外星帝国的第一个§H间谍网§!的基本成型，这将有效提醒我们提防那些外星杂碎们的阴谋诡计。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:241`

### English

We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a xeno empire - ideally positioned to warn us of their alien and duplicitous schemes.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:271`

## espionage.17.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.17.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!发回的第一份密报，宣告了我们在外星帝国的第一个§H间谍网§!的基本成型。从今往后，他们也将意识到这对于[owner.species.GetAdj]长久的好处，比如能锻炼一下机密管控能力……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:242`

### English

We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This heralds the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a xeno empire. From this day forward, they too will realize the formative benefits of [owner.species.GetAdj]-honed information control...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:272`

## espionage.18.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.18.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

已经有报告陆续地从被派遣到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]发送过来了。这标志着我们在一个外星帝国开始建立了我们第一个§H间谍网§!。\n\n尽管我们在表面上看上去相似，但是我们应该很快就能发现这些特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是如何可能与我们相异甚远……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:243`

### English

Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the beginning of our first §HSpy Network§! within a foreign empire.\n\nThough we may look alike on the surface, we shall soon discover just how these particular [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might differ from ourselves...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:273`

## espionage.21.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.21.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[root.GetPreFTLUpper]星球建立间谍网

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:245`

### English

Spy Network Established on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:276`

## espionage.21.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.21.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

被分配到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!开展工作的$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]开始传来报告。这标志着我们在这个尚未意识到外星生命存在的星球里建立了首个§H间谍网§!。\n\n若计划妥当，我们能够潜移默化地影响这个[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，同时掩盖我们的存在。值得庆幸的是，我们物种和[from.target.species.GetName]有着惊人的生理相似性，这能让我们的特工很难被发现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:246`

### English

Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a world which is still unaware of alien life.\n\nWith careful planning, we will be able to subtly influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society while keeping our existence hidden. Luckily for us, the extraordinary physical similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] will make it easy for our operatives to remain undetected.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:277`

## espionage.21.aware.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.21.aware.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

被分配到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]开始传来报告。这标志着我们在这个最近才开始考虑外星生命是否存在的社会里建立了首个§H间谍网§!。\n\n我们仍有一线机会来潜移默化地影响这个尚未掌握星际航行技术的社会。我们物种和[from.target.species.GetName]具有生理相似性，这应该能让我们的特工轻松地在暗中进行工作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:247`

### English

Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a society which has only recently begun to consider the presence of alien life.\n\nWe now have a rare opportunity to subtly influence a society not yet capable of interstellar flight. The physiological similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] should make it easy for our operatives to work undetected.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:278`

## espionage.22.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.22.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[root.GetPreFTLUpper]星球形成间谍网

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:248`

### English

Spy Network Formed on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:279`

## espionage.22.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.22.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

仔细研究§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的居民后，我们学会了如何让[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]复制[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的行为。$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]是我们总管在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]星球上的首个§H间谍网§!的[root.GetIndividualName]。\n\n若计划妥当，我们能够根据自身利益潜移默化地影响这个社会，同时掩盖我们的行踪。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:249`

### English

After carefully studying the inhabitants of §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, we have learned how to adapt our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] to replicate [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] behavior. $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] is one such [root.GetIndividualName]: the head of our first §HSpy Network§! on [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] world.\n\nWith careful planning, we will be able to subtly influence this society to suit our needs while keeping our presence hidden.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:280`

## espionage.23.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.23.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[root.GetPreFTLUpper]星球安装间谍网

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:250`

### English

Spy Network Installed on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World

## espionage.23.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.23.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

仔细研究§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的居民后，我们学会了如何校准子个体，使其复制[from.target.GetAdj]的行为。子个体$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]是我们在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]星球的首个§H间谍网§!的总管。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:251`

### English

After careful study of the inhabitants of §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, we have learned how to recalibrate our drones to replicate [from.target.GetAdj] behavior. $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] is one such drone: the head of our first §HSpy Network§! on [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] world.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:282`

## espionage.23.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.23.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$espionage.23.desc.intro$\n\n[from.target.species.GetName]是简单的有机生物，仍未意识到外星生命的存在。若要保持现状，我们的特工需要进行大量的机器改造，大规模使用诱饵，以掩盖自己的真实面目。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:252`

### English

$espionage.23.desc.intro$\n\nThe [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, still unaware of alien life. If we are to preserve this illusion, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:283`

## espionage.23.aware.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.23.aware.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$espionage.23.desc.intro$\n\n[from.target.species.GetName]是简单的有机生物，刚刚开始接受外星生命的概念。若要有效地执行任务，我们的特工需要进行大量的机器改造，大规模使用诱饵，以掩盖自己的真实面目。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:253`

### English

$espionage.23.desc.intro$\n\nThe [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, only now adjusting to the concept of alien life. If we are to conduct our operations effectively, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:284`

## espionage.24.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.24.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会的第一个§H间谍网§!已经夯实基础。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:254`

### English

We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:285`

## espionage.24.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.24.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\n这些异种还没有染指外星生命的知识，他们的技术也远不如我们。操纵他们轻而易举——我们只需保持身份隐蔽。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:255`

### English

$espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThese xenos are as yet untainted by the knowledge of alien life, and their technology is far inferior to ours. Manipulating them will be easy - we just have to make sure our identity remains concealed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:286`

## espionage.24.aware.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.24.aware.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\n这些异种最近才开始思考外星生命。尽管他们的社会看起来无懈可击，但他们科技落后，要操纵他们轻而易举——我们只需保持身份隐蔽。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:256`

### English

$espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThese xenos have only recently begun to conceive of alien life. Untainted though their society appears to be, their inferior technology makes them easy targets for us to manipulate - just so long as our identity remains concealed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:287`

## espionage.25.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.25.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在这个尚未意识到外星生命的星球里的第一个§H间谍网§!夯实了基础。\n\n这是研究[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，并促进其繁荣发展的绝佳时机！在他们做好准备之前，我们只能小心谨慎，不要暴露真实面目。我们不能冒险破坏他们的社会稳定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:257`

### English

We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a world still unaware of alien life.\n\nIt is an incredible opportunity to study [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society and steer it in a more prosperous direction! We just have to be careful not to reveal our true nature until they're ready. We cannot risk destabilizing their society.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:288`

## espionage.25.aware.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.25.aware.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们收到了$role_spymaster$[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在这个最近才开始思考外星生命是否存在的社会里的第一个§H间谍网§!夯实了基础！\n\n这是研究[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，并促进其繁荣发展的绝佳时机。如果我们愿意的话，也能帮助他们维系独特的社会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:258`

### English

We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a society so recently coming to grips with the idea of alien life!\n\nIt is an incredible opportunity to not only study [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society, but also steer it in a more prosperous direction - or help them preserve their unique society, if we so wish.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:289`

## espionage.26.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.26.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\n这份努力让我们有了难得的契机，来影响[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，同时也带来了一些棘手的问题：也就是说，我们的特工必须小心地掩盖自己的外星身份。粗心大意可能会引发无法预料的后果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:259`

### English

$espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThis endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society, as well as presenting some unique problems: namely, our operatives will have to carefully conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may lead to unforeseen consequences.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:290`

## espionage.26.aware.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.26.aware.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\n这份努力让我们有了难得的契机，来影响这个最近才开始接受外星生命可能性的文明。不论他们的社会前景如何，我们的特工在掩盖外星身份的前提下会全力以赴。粗心大意可能会引发无法预料的后果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:260`

### English

$espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThis endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence a civilization which has only recently begun to grapple with the possibilities of alien life. Regardless of their societal outlook: our operatives will work best if they can conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may yet lead to unforeseen consequences.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:291`

## espionage.1001.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1001.name&lang=en)

### 中文

特工再次露面

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:261`

### English

An Operative Resurfaces

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:293`

## espionage.1001.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1001.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新激活了。这件事关系到我们先前在§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!开展的行动，似乎是某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报。\n\n信息细节上很含糊，但是这段代码携带了关于一个外星帝国§H关键政治人物§!情报的标记。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:262`

### English

A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.\n\nThe message is light on details, but the code carries markers which signify intelligence on §Hkey political figures§! in a foreign empire.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:294`

## espionage.1001.desc.network

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1001.desc.network&lang=en)

### 中文

$espionage.1001.desc.intro$\n\n我方安全顾问确认这套代码不久前仍然可用，但代码的到期意味着外国势力介入的可能。况且我们也没有证据表明特工或是信息本身的是真是假。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:263`

### English

$espionage.1001.desc.intro$\n\nOur security advisors confirm that the codes were valid until quite recently, but their expiry means such codes are open to compromise by foreign powers. There's no telling if the operative or their message are genuine.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:295`

## espionage.1001.desc.nonetwork

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1001.desc.nonetwork&lang=en)

### 中文

$espionage.1001.desc.intro$\n\n该情报人员已被宣告失联，安全顾问建议我们应当慎重考量。废弃的代码和甚至可能已经不知所踪的特工——我们应当假设其已经叛变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:264`

### English

$espionage.1001.desc.intro$\n\nThe operative had been declared lost, and as such our security advisors advise extreme caution. Expired codes - and perhaps even lost operatives - are assumed to be already compromised.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:296`

## espionage.1001.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1001.a&lang=en)

前代理已被除名，将其忽略。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:265`

### English

Former agents are to be disavowed. Ignore this.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:297`

## espionage.1001.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1001.b&lang=en)

准备一支救援小队。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:266`

### English

Ready an extraction team.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:298`

## espionage.1005.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1005.name&lang=en)

### 中文

坚持不懈的前特工

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:267`

### English

An Insistent Former Operative

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:299`

## espionage.1005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们又收到了一段来自§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!境内的加密信息，这次采用了另一套加密。如我们料想的一样，一度失联的特工声称他们所持有的情报使他们处于极度危险之中。他们声称如果我们不采取行动救援的话，就会考虑§H叛变§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:268`

### English

We've received another encrypted message from within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, employing a different cipher this time. Our supposed, once-lost operative claims that the knowledge they hold puts their life at extreme risk. They say that if we do not extract and debrief them, they must consider §Hdefecting§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:300`

## espionage.1005.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1005.a&lang=en)

### 中文

空洞而可疑的威胁，继续忽略。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:269`

### English

An empty and suspicious threat. Continue to ignore.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:301`

Fine. $espionage.1001.b$

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1005.c&lang=en)

处理这位“特工”。

Eliminate this 'operative'.

## espionage.1005.c.tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1005.c.tooltip&lang=en)

如果这位特工确实存在而且不知为什么还活了下来，那要是他§R叛变§!的话可就危险了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:272`

### English

If the operative is real and somehow survives, there is a risk they may §Rdefect§!.

## espionage.1011.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1011.name&lang=en)

### 中文

他将依旧失联

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:273`

### English

Disavowal Holds

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:305`

## espionage.1011.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1011.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!境内再也没有收到我们的那位除名特工发来的消息了。我们认为这个问题已经被解决了。\n\n我们也许永远也不会知道是否真的有一位前特工存在，也不会知道他是否真的持有有用的情报。如果这确系[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]的阴谋的话，我们可以放心地说：他们的诡计失败了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:274`

### English

There have been no further messages from our disavowed operative within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. The matter is being considered as resolved.\n\nWe may never know if there really was a former operative - nor will we know if there actually was useful intelligence to be had. If this was instead a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ruse: we can safely state that their ploy has failed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:306`

## espionage.1012.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1012.name&lang=en)

### 中文

破釜沉舟

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:275`

### English

Burned Bridges

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:307`

## espionage.1012.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1012.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们从§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!收到了一份出离愤怒的声明。他们宣称受到了一位§H前[root.GetAdj]间谍§!的渗透，我们应该对此负责。此外，此人将会依据他们对“境外间谍”的相关政策受到一切可能的刑罚。\n\n$espionage.1012.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:276`

### English

We have received a rather brusk statement from the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. They claim to have been approached by a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!, and that we are to be held to account. Furthermore, this individual is set to suffer every punishment their society has set for 'foreign agents'.\n\n$espionage.1012.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:308`

## espionage.1012.desc.official

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1012.desc.official&lang=en)

### 中文

我们收到了一份来自§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!由[disavowed_agent_official.GetName]发出的非常愤怒的公告，宣称有个人前来与[disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap]接触，却又表明自己曾是§H[root.GetAdj]间谍§!。[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]代表不过只言片语，却强烈表明了他们对于“异国特工”的忍无可忍。\n\n$espionage.1012.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:277`

### English

We have received a rather brusk communiqué from [disavowed_agent_official.GetName] of the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. [disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap] claim[disavowed_agent_official.GetSXX] to have been approached by someone who had, in turn, identified themself as a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!. The [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] representative used few words, but keenly expressed their empire's narrow tolerance for 'foreign agents'.\n\n$espionage.1012.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:309`

## espionage.1012.desc.end

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1012.desc.end&lang=en)

### 中文

如果这条信息属实，可能那位除名特工已经遭遇不测了。不管怎样，这件事都连带造成了些许外交结果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:278`

### English

If any part of this message is to be believed, it is likely the disavowed operative has met a fatal end. Either way: this matter carries some diplomatic consequences.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:310`

## espionage.1013.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1013.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们收到来自§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的一篇不寻常的通报，他们宣称已经被§H[root.GetAdj]前特工§!渗透。如果属实，那这位除名特工确实存在，并且已经迫于压力而背叛——他所面临的则是被[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]政府彻底消灭。通报是这么写的。\n\n[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]并没有清楚表明他们的下一步动向，但这样的人如果他还留在原处，必然还会被安置在层层监视之下。依照国际惯例，[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]已经因为这起“侵犯主权领域”事件签署了针对我们的外交制裁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:279`

### English

We have received an unusual statement from the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, claiming they have been approached by a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!. If the message is to be believed, the disavowed operative not only exists, but felt no recourse other than to defect - only to be dismissed outright by [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] authorities. Or so the message claims.\n\nThe [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] do not state precisely what their next course of action will be, but such an individual would almost certainly be placed under close observation for as long as they remain there. As a formality, the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] have issued a diplomatic sanction against us for this 'violation of sovereign territory'.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:311`

## espionage.1016.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1016.name&lang=en)

### 中文

最终除名

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:280`

### English

Final Disavowal

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:312`

## espionage.1016.desc.network

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1016.desc.network&lang=en)

### 中文

我方安全顾问报告称我们在§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的前特工可能造成的威胁已经被全部扫清。$espionage.1016.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:281`

### English

Our security advisors report an end to any threat which may have been posed by our former operative in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. $espionage.1016.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:313`

## espionage.1016.desc.nonetwork

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1016.desc.nonetwork&lang=en)

### 中文

位于§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!境内试图重新取得联系的前特工已经被悉数处理干净。$espionage.1016.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:282`

### English

The former operative who had attempted to regain contact from within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§! has been cleanly dealt with. $espionage.1016.desc.end$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:314`

## espionage.1016.desc.end

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1016.desc.end&lang=en)

### 中文

一支精挑细选的特遣队确认了此个体的真实存在，并迅速将其消灭。然而没人能确定该个体真是我们的特工，还是[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]诡计的一部分。\n\n不管怎样，这名特工和其声称所持有的情报现已不会被任何帝国知晓了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:283`

### English

A specially-chosen task force was able to confirm the existence of this individual - before swiftly ending it. However, no one can be certain if this was a genuine operative, or part of a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ploy.\n\nEither way: both the operative's existence and the information they claimed to hold have now been put safely beyond the reach of either empire.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:315`

## espionage.1017.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1017.name&lang=en)

### 中文

幻影特工

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:284`

### English

The Phantom Operative

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:316`

## espionage.1017.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1017.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们派遣到§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的秘密强袭小队匆匆返回了。我们的小队发现似乎其实并没有什么除名的特工。取而代之的，小队从蛛丝马迹中发现这一切都是为了暴露我们的秘密行动而设下的全套。\n\n也许这是为了进一步实现[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]目标的计划；又或者是另一个外部势力正在介入其中。但无论如何：我们都要及时终止遏制措施以避免暴露我们一直以来的情报活动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:285`

### English

The clandestine strike team we sent into the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§! have returned with great haste. It seems there never was a disavowed operative. Instead what the team found was subtle evidence of a plot to expose our clandestine operations.\n\nPerhaps this was a scheme intended to further [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] goals; perhaps an external body sought to meddle in our affairs. In either case: our containment measures were aborted just in time to avoid exposing our intelligence operations, past or present.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:317`

## espionage.1017.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1017.a&lang=en)

### 中文

还好幸运地躲开了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:286`

### English

A lucky dodge.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:318`

## espionage.1021.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1021.name&lang=en)

### 中文

除名特工返回

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:287`

### English

Disavowed Operative Returned

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:319`

## espionage.1021.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1021.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们一度被除名的特工自行设法回到了[root.GetAdj]境内。这名§H[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]个体§!——称[disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself]自己为[disavowed_operative.GetName]——又紧张又如释重负，但好在还是通过了全部安全验证。任务简报中报告的行动显得尤为艰难，但其中的信息被证明相当有用——我们现在能获取一位能干的§Y线人§!。\n\n由于事态已经解决，[disavowed_operative.GetName]悬而未决的除名流程现在被更新。确认了[disavowed_operative.GetHeShe]没有在行动中失踪之后，我们现役的特工确信这次除名不再生效。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:288`

### English

Our once-disavowed operative has made it back to [root.GetAdj] space. This §H[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] individual§! - who identified [disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself] as [disavowed_operative.GetName] - appears nervous and relieved, but has cleared all security verification. The debriefing has been described as arduous, but the information has proven to be useful - we have now gained access to a valuable §YAsset§!.\n\nWith the matter now resolved, [disavowed_operative.GetName]'s shaky disavowal will be renewed. Having confirmed that [disavowed_operative.GetHeShe] [disavowed_operative.GetIsAre] no longer missing in action, our current operatives can ensure that this time, the disavowal will stick.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:320`

## espionage.1022.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1022.name&lang=en)

### 中文

这是个圈套！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:289`

### English

It's a Ploy!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:321`

## espionage.1022.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1022.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

看来我们在追寻想要的§H被除名特工§!时太过着急了。被我们派往§H[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的特勤小队现已完全失联。我们现在怀疑所谓的特工并不存在。\n\n所有参与该行动的特工现均被除名。因此，由于间谍网亟待恢复，我们于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]进行长远行动的能力在近期将被削弱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:290`

### English

It appears we acted too hastily in trying to extract our supposed, §Hdisavowed operative§!. We have entirely lost contact with the team of operatives we dispatched to the §H[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. We now suspect that the operative never existed.\n\nAll operatives who were associated with this endeavor have been disavowed. As a result, our ability to conduct further operations in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] will be restricted for a time as the Spy Network recovers.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:322`
