## espionage.1030.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1030.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

某些位于§H[vividsight_country.GetName]§!听从我们指令的特工开始引起不必要的注意——他们某种程度上成为了……红人？\n\n我们没有理由相信他们的身份暴露了，但是他们不断增长的名声和影响力让我们在隐蔽间谍网方面愈发紧张兮兮。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:293`

### English

Some of the operatives we control in the §H[vividsight_country.GetName]§! are beginning to draw unusual amounts of attention; they are regarded as somehow... attractive?\n\nWe have no reason to believe their cover identities are in jeopardy, but their growing notoriety and influence put strain on the deniability of our Spy Network.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:326`

## espionage.1040.desc.regular

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1040.desc.regular&lang=en)

### 中文

我们正在观察§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!的$role_spymaster$报告了一次新的，令人惊讶的§Y线人§!获取——一名负责交感神经接触的子个体现在为我们的行动服务。\n\n我们已尽一切努力确保这次新的接触不是一个陷阱。例如，我们现在已经制定了一些协议，以尽量减少该线人为双重间谍的可能性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:298`

### English

Our $role_spymaster$ watching over the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! reports the surprise, successful acquisition of a new §YAsset§! - a sympathetic contact who will be of service to our operations as and when we need them.\n\nAll efforts have been taken to ensure that this new contact is genuine. Protocols have been established which seek to minimize the risk of potential double agents, for example.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:332`

## espionage.1040.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1040.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!所进行的诸多隐秘任务就包括低调地搜罗潜在的线人：任何可以帮助我们进一步深入格式塔实体的工具。我们的$role_spymaster$报告刚刚有了一个幸运的发现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:299`

### English

Amongst our many clandestine tasks in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! is the low-key scouting of potential Assets: any tool we can use to further our efforts amongst the gestalt entity. Our $role_spymaster$ reports having just made one such lucky catch.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:333`

## espionage.1040.desc.caughtspies

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1040.desc.caughtspies&lang=en)

### 中文

我们成功地让一群§P[luckycatch_country.GetAdj]敌特§!落入了我们的罗网。他们似乎正在从事危害我方的行动，但细节尚不清楚。\n\n不过，经由审讯，我们已经搜集到了少许关于§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!的情报。我方$role_spymaster$还联系上了一名当地§Y线人§!以对这些情报进行利用。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:300`

### English

We have have trapped a group of §P[luckycatch_country.GetAdj] spies§!. It seems they were engaged in an operation against us, the details of which are unknown to us yet.\n\nThrough our interrogations, however, we have gathered some small amount of Intel on the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!. Our $role_spymaster$ now also has access to a local §YAsset§! with which we can press this advantage.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:334`

## espionage.1040.desc.caught

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1040.desc.caught&lang=en)

### 中文

我们位于§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!的$role_spymaster$发来报告，一批§P敌特§!业已落网。虽然近日来其对我们的不利行动已不可挽回，但事实证明，对这些人的审讯是有价值的。\n\n我们由此获得的情报的时效并不长，但这些敌特的落网使得我们对抗[luckycatch_country.GetName]的行动取得了一定优势。我们已在这些人中发展了一些§Y线人§!，以备不时之需。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:301`

### English

Our $role_spymaster$ in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! reports that we have successfully captured a band of §Psaboteurs§!. Though we were unable to prevent their recent act of aggression against us, our interrogations of the hostile operatives has proven lucrative.\n\nThe intelligence we've gathered will not serve us for long, but capturing these saboteurs has granted us an advantage in our own operations against the [luckycatch_country.GetName]. Through them, we have secured an §YAsset§! to aid us when required.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:335`

### English

We have acquired a §Ynew Asset§! for our Spy Network in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!.

拾者有份

### English

Finders Keepers

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:338`

## espionage.1050.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1050.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[finderskeepers_country.GetAdj]加密密钥§!的一部分落入了位于§Y[finderskeepers_country.GetName]§!的一名格外眼尖的特工[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。看起来是某位粗心的[finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName]$job_politician$在通勤时落下了这一设备。\n\n这对于我们在[finderskeepers_country.GetName]中的行动而言是个好兆头，而且就这一设备独特设计的研究揭示了若干有助于我们通用§Y$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§!方法研发的新颖洞见。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:304`

### English

A particularly observant operative in the §Y[finderskeepers_country.GetName]§! has laid their [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] on part of a §H[finderskeepers_country.GetAdj] encryption key§!. It would seem a careless [finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName] $job_politician$ mislaid the device whilst commuting.\n\nThis bodes well enough for our operations in the [finderskeepers_country.GetName], but our study of the device's unique design has revealed novel insights for our general approach to §Y$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:339`

## espionage.1060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在[capital_scope.GetName]的一名$job_politician_plural$一时大意，将一组敏感材料放错了位置，其中包括一个即使只是单纯将其带出政府机关外也已经严重违反协议的§H加密密钥§!。\n\n我国内政部门正在抢救式切换安保平台，因为这些材料很可能已经落入敌对势力[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:306`

### English

One of our $job_politician_plural$ on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an §Hencryption key§! whose very existence outside of government facilities is a gross breach of protocol.\n\nOur domestic authorities are scrambling to switch security platforms, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into hostile [root.species.GetHandNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:342`

## espionage.1060.desc.corp

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1060.desc.corp&lang=en)

我们在[capital_scope.GetName]的一名[root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural]一时大意，将一组敏感材料放错了位置，其中包括一个即使只是单纯将其带出政府机关外也已经严重违反协议的§H加密密钥§!。\n\n我方安全团队正在抢救式切换安保平台，因为这些材料很可能已经落入我们的竞争者[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:307`

### English

One of our [root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural] on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an §Hencryption key§! whose mere existence outside of strictly-defined zones is a gross breach of protocol.\n\nOur security teams are scrambling to switch operating procedures, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into the [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] of our competitors.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:343`

## espionage.1070.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1070.name&lang=en)

### 中文

检测到敌方渗透

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:312`

### English

Hostile Infiltration Detected

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:349`

## espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1070.desc.identified.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的加密措施抓获了一帮危险的潜伏者。这些潜在敌人似乎为§H[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!工作，其阴谋原本会使许多[root.species.GetAdj]人民丧生并对我方造成显著破坏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:313`

### English

Our Encryption measures have caught a band of dangerous infiltrators. These would-be hostiles appear to be working on behalf of the §H[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!, on a scheme which would have cost many [root.species.GetAdj] lives and caused us significant damage.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:350`

## espionage.1070.desc.identified

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1070.desc.identified&lang=en)

### 中文

$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$\n\n我们设法§Y解密§!了他们携带着的各种材料，但没有一个材料能展现出他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；我们也无法断言他们下一步会做什么。我们获得的情报因而相对较少。\n\n我们必须仔细考虑如何应对。也许我们希望隐藏自身的能力，在星系中的其他邻居面前假装无知。不过，我们也可以正大光明地谴责这次针对我们的未遂暴力袭击。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:314`

### English

$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$\n\nWe have managed to §Ydecrypt§! various materials they were carrying, however none lays out the full scope of their plans against us; nor are we able to say with certainty what their next move may be. Our Intel gains are therefore relatively small.\n\nWe must carefully consider how to respond. We may wish to keep quiet about our own capabilities, feigning ignorance in front of our other galactic neighbors. We would, however, also be justified in publicly denouncing this planned act of violence against us.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:351`

## espionage.1070.desc.identified.hostile

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1070.desc.identified.hostile&lang=en)

### 中文

$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$\n\n我们从他们身上武力夺取的材料中包括大量通讯日志，并且我们设法解密了日志。没有一份日志描述了他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；[hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj]的安保看上去至少相当有能量，我们只能获取零星的情报。我们获知的一切消息都算不上可靠。\n\n尽管我们的愤怒来得合理正当，明智来讲我们需要考虑如何回应。我们可能希望隐藏自身的加密能力，在敌人面前假装无能。不过，我们也可以将[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]针对我们的未遂暴力行动公之于众，也许敌人中也会有人对我们表示同情。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:315`

### English

$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$\n\nAmongst the materials we forcibly extracted from them were a number of communication logs, which we have managed to decrypt. None describes the full scope of their plans against us; [hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj] security seems at least capable enough to yield only patchy Intel to us. Everything else we may extract from them is deemed unreliable information.\n\nDespite the justified outrage we may wish to express, we would be wise to consider our response. We could keep quiet about our own Encryption skill, feigning ineptitude in front of our enemies. Were we to expose the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] for this planned act of violence against us, however, we might find those enemies even regarding us with sympathy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:352`

## espionage.1070.desc.unknown

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1070.desc.unknown&lang=en)

### 中文

我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验明身份。\n\n$espionage.1070.desc.middle$\n\n以防万一，保持密切地监视[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]或许是值得的。不过，保持沉默或许也有好处，以免走漏我们在安保方面相对虚弱的一面。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:316`

### English

Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. They claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.\n\n$espionage.1070.desc.middle$\n\nIt may be worthwhile keeping a closer watch on the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], just in case. However, it may also benefit us to keep quiet and not let slip the comparative weakness of our own security.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:353`

## espionage.1070.desc.middle

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1070.desc.middle&lang=en)

### 中文

这些状似特工的[hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]们携带了各式牵连他人的物件，其中有些我们很容易解密。不过，我们怀疑这些东西是伪造的，用来误导或者欺骗我方。这些间谍或许的确替[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，但证据算不上确凿。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:317`

### English

These [hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]-looking operatives were carrying various incriminating items, some of which we were easily able to decrypt. We suspect, however, that these items are a fabricated distraction or ruse. These spies may indeed be working for the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], but the evidence is inconclusive.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:354`

## espionage.1070.desc.unknown.hostile

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1070.desc.unknown.hostile&lang=en)

### 中文

我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验证。\n\n$espionage.1070.desc.middle$\n\n我们可以对[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]进行报复——这样的行动甚至会被他国视作正当之举。不过，也有可能整起事件都是个诱饵，用来转移我们对真正敌人的注意力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:318`

### English

Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. Even under interrogation they claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.\n\n$espionage.1070.desc.middle$\n\nWe could retaliate against the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] - such action may even be deemed justified by others. However, it's possible this entire incident is a clever lure, put in place to distract us from our true enemies.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:355`

## espionage.1071.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1071.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我方近来情报行动的目标，§Y[from.GetName]§!，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方行动§P公之于众§!！。\n\n有可能他们并没有能够支撑这些指控且可以验证的证据——只有少数国家会选择相信他们。不过，单是这些指控本身可能就足以造成危害了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:327`

### English

Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have not only seen through our scheme but have chosen to §Pexpose us§! for our actions!\n\nIt's possible that no verifiable evidence backs up these claims - few may choose to believe them. The accusation alone may be damaging enough, however.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:364`

## espionage.1071.desc.hostile

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1071.desc.hostile&lang=en)

### 中文

我方近来情报行动的目标，§Y[from.GetName]§!，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方的敌对行动§P公之于众§!！。\n\n有可能他们并未对此掌握实际证据——他们也许只是试图虚张声势来侮辱我们，或者是从他们在星系中的邻居那里赢取支持。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:328`

### English

Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have not only seen through our scheme but have decided to §Pexpose us§! for our actions against them.\n\nIt's possible that they hold no actual evidence for this - they may simply try to bluff their way to insulting us or earning favor with their galactic neighbors.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:365`

## espionage.1072.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1072.name&lang=en)

### 中文

对谍报活动的指控

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:331`

### English

Allegations of Espionage

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:368`

## espionage.1072.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1072.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[from.GetName]§!指控我方进行§P敌对谍报活动§!。他们的宣称——我方派遣特工从事龌龊的侵略举动——完全是基于谎言、虚假消息和不实的论据之上。\n\n不管理由如何，这一指控导致了[from.GetName]对我们的外交制裁。我们大概不会看到由此带来任何直接后果，但他们的盟友，甚或我们自己的盟友都不会对这种诋毁视而不见。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:332`

### English

The §H[from.GetName]§! accuses us of §Phostile espionage§!. Their claims - that we sent operatives to conduct abhorrent acts of aggression against them - are built upon shaky and misattributed evidence.\n\nWhatever the credibility or reasoning behind this allegation, it has resulted in a diplomatic sanction from the [from.GetName]. We are not likely to see any direct consequences from this, but it's unlikely this smear will go unnoticed by any of their other allies, or even our own.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:369`

## espionage.1072.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1072.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这与我们无关。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:333`

### English

It is of no concern to us.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:370`

## espionage.1073.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1073.name&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:334`

### English

Extorted for Espionage

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:371`

## espionage.1073.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1073.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我方近来情报行动的目标，§Y[from.GetName]§!，将我方情报人员当场抓获且§H要求外交支持§!。作为交换，他们同意不将我们的隐秘行动公诸星海。\n\n有可能他们的指控并没有实际证据来支撑，但无论如何这一指控本身就足以对我们造成损害。不论动机如何，[from.GetName]已经要求从我方获得政治好处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:335`

### English

Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have caught us in the act and §Hdemanded political favors§!. In doing so, they have agreed not to expose our covert actions to the wider galaxy.\n\nIt's possible that no actual evidence backs up their claims - the accusation alone could cause us enough damage anyway. Whatever their motivation is, the [from.GetName] have claimed political leverage on us.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:372`

## espionage.1081.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1081.name&lang=en)

### 中文

阴谋被揭露

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:336`

### English

Insidious Plot Uncovered

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:374`

## espionage.1081.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1081.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工发现了一些不寻常的事情：有可靠线索表明，§H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§!正阴谋欺骗我方！我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。\n\n$espionage.1081.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:337`

### English

Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered something unusual: credible hints that the §H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§! are plotting to deceive us! We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.\n\n$espionage.1081.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:375`

## espionage.1081.desc.hostile

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1081.desc.hostile&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工揭露了一些谣言——§H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§!正在密谋欺骗我们。我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们以及我们的生活方式本身的破坏。\n\n$espionage.1081.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:338`

### English

Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered rumors that the §H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§! are plotting to deceive us. We have no exact details of their apparent scheme yet, but it seems set to try and undermine us and our way of life.\n\n$espionage.1081.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:376`

## espionage.1081.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1081.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然完全不清楚[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]是如何获知这些情报的。不过我们的特工追踪可疑的[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj]特工的努力似乎已经有了回报。但如果这些情报是真的，[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]可能只是艰辛地为我们收集了该情报。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:339`

### English

Quite how this information came to be known by the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] is unclear. Our own operatives' efforts to tail suspected [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj] intelligence operatives seem to have paid off, though. If this intelligence is genuine, the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] may just have done the hard work of gathering it for us.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:377`

## espionage.1081.desc.samecountry

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1081.desc.samecountry&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工获悉了一些可靠的传闻，当地有针对我们的阴谋。似乎他们§H[insidious_plot_country.GetAdj]§!特工对于自身特工行为的保密性不太重视。\n\n我们尚未掌握该暴露阴谋的具体细节，但据说其中涉及对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:340`

### English

Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered credible rumors of a local plot against us. It seems their §H[insidious_plot_country.GetAdj]§! counterparts are somewhat careless about their own operational secrecy.\n\nWe have no exact details for their apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve a manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:378`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1082.desc&lang=en)

我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工发现了一些可疑的证据，其表明§H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§!意图在近期欺骗我们。\n\n$espionage.1082.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:343`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:381`

## espionage.1082.desc.samecountry

### 中文

我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工发现了一些可疑的证据，证据表明他们意图在近期对我们发起一次误导性的反制行动。\n\n$espionage.1082.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:344`

Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered suspect evidence that they mean to launch a deceptive counter-operation against us in the near future.\n\n$espionage.1082.outro$

## espionage.1082.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1082.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管该计划的细节尚不得而知，但据说其中涉及对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。$role_spymaster$[insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName]建议对这一情况保持谨慎，因为这些信息的获得过于容易，显得§P相当可疑§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:345`

### English

We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it looks to involve manipulating our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life. $role_spymaster$ [insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName] advises caution, however, as the ease by which we came across this information is §Pfairly suspect§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:383`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1085.name&lang=en)

卷入阴谋

### English

Implicated in a Plot

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:386`

## espionage.1085.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1085.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们被牵连进了一个针对§H[from.GetName]§!的阴谋中。这一指控是如此地含糊，以至于我们靠自己根本无从得知他们是否真的掌握了我们的把柄。\n\n我们自己的间谍抗议说，这一指控毫无根据，声称这可能是我们目标之一的防御性、反间谍行动，抑或是来自第三方的抹黑。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:349`

### English

We have been implicated in a plot against the §H[from.GetName]§!. So vague is the allegation that we cannot definitively state whether or not they are on to something.\n\nOur own spies protest that the allegation is baseless, claiming this is likely either a defensive, counter-espionage response from one of our targets - or else a smear campaign being conducted by some third party. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:387`

## espionage.1085.desc.neverspied

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aespionage.1085.desc.neverspied&lang=en)

### 中文

令人惊讶的是，我们被毫无来由地指控参与到针对§H[from.GetName]§!的阴谋中。这一指控十分荒谬，因为我们近来委实未曾发起对外的间谍活动——但另一方面，[from.GetAdj]根本不知道这一指控有多荒谬。\n\n似乎不明身份的人在试图陷害我们，从而为他们自己的不轨行为开脱——抑或是单纯为了制造外交混乱。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:350`

### English

Amazingly, we have been implicated in some vaguely-defined plot against the §H[from.GetName]§!. It's a ridiculous allegation, given our complete lack of foreign espionage activity so far - but then, the [from.GetAdj] would have no way of knowing how truly ridiculous the allegation is.\n\nIt would seem that parties unknown are attempting to frame us for their own misdemeanors - or perhaps simply to sow some diplomatic chaos. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:388`

## operation.1006.desc.celebrity

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.1006.desc.celebrity&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.1006.desc.intro$我们的间谍网现在已能接触到§H一位在[from.target.GetAdj]文化界有影响力的人物§!，我们可以将他们想维持公众形象的需求和我们所拥有的雄心壮志相结合，以此来暗中对其心智与思维施加影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:364`

### English

$operation.1006.desc.intro$ Our Spy Network now has access to §Han influential figure within [from.target.GetAdj] culture§!, whose desire to maintain their public profile pairs splendidly with ambitions we may wish to wield, to manipulate hearts and minds.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:404`

## operation.1006.desc.official

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.1006.desc.official&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.1006.desc.intro$我们已经确保了同§H一位[from.target.GetAdj]政府高层官员§!联络的通路。这位线人已经被保护起来，同时蓄势待发，做好了在未来行动中协助我们的准备，尤其是当我们遇到外交或是政府层面的问题时。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:365`

### English

$operation.1006.desc.intro$ We have secured access to §Han official within the [from.target.GetAdj] civic hierarchy§!. This Asset will be kept secure but poised, ready to assist us with future operations - particularly when we might brush up against diplomatic or governmental issues.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:405`

$operation.1006.desc.intro$我们的间谍网现在能支持我们接触到§H一位有影响力的[from.target.GetAdj]专家§!，其已准备好协助我们的行动，该线人的人脉网络及其声誉将有利于行动的开展。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:366`

### English

$operation.1006.desc.intro$ Our Spy Network is now bolstered by access to §Han influential [from.target.GetAdj] professional§!, ready to assist us with operations which may benefit from the Asset's own network contacts, or the weight of their reputation.

$operation.1006.desc.intro$我们已经控制了§H[from.target.GetName]实体的一部分§!，这一异常无人机使我们得以接入其中央主控智能并发动直接而毁灭性的打击。

我们的特工分散在[root.target.GetName]为造福他们自己的公民而运行的各种科学宣传计划中。我们的行动目的就是想对这些计划有所了解。

## operation.1020.desc.enigmatic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.1020.desc.enigmatic&lang=en)

### 中文

$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告称，我们特工的行动遇到了不可逾越的障碍：[target.GetAdj]的工程技术突飞猛进，远远甩开了我们。\n\n任何可能从他们那里窃取的技术都已变得§H浑不可解§!——且与我们现有的技术体系不兼容。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:382`

$role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our operatives have met an insurmountable obstacle: [target.GetAdj] engineering appears to have advanced and deviated far from our own.\n\nAny technology we might hope to steal from them would be §Hinscrutable§! to us - as well as incompatible with what we currently possess.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:423`

### 中文

### English

$operation.1026.desc.intro$\n\nA single operative hid within the §Hgoods entrance§! of a remote research facility, waiting to be couriered past a number of clearly-inadequate [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security measures. An unwitting [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesAdj] has placed our operative within easy reach of a terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository.\n\n$operation.2016.desc.outro.smooth$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:434`

## operation.1027.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.1027.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]提交了一份报告，事关§H[from.target.GetName]§!境内的[from.GetName]行动。似乎看上去[from.target.GetAdj]的科学和工程学已经先进到了可以欺瞒我方最专业的特工的地步了。他们宣称其内部技术和我们自己的科技截然不同，即使我们设法偷到了一两项科技，仿制出来的硬件也无法和我们自己的兼容\n\n$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]建议我们去其他的地方再窃取类似的秘密。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:412`

### English

$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has submitted a report on Operation [from.GetName], inside the §H[from.target.GetName]§!. It seems that [from.target.GetAdj] science and engineering have advanced to the point of bamboozling our expert operatives. They claim that the underlying technology has deviated greatly from our own, meaning that even if we could somehow steal their research, the resulting hardware would be incompatible with ours.\n\n$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] suggests that we appropriate such secrets elsewhere.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:453`

## operation.1030.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.1030.name&lang=en)

### 中文

研究被破坏！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:413`

### English

Research Sabotaged!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:454`

## operation.1030.desc.regular

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.1030.desc.regular&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的研究网络已经被破坏！一个不知名的渗透者已经混淆了相当数量的数据库，§H偷窃研究成果§!为他们所用，§H正在进行的研究§!已经陷入瘫痪。\n\n我们的团队已经尽快开始使用备用系统，但这将会显著拖慢他们的进度。我们预计需要几个月的时间，我们才能利用已保存的纸面材料，重新整合研究开发进度。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:414`

### English

Our research networks have been compromised! An unknown infiltrator has upended many of our data libraries, §Hstealing research§! for their own use and causing significant delays to our §Hongoing studies§!.\n\nOur teams were able to switch to backup systems quite rapidly, but this will slow their progress. It's estimated that months may pass before we're able to re-integrate our research & development processes with the existing corpus.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:455`

## operation.1030.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.1030.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的研究网络已经被破坏！一个不知名的渗透者已经混淆了相当数量的数据库，§H偷窃研究成果§!为他们所用，§H正在进行的研究§!已经陷入瘫痪。\n\n我们已经尽快开始使用备用系统，但这将会显著拖慢进度。我们需要几个月的时间才能利用已恢复的研究数据集来重新整合研究开发进度。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:415`

### English

Our research networks have been compromised! An unknown entity has infiltrated our data media, §Hstealing research§! for their own use and causing significant disruption to our §Hongoing studies§!.\n\nWe were able to engage backup systems quite rapidly, but our progress from here will be slowed down. Months may pass before we're able to smoothly re-integrate research & development with our existing research libraries.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:456`

## operation.2000.desc.cargo

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2000.desc.cargo&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$它的货架上装满了对[target.owner.GetAdj]的扫描器会显示为$rare_crystals$和其他珍贵矿物的物件。我们相信，最简单直白的策略能够达到最好的障眼法效果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:422`

### English

$operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$ Its hold is packed with what will appear to [target.owner.GetAdj] scanners as $rare_crystals$ and other precious minerals. We trust that the bare-faced simplicity of this strategy will serve as its own bluff.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:464`

## operation.2000.desc.derelict

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2000.desc.derelict&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$这艘舰船在接近[target.owner.GetAdj]国境的时候被安排了一场非致命性的爆炸，使得其尽可能接近§H[target.solar_system.GetName]§!星系。辐射将会倾泻出来充满了整个船舱内部，这样我们的特工就能秘密隐藏在它不可见的受保护核心中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:423`

### English

$operation.2000.desc.intro.hostile$ The ship is rigged for a non-lethal explosion as it approaches the [target.owner.GetAdj] border - as close as it can get to the §H[target.solar_system.GetName] system§!. Radiation will appear to flood the interior of the vessel as our operatives secrete themselves within its invisibly-shielded core.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:465`

## operation.2001.desc.vocation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2001.desc.vocation&lang=en)

### 中文

我方的数名特工已经被允许登陆§H[target.GetName]§!设施。其他未获得授权的特工则继续分散在邻近星系。在这里他们可以转换成备用的掩护身份以进一步支援整个行动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:426`

### English

A number of our operatives have been accepted aboard the §H[target.GetName] facility§!. Those who haven't been granted work there have dispersed to neighboring systems. There they will switch to backup cover identities and lend support to the overall operation.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:468`

## operation.2001.desc.vessel

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2001.desc.vessel&lang=en)

### 中文

对方已经上钩了，我们的特工已经“遁入黑暗”，进而在敌对设施内部展开工作。$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]将会等待进一步的讯息信号。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:427`

### English

The bait has been taken, and our operatives have 'gone dark' as they work to establish themselves within the hostile facility. $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] will await further signals from them.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:469`

## operation.2002.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2002.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

一段加密的信号自§Y[target.owner.GetName]§!传来，表明我们的特工现在已经准备就绪。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:429`

### English

A coded signal has arrived from within the §Y[target.owner.GetName]§!, indicating that our operatives now stand ready.

## operation.2002.desc.vocation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2002.desc.vocation&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.2002.desc.intro$\n\n他们的身份伪装已经深入到了一定程度，我们的特工事实上已经和那里的人员打成一片。通过友情聚餐、共享娱乐，以及日常社交活动，他们在§H[target.GetName]设施§!获得了不少能用于进入核心系统的线索。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:430`

### English

$operation.2002.desc.intro$\n\nThey have worked their cover roles to such a degree, our operatives have actually developed a rapport with local personnel. A number of useful points of entry have been noted during friendly meals, shared entertainments and day-to-day socializing aboard the §H[target.GetName] facility§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:472`

## operation.2002.desc.vessel

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2002.desc.vessel&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:431`

### English

$operation.2002.desc.intro$ $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has made preparations to extract them where possible, however their chances are slim.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:473`

## operation.2005.desc.civic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2005.desc.civic&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系内的§H民用设施§!进行了一次成功的爆破。随后而来的混乱证明了我们目标的成功实现。\n\n$operation.2005.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:433`

### English

We have struck a a successful blow to §Hcivic infrastructure§! in the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. The ensuing chaos should serve our goals well.\n\n$operation.2005.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:475`

## operation.2005.desc.military

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2005.desc.military&lang=en)

### 中文

我们成功地破坏了[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施上面的§H军用支援结构§!。我们的特工报道了在他们的设备激活后，周边工作的人出现了少量的伤亡。\n\n我们发动的这次打击扰乱了§Y[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetName]§!的作战后勤，对方不会对其视而不见的。\n\n$operation.2005.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:434`

### English

We have successfully sabotaged a §Hmilitary support structure§! aboard the [sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility. Our operatives report minor casualties amongst those working nearby at the time their device activated.\n\nThis blow we've dealt to combat logistics within the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetName]§! will not go unnoticed by them.\n\n$operation.2005.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:476`

## operation.2005.desc.trade

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2005.desc.trade&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]星系及其周边的§H商业利益§!发动了一次打击。由于当地星系的交通控制者手忙脚乱地制定新的物流模式，贸易舰船已经堵塞了所有的运输航线。\n\n$operation.2005.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:435`

### English

We have struck a blow to §Hcommercial interests§! in and around the [sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system. Trading vessels are already clogging up the shipping lanes as local space traffic controllers scramble to draw up new holding patterns.\n\n$operation.2005.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:477`

## operation.2005.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2005.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们现在必须考虑能否为我们的行动开脱。在未来任何针对[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]空间的行动都需要我们尽可能地维持掩护——也就是说，我们要把慎重放在第一要位……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:436`

### English

We must now consider the deniability of our own actions. Any future operations in [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] space will require us to maintain as much cover as we can - that is, assuming we wish to prioritize such discretion...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:478`

## operation.2006.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2006.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告道，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的特工小队必须放弃目前打算破坏§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!位于§H[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]星系目标§!的计划。[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]内部发生了急剧的变化，我们之前的准备工作成为了赘余。我们应该明智地挑选一个不同的目标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:444`

### English

$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] team of operatives must abandon their efforts to sabotage §H[sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj]§! in the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName] system§!. Drastic changes to the [sabotaged_starbase_owner.GetAdj] interior have made our efforts so far redundant. We would be wise to choose a different target.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:486`

## operation.2010.desc.phobe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2010.desc.phobe&lang=en)

### 中文

入侵者们已经越过了我们在§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!星系的边境，并破坏了§H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]§!设施的一部分。这些破坏分子显然是在为某个外国势力卖命；我们的反间谍部队必须提高警戒并尝试抓住这些特工。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:446`

### English

Intruders have violated our borders in the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§! system, wrecking part of the §H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility§!. These saboteurs appear to have been acting on behalf of a foreign power; our counter-espionage forces are on high alert to try and capture these operatives.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:488`

## operation.2010.desc.regular

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2010.desc.regular&lang=en)

### 中文

未知的破坏分子在§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!星系发动了袭击，破坏了§H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施§!的部分功能。\n\n我们的反间谍部门推断这是外国势力从中作梗而不是本国的威胁。我们已经提高了受影响宇域的安全等级，希望能够擒拿这些特工。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:447`

### English

Unknown saboteurs have struck at the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§! system, wrecking part of the §H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility§!.\n\nOur counter-espionage service suggests this is likely the work of foreign actors, rather than any home-grown threat. We have increased security around the affected region of space in the hopes of capturing these operatives.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:489`

## operation.2010.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.2010.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

一个外国实体突破了我们位于§Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§!星系的边境，放肆地扰乱了§H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName]设施§!的平稳运行。我们暂时无法确信这些破坏分子是如何如此有效地进入我国国界，但是我们提高了内部的安全级别以直接应对这次威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:448`

### English

A foreign entity has breached our borders in the §Y[sabotaged_starbase_system.GetName]§! system and has wantonly disrupted the smooth running of §H[sabotaged_starbase.GetName] facility§!. We cannot yet ascertain how these saboteurs gained entry so effectively, however we have increased our internal security in direct response.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:490`

## operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.3001.desc.spirit.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

由$role_spymaster$[Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队会开展工作，放大[root.target.GetName]内部的宗教偏狭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:459`

### English

The team under $role_spymaster$ [Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName] will work to exaggerate religious intolerance amongst the [root.target.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:502`

## operation.3001.desc.spirit.ridic

## operation.3001.desc.spirit.merch

### 中文

$operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$如果他们被抓到兜售廉价、渎神的圣像，而[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]恰好将视其为神明，那么……

## operation.3001.desc.spirit.deity

$operation.3001.desc.spirit.intro$我们会伪造一场[root.target.GetAdj]运动，目标直指那些[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]内非祭司阶层的人。要想扰乱宗教教团的政治，就得攻击那些负责运作的人。

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:505`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.3010.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们现在面临着一个选择：把我们所知道的关于这一骗术的零星信息通告给[smear_campaign_target.GetName]；或者保持沉默，相信我们对付敌对间谍的能力。即使我们掩盖了我们能力的真实水平，我们还是可以把这个可疑的敌人引出来——但前提是我们根据他们提供的信息采取行动，就好像它们是真的一样。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:520`

### English

We now face a choice: expose what little we know about this deception to the [smear_campaign_target.GetName], or else keep quiet about our ability to cope with hostile espionage. Even if we do mask the true extent of our abilities, we may still draw this shady enemy out - but only if we act upon the information they've supplied as though it were genuine.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:563`

## operation.3011.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.3011.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.3010.desc.intro$我们在加密工作中已经标记了一系列奇怪且难以溯源的信息。这中间包含了一堆诽谤我们的黑材料，据说是我们的[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]邻居写的——但经过核对确认之后，我们发现这实际上是第三方精心伪造的。\n\n$operation.3010.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:525`

### English

$operation.3010.desc.intro$ Our Encryption protocols have flagged a series of strange and almost-anonymous messages. They comprise a dossier of slander against us, supposedly authored by our [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] neighbors - but the assertions are, in fact, elaborate fakes.\n\n$operation.3010.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:568`

## operation.3012.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.3012.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.3010.desc.intro$我们仔细审查了近来一条源头“不明”的信息，该信息意图揭露一项[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]针对我们的阴谋的细节——该阴谋事实上是完全凭空捏造的。我们的加密协议已经被证明是十分有效的，并揭露了一个[from.GetAdj]的阴谋。\n\n$operation.3010.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:527`

### English

$operation.3010.desc.intro$ We scrutinized a recent communication from an 'anonymous' source, whose intent was to expose an elaborate [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] scheme against us - only it is, in fact, a complete fabrication. Our Encryption protocols have proven resilient, and reveal a [from.GetAdj] plot beneath.\n\n$operation.3010.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:570`

## operation.3020.desc.espionage

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.3020.desc.espionage&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§!向我们提交了一份档案，在其中详尽阐述了复杂的间谍指控，意在挑拨离间。似乎§H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!希望在我们之间散布不信任。\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:529`

### English

The §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§! have delivered a dossier to us, detailing complex allegations of espionage which were intended to drive a wedge between our two empires. It seems the §H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§! wish to sow distrust between us.\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:572`

## operation.3020.desc.insult

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.3020.desc.insult&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§!向我们提交了一份措辞巧妙的档案，提及§H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!，声称其意图对我们不利。若这份[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]文件可信，则说明[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]意图以我们的名义散布谣言以破坏我们与[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的关系。\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:530`

### English

The §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§! have approached us with a delicately-worded dossier on the §H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!, who seem to wish us ill. If the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] files are to be believed, the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName] intended to damage any relationship between us and the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] by seeding slanderous lies in our name.\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:573`

## operation.3020.desc.deception

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.3020.desc.deception&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§!向我们提交了一份档案，揭露了一个精心策划的阴谋，有人企图在我们两个帝国之间制造裂痕。§H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§!很有可能就是罪魁祸首。\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:531`

### English

The §Y[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]§! has delivered a dossier to us, exposing an elaborate plot which was intended to drive a wedge between our two empires. The §H[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]§! are named as its would-be perpetrators.\n\n$operation.3020.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:574`

## operation.3020.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.3020.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然[smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj]行动是隐秘进行的，但依然不是[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]编码手段的对手。他们最终选择不再保留这些秘密，而是向我们公开他们的档案。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:532`

### English

Although the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj] operation was carried out in secrecy, it was apparently no match for [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] Encryption. Instead of keeping that knowledge to themselves, they have chosen to open their files to us.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:575`

## operation.4000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组。所有人员都将作为独狼参与其中，并已经做好了单程票的准备。他们现在只等一个目标-一个值得将其引向§H[target.GetName]§!重大灾难。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:536`

### English

$role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives. Those involved will work alone, and are prepared for the fact this will almost certainly be a one-way trip. All they need now is a target - a worthy catastrophe to draw towards the §H[target.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:580`

## operation.4000.desc.single

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4000.desc.single&lang=en)

$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组，他们将设法把§P[crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName]§!引诱至§H[target.GetAdj]§!领土上。预计将全队覆灭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:537`

### English

$role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives who will seek to lure the §P[crisis_beacon_option_1.GetName]§! directly into §H[target.GetAdj]§! territory. The team is not expected to return.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:581`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:538`

### English

$role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that at this time, §Yno crisis-level threats§! are likely to be lured in by such an operation. The operatives [spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] assembled will remain on standby until we know more about the catastrophic threats lurking in this galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:582`

## operation.4001.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4001.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的研究员与特工们已准备好应对各种任务突发变数，特遣队也已前往§Y[target.GetAdj]§!与§P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!之间的未知区域。

### English

Our researchers and operatives have prepared for a wide variety of mission variables, and the task team has departed for an uncharted region of space between §Y[target.GetAdj] territory§! and the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!.

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4002.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在§H[target.GetName]§!附近的特工们发出了一条单方面通讯：他们已经准备好继续执行任务，一但我们发出指令，他们就将去触怒§P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!。

### English

Our operatives near the §H[target.GetName]§! have sent a one-time communiqué: they are ready to proceed, and will draw the ire of the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§! upon our signal.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:589`

[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]已上钩

### English

## operation.4005.desc.contingency

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4005.desc.contingency&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的研究者只能假设我方特工迅速而见机行事的思路奏了效，因为他们成功地引诱了一艘来自$CRISIS_TYPE_CONTINGENCY$威胁的舰队。无论是通过精妙的骇入协议，亦或是通过伪造某种形式的漏洞超载，我们的遥测扫描已经确认§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!之间传来了敌对的信号传输。\n\n无论§Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!在这个纷乱的时间点是否还有其他的顾虑：我们的行动保证他们至少又多了一件事可以操碎他们的心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:547`

### English

Our researchers can only speculate upon the quick and adaptive thinking employed by our operatives when they successfully lured a fleet from the ongoing $CRISIS_TYPE_CONTINGENCY$ threat. Whether by an elaborate protocol hacking or by fabricating some sort of loophole override, our remote scans now confirm a hostile presence in transit between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!.\n\nWhether or not the §Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§! have other ongoing concerns during these turbulent times: our actions have ensured they shall have at least one more pressing matter to attend to.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:591`

## operation.4005.desc.graytempest

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4005.desc.graytempest&lang=en)

### 中文

吸引这个所谓的§P灰蛊风暴§!这样零散的实体的注意力，并不是什么难事。我们的特工成功地通过一个单发的、调制的载波成功地把灰蛊风暴指向了§H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!。\n\n构建这个波充满挑战，因为§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]的首都之间距离很长，使得§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!需要前所未有的能量维持。我们的团队采用了在一个远程发射器的电源组中触发一个不可控的连锁反应。该装置保持在一起的时间刚好足以将我们的诱饵传送到超空间。\n\n长距离遥测显示纳米虫群正向着§Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!前进。我们的研究人员还注意到在[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]附近发生了灾难性爆炸，这应该是我们的那位特工的功劳。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:548`

### English

Drawing the focused attention of entities as piecemeal as this so-called §PGray Tempest§! was no mean feat. Our operatives succeeded by way of a one-shot, modulating carrier wave pointed squarely in the direction of the §H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!.\n\nConstructing this wave was a fraught effort, as the distance between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§! requires an unprecedented amount of energy. Our team resorted to triggering an uncontrollable chain reaction in the power banks of a long-range transmitter. The device held together just long enough to beam our lure across hyperspace.\n\nLong-distance telemetry suggests that a Nanite Swarm is now making its way towards the §Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!. Our researchers also note readings of a catastrophic explosion in the vicinity of [crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] - believed to be the site of our operatives' fatal endeavor.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:592`

## operation.4005.desc.marauders

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4005.desc.marauders&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管他们最近表现得很团结，§P[raider_khanate.GetName]§!最后还是证明了自己只是头脑简单的猎捕者，轻易就被愤怒钓上了钩。我们的小队想方设法激怒了某位指挥官，后者正甚嚣尘上地以超光速杀向[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]的首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!。\n\n我们的特工很确信任何倒霉到竖立在§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]之间的恒星基地都会作为东道主给这支掠夺者小分队表演一下什么叫做热锅上的蚂蚁。让我们希望这次牺牲没有白费。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:549`

### English

Despite their recent attempts at unity, §Pthe [raider_khanate.GetName]§! have proven an uncomplicated prey to bait in anger. Our team worked hard to antagonize one Commander in particular, whose boiling rage is now being directed at faster-than-light speeds toward the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!.\n\nOur operatives are resolute that any starbase unfortunate enough to lie between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName] will play chaotic host to this small band of marauders. Let us hope this sacrifice is not in vain.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:593`

## operation.4005.desc.swarm

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4005.desc.swarm&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对§P$CRISIS_TYPE_PRETHORYN$§!的生物引擎研究的时间虽然不长，但是被证明十分有效。我们发明了一种合成化合物——生产起来很昂贵，运输起来也很困难——但是能够成功诱使一支舰队偏离虫群。\n\n这种化合物的附着性是如此之强，我方特工的命运现在就和竖在§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!和[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!之间的恒星基地一样惨烈。一旦我方特工释放这种诱骗性的化合物，他们的命就没了。\n\n相比于四散而逃并搅乱虫群的路线，我们的小队决定花费剩余的时间确保没有留下任何行动的痕迹。§H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§!很快就会尝到我们的牺牲带来的后果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:550`

### English

Our research into the biological drives of the §P$CRISIS_TYPE_PRETHORYN$§! was conducted swiftly, but has proven effective. We devised a synthetic compound - expensive to produce, and dangerous to transport - which has succeeded in luring a fleet away from the Swarm.\n\nSo adhesive is this compound that the fate of our operatives is now as bleak as that of any starbase which lies between the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§! and the [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!. The moment our operatives released the beguiling chemical, their fate was sealed.\n\nRather than flee and risk confusing the swarm's route, our team will instead spend what remaining time they have ensuring that the trail remains intact. The §H[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetName]§! will soon experience the results of our sacrifice.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:594`

## operation.4005.desc.unbidden

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4005.desc.unbidden&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对抗§P$CRISIS_TYPE_UNBIDDEN$§!的努力终于有了成果，尽管代价十分的惨重。我们的特工成功地诱使一支异次元舰队认为他们在[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]领土腹地的一个次元锚正处于威胁。舰队现在正从§Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]星系§!向§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!开拔。\n\n$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]会继续监视这一形势，但是看样子我们是没法见到我们的特工活着返回了。我们必须密切关注，并相信我们的诱敌方案有利于我们的计划。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:551`

### English

Our efforts against the §P$CRISIS_TYPE_UNBIDDEN$§! have paid off, though the cost was certainly steep. Our operatives have successfully duped an extra-dimensional fleet into thinking one of their dimensional anchors is under threat, deep inside [crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] territory. Ships are now en route to §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§! from the §Y[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName] system§!.\n\n$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] will continue to monitor the situation, but it is unlikely we will see our operatives returned to us. We must now watch, and trust that our lure serves our plan.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:595`

## operation.4005.a.tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4005.a.tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

§P[crisis_beacon_crisis_fleet.GetName]§!现在正位于前往§Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj]首都§!的路线上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:552`

### English

The §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_fleet.GetName]§! is now en route to the §Y[crisis_beacon_target_country.GetAdj] capital§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:597`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4010.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[crisis_beacon_crisis_fleet.GetName]朝[root.capital_scope.GetName]行动

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:553`

### English

[crisis_beacon_crisis_fleet.GetName] on Course for [root.capital_scope.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:598`

## operation.4010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.4010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们探测到了来自§P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!的敌对信号，正朝着我们的首都§Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!笔直地杀过来！奇怪的能量波动从§H[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]§!的附近爆发，我们猜测这是他们的源头。\n\n当这个区域的能量信号突然发生变化时，我们才刚刚开始分析这一现象。所有的信号都显示这是舰队移动突然发生了改变。此外，中间至少有一个能量信号看上去不属于[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]。无论他们是谁，看上去正是他们导致了这样的行为。我们怀疑这是我们的某个星系对手搞得§H祸水东引§!动作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:554`

### English

We detect a hostile presence from the §P[crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]§!, heading straight for our capital, §Y[crisis_beacon_target_capital.GetName]§!! Strange energy waves have burst out from the vicinity of §H[crisis_beacon_crisis_system.GetName]§!, their assumed origin.\n\nWe had just begun the work of analyzing this phenomenon when energy signatures in the region abruptly changed. All signs suggest this means a sudden change of fleet movements. Furthermore, at least one of those energy signatures looks to belong to an empire other than the [crisis_beacon_crisis_country.GetName]. Whoever they are, they appear to be the cause of this behavior. We suspect this to be §Hprovocative action§! by one of our galactic rivals.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:599`

## operation.5000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们失去了活跃于§H[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]§!上的[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]特工的联系。他们已经错过了最近的几次约定的汇报时间。\n\n按照标准程序，我们现在需要决定是否去追踪他们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:559`

### English

$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having lost contact with [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] operatives on active deployment in the §H[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]§!. They have missed a number of their most recent, scheduled check-ins.\n\nIn accordance with standard procedure, we must now decide whether or not to track down our own operatives.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:606`

## operation.5001.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5001.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的努力奏效了——同我方特工的联络恢复了。$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经开始着手审核[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]为了在§H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!经营而布置好的监视流程。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:565`

### English

Our efforts proved successful - contact with our operatives has been restored. $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is already working to review the monitoring procedures [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] in place for work in the §H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:612`

## operation.5002.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5002.name&lang=en)

### 中文

联络人确认失踪

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:566`

### English

Contact Confirmed Lost

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:613`

## operation.5002.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5002.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们已经尽全力，但我们还是没法恢复与我们在§H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!的特工的通讯。$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经下达指令，对我们当地间谍网的监视流程进行一次评估；有可能[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的§H加密§!手段比我们估计的还要高明。\n\n于此同时，§H[fromfrom.GetName]行动§!将以未达到全力的情况下恢复，直到我们补充了损失的部分。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:567`

### English

Despite our best efforts, we cannot restore contact with our operatives in the §H[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!. $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has ordered a review of monitoring procedures for our Spy Network there; it is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] have more sophisticated §HEncryption§! than we had thought.\n\nMeanwhile, §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§! will resume at a reduced capacity while we recoup our losses.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:614`

## operation.5005.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5005.name&lang=en)

### 中文

特工受惊

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:568`

### English

Operative Spooked

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:616`

## operation.5005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管已经像训练时那样准备了所有的预防措施，位于§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的一名我方特工还是提出了对于他们的伪装的担心。特别是在§H[from.GetName]§!行动的关键时刻，决不能暴露出来——因此，$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]请求投入更多资源来使得[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]避免未来的意外发生。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:569`

### English

Despite having taken every precaution prescribed in their training, one of our operatives in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has raised concerns that their cover may be blown. Apparently this comes at a critical time for §HOperation [from.GetName]§! - as such, $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] requests more resources with which [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] might prevent disruptions further down the line.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:617`

## operation.5010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[from.target.GetName]§!刚刚注意到了我方存在，并引起了警觉。看上去我们对当地的情报了解不足，我们的特工已经引起了当地[patrol_drone.GetNamePlural]的注意。\n\n这次§H[from.GetName]行动§!还是有机会挽回的，但是需要立马对$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]进行援助。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:576`

### English

The §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has just been alerted to our presence. It seems we lacked sufficient intelligence on the local area, and our operatives have earned the attention of local [patrol_drone.GetNamePlural].\n\n§HOperation [from.GetName]§! is not truly jeopardized yet, but $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] requires speedy assistance.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:625`

We must trust in diplomacy.

## operation.5011.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5011.name&lang=en)

### 中文

外交解决方案

### English

A Diplomatic Solution

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:628`

## operation.5011.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5011.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]和[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的同事们消除了因我们特工入侵§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!产生的尴尬。\n\n有可能私下里，[fromfrom.target.GetName]依然将我们的正当理由视作一通子鬼话。但只要双方还在意面子：我们的身份就会被视作是“清白”的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:580`

### English

$role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] and [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] colleagues have smoothed over our operatives' awkward intrusion into the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.\n\nIt's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] sees our excuses for the pack of lies they are. As far as outward appearances are concerned, however: we are considered to be 'in the clear'.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:629`

## operation.5011.desc.hive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5011.desc.hive&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经通过外交斡旋解决了我们侵入§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!所引起的一些外交误会。\n\n有可能私下里，[fromfrom.target.GetName]依然将我们的正当理由视作一通子鬼话。但只要双方还在意面子：我们的身份就会被视作是“清白”的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:581`

### English

We have successfully negotiated our way out of the diplomatically awkward intrusion into the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!.\n\nIt's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] does not lend any credibility to our excuses at all, but from an outside perspective: we are considered to be 'in the clear' for now.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:630`

## operation.5015.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5015.name&lang=en)

### 中文

多相力场

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:582`

### English

Multi-Phasic Force Fields

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:632`

## operation.5015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当特工在稳步进入§H[from.target.GetName]§!更加戒备森严的区域时，我们失去了与其的联系。我们搞不好会全部交代在这里。这样的信号中断可能是马虎的[from.target.GetAdj]启动了屏蔽科技，隔断了我们的噪声干涉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:583`

### English

We are losing contact with our operatives as they enter steadily more secure areas in the §H[from.target.GetName]§!. There is a chance we could lose our presence there altogether. These interruptions are likely caused by sloppy [from.target.GetAdj] shielding technology putting out noisy interference.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:633`

## operation.5016.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5016.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们失去了指派给对于§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!的§H[fromfrom.GetName]行动§!中所有人员的联系。无论是被我们的目标算计，还是单纯遇到了不幸的巧合，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的屏蔽科技都是一个相当棘手的对手。\n\n[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName]在这场事件中存在获得收益的可能性。尽管我们的特工[GetOperativesLowerPlural]能够做到半自主，但是没有了我们的出面引导，这些子个体可能会更加容易落到敌人手中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:588`

### English

We have lost all contact with our operatives assigned to §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§! in the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!. Whether by our target's cunning design, or simply an unlucky coincidence for us, [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] shielding technology has proven a worthy adversary us.\n\nIt is possible the [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName] may gain from this incident. Although our [GetOperativesLowerPlural] may operate semi-autonomously, without our presence they are still far more vulnerable to enemy capture.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:638`

### English

This particular [from.target.GetSpeciesName] [from.target.GetIndividualName] seems to instinctively regard anything other than itself as a source of potential nutrition.

## operation.5035.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5035.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们位于§Y[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!附近的特工小队已经错过了几个检查点。考虑到这次行动的性质，我们预料到他们不能维持频繁的联系。然而，虽然感到遗憾，我们的$role_spymaster$坚信这支小队是失踪了。\n\n如果我们能够成功地掩盖痕迹，§H[from.GetName]行动§!可能被挽救。我们得发挥我们的§H$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§!对抗[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]的§H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!的优势。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:617`

### English

$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our team of operatives near the §Y[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has missed a number of checkpoints. Given the nature of this operation, we had already anticipated them being unable to maintain frequent contact. However, our $role_spymaster$ is regrettably confident that by now, the team has been lost.\n\n§HOperation [from.GetName]§! may be rescued if we can successfully cover our tracks, pitting our §H$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§! against [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] §H$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:671`

潜伏成功

### English

Successful Cover-Up
