## operation.5036.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5036.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管耗费了大量人力物力，消耗了许多$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在§H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!积累的成果，我们终于确保了行动的安全性。所有松动的口子都被堵上；所有掩护身份都被抛弃掉。一支全新的特工队伍将替代原来的人员，在我们的$role_spymaster$亲自注视下执行着完全不同指令。\n\n与此同时，[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]依然没有注意到我方的存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:623`

### English

Though it has greatly taxed the resources of $role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]'s work in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!, operational security has been reasserted. All loose ends have been covered; all cover identities discarded. A new team of operatives will take over from here, enacting a subtly different set of orders under our $role_spymaster$'s watchful gaze.\n\nThe [snuffedout_country.GetAdj], meanwhile, still seem oblivious to our presence.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:677`

## operation.5037.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5037.name&lang=en)

### 中文

行动暴露

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:624`

### English

Operation Exposed

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:678`

## operation.5037.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5037.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们最担心的事情成了真：我们最近在§H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!失去的特工曝光了我们大部分§H[fromfrom.GetName]行动§!的细节。\n\n我们的全部间谍网都经过了妥善安排，确保在正常情况下，只有极其不周密的证据才会追溯到我们执行的隐秘行动。然而，在当下的情况，我们完全无法确认何种情报已经泄露；也没法知道[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]打算如何进行回应。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:625`

### English

Our worst fears have come to pass: the recent loss of our operatives in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has exposed large parts of §HOperation [fromfrom.GetName]§!.\n\nAll our Spy Networks are carefully arranged so that under normal circumstances, only very flimsy evidence could ever implicate us in the covert activities we carry out. However, in this instance we cannot be entirely sure what Intel may have been given away; nor can we know how the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] might choose to respond.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:679`

## operation.5037.desc.provocation

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5037.desc.provocation&lang=en)

### 中文

我们最近在§H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§!损失的特工酿成了严重的后果：我方的整个行动被暴露了。\n\n我们的间谍网处于妥善管理的状态，保证正常情况下，能够为我方特工提供一定的匿名性。然而，在当下的情况，我方的任何行动都会导致严重后果，因为各类证据会导向我们，而[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]绝不会对此坐视不管。我们不知道他们会如何回应，得我们应该做好最坏的打算。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:626`

### English

The recent loss of our operatives in the §H[snuffedout_country.GetName]§! has had some dire consequences: our entire operation has been exposed.\n\nOur Spy Networks are carefully managed so that under normal circumstances, they afford us some level of deniability. However, on this occasion our actions were serious enough that the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] are unlikely to ignore even circumstantial evidence which may lead back to us. We do not know precisely how they will respond, but we should prepare for the worst.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:680`

## operation.5040.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5040.name&lang=en)

### 中文

资源耗尽

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:627`

### English

Drain on Resources

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:682`

## operation.5040.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5040.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最近$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在察觉到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!上的特工表现失常后对[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]发起了一场调查。\n\n[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap][from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave]这才发现这些特工对用于情报搜集与贿赂的资源雁过拔毛。他们将这些物资与货币投资到了[from.target.GetAdj]上的生意场上以损公肥私。因此，他们的追求与忠诚背道而驰。\n\n在$role_spymaster$[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]重整部门风气前，有关§H行动[from.GetName]§!的一切项目均被暂时搁置。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:628`

### English

$role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] recently launched a quiet investigation into [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] own operatives in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, after noticing a recent drop in their performance.\n\n[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap] [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave] discovered these operatives skimming from resources allocated to intelligence-gathering and bribes. These goods and currencies are being re-invested elsewhere in [from.target.GetAdj] business concerns, earning the operatives a comfortable profit at our expense. As a result, their attention and loyalties have clearly become divided.\n\nProgress on §HOperation [from.GetName]§! has been put on hold for the moment, until $role_spymaster$ [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] can re-assert operational efficiency.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:683`

## operation.5041.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5041.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们位于§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!上的特工不再使用我们间谍网的资源。对效忠对象的坚定提醒，重新激发了特工们的奉献精神；他们将把他们的聪明才智完全用于我们的事业。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:635`

### English

Our operatives in the §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§! are no longer skimming resources from our Spy Network allocation. Firm reminders of just where their loyalties lie have reinvigorated the operatives' sense of dedication; they will turn their resourceful talents wholly to our cause.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:690`

## operation.5042.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5042.name&lang=en)

### 中文

特工断绝关系

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:636`

### English

Operatives Cut Ties

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:691`

## operation.5042.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5042.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$role_spymaster$[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]遗憾的报告：我们失去了§Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§!上的间谍网。\n\n当我们特工中的一群小偷被要求解释原因时，他们的反应是逃跑——分散到[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]的宇域里，那些甚至连我们都难以监控的地方。[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]不再能够追踪他们——至少没法在不引发注意的情况下找到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:637`

### English

$role_spymaster$ [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] regretfully reports a breakdown in our §Y[fromfrom.target.GetName]§! Spy Network.\n\nWhen a group of thieves amongst our operatives was called to account, their response was to flee - scattering to parts of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] space that even we struggle to monitor. [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] is no longer able to track them down - at least not without drawing undue attention.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:692`

## operation.5045.name

### 中文

特工叛逃

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:638`

### English

Operative Defects

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:694`

## operation.5045.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5045.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们位于§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的$role_spymaster$，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]，向我们报告了在[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]内筛查特工项目上的惨痛失败。来自[from.target.GetAdj]首都的发言显示[root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle]已经选择§R叛逃§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:639`

### English

Our $role_spymaster$ in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName], reports a drastic failure in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] process for screening operatives. Word from the [from.target.GetAdj] capital is that [root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle] has chosen to §Rdefect§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:695`

## operation.5045.desc.culture

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5045.desc.culture&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.5045.desc.intro$\n\n看上去[root.GetOperativeRole]对于[from.target.GetName]的文化和主体物种生出了同情，而背离了我们。我们的审查机制本来应该排除掉这样的异样，但是这次却失败了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:640`

### English

$operation.5045.desc.intro$\n\nIt seems that the [root.GetOperativeRole] has grown more sympathetic towards the culture and founding ethics of the [from.target.GetName], in opposition to our own. Our screening process has failed in that it is supposed to rule out such flakiness.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:696`

## operation.5045.desc.turned

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5045.desc.turned&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.5045.desc.intro$\n\n尽管我们本应当通过审查排除掉组织里的不忠，但[root.GetOperativeRole]还是被“变节”了——或是通过反间谍行动，或是通过培养对[from.target.GetName]的同情意识，而我们之前并没有注意到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:641`

### English

$operation.5045.desc.intro$\n\nDespite the fact we are supposed to be able to screen out such disloyalty, the [root.GetOperativeRole] has been 'turned' - either by act of Counter-Espionage, or some innate sympathy towards [from.target.GetName] which we were unable to detect before.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:697`

## operation.5050.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5050.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

一位位于§Y[from.target.owner.GetName]§!的特工触发了安装在[from.target.GetName]恒星基地服务管道内的防篡改装置。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:648`

### English

An operative in the §Y[from.target.owner.GetName]§! has fallen foul of an anti-tampering device, installed in the service ducts of the [from.target.GetName] starbase.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:705`

## operation.5050.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5050.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\n他身受重伤，但还是勉力完成了任务，而且到目前为止仍未被发现。然而[from.target.owner.GetAdj]有关部门非常清楚，这起意外太不寻常，近乎可疑。讯问正在展开，我们特工呆在他们那疗伤越久就越容易暴露。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:649`

### English

$operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\nTheir injuries are severe, but our operative managed to complete their task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains in their medical care, the greater the risk our cover will be blown.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:706`

## operation.5050.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5050.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\n无人机遭受严重的损害，但依旧完成了任务并保持隐蔽状态。然而[from.target.owner.GetAdj]有关部门非常清楚，这起意外太不寻常，近乎可疑。讯问正在展开，我们的特工在对方的监察下越久，暴露的危险就越大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:650`

### English

$operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\nThe drone has sustained serious damage, but has completed its task and has maintained cover so far. It is clear to the [from.target.owner.GetAdj] authorities, however, that the incident was unusual, bordering on suspicious. Questions are being asked, and the longer our operative remains under their supervision, the greater the risk of exposure.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:707`

## operation.5050.desc.hostile

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5050.desc.hostile&lang=en)

### 中文

$operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\n他现在没法跑太远，除非我们在行动接下来的时间中给予除基本支援外的更多援助，这样他才能确保找到一个足够安全的藏身处。然而不久之后这片区域肯定会进行清理式扫荡。我们的特工呆在[from.target.owner.GetAdj]疆域下越久，暴露的危险就越大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:651`

### English

$operation.5050.desc.intro$\n\nThey are currently unable to move far or else lend more than basic support to the rest of the operation, so they have secured a reasonably safe hideout. There is, however, bound to be a maintenance sweep of the area before long. The longer our operative remains in [from.target.owner.GetAdj] care, the greater the risk of exposure.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:708`

## operation.5055.desc.regular

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5055.desc.regular&lang=en)

### 中文

一队位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工开始回避分配给他们的任务，并声称他们对目标总体而言缺乏信心。$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]通常会在不引起我们注意的情况下就处理好这些事情，但其实他自己并没有深入了解其中的细节：这些特工似乎对于§H[from.GetName]行动§!甚至是整个间谍网都过分了解。\n\n鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们那些更活跃的知情代理人保持着一定距离，[operation.leader.GetName]怀疑这些特工很有可能是从外界获取的信息。但[operation.leader.GetHeSheCap]同样也承认可能只是他们的洞察力过分敏锐罢了。\n\n$operation.5055.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:657`

### English

A group of auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! has begun shying away from their assigned tasks, citing a lack of confidence in their overall purpose. $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] would typically handle such matters without bringing them to our attention, but even without them knowing any details: these operatives seem unusually well-informed about §HOperation [from.GetName]§!, and perhaps the spy network as a whole.\n\nGiven that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active and better-informed agents, [operation.leader.GetName] suspects the operatives are being fed information from an outside source. [operation.leader.GetHeSheCap] also concede[operation.leader.GetSXX] that they may simply be highly perceptive individuals.\n\n$operation.5055.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:715`

## operation.5055.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5055.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

一组位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工在执行分配给它们的任务时进度开始滞后，并做出一些能被解析为怀疑的行动。我们通常直接命令$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]来解决此事，但这些特工表现得它们似乎能察觉到§H行动[from.GetName]§!中所埋藏的阴谋，也许还有整个间谍网也在它们的知情范围内。\n\n鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们更为活跃的代理个体保持隔离，我们怀疑有外部势力在向它们灌输信息。然而，如果可能的话，它们与自主代理个体的趋同或许能够赋予它们自己一种我们今后有机会将其利用到的洞察力。\n\n$operation.5055.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:658`

### English

A group of auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! has begun lagging in their assigned tasks, displaying behavior which could be interpreted as doubt. We would typically handle such matters directly through $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName], but this group acts as though it can perceive the wider machinations of §HOperation [from.GetName]§!, and perhaps the spy network as a whole.\n\nGiven that these auxiliaries are kept isolated from our more active agents, we suspect they are being fed information from an outside source. It is, however, also possible that their proximity to independent agents may simply have endowed these operatives with the kind of insight we may one day find useful.\n\n$operation.5055.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:716`

## operation.5055.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5055.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

基于以上怀疑，以及各种猜测对于[from.GetName]行动可能的威胁，$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]请求指示接下来该如何进行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:659`

### English

Given these doubts - and the threats posed to Operation [from.GetName] by each scenario - $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] requests a directive on how to proceed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:717`

## operation.5056.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5056.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工们在发现自己从前难以形容的怀疑并不是无中生有后，便以加倍的热情投入进工作中。$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]仍然对他们维持了严格的信息屏蔽，但报告称[operation.leader.GetHisHer]的运作变得前所未有的流畅。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:664`

### English

Our auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! have applied themselves with unusual fervor upon learning that their once-intangible suspicions were founded in a real cause after all. $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] maintains a strict information quarantine, but reports that [operation.leader.GetHisHer] supply lines have never been smoother.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:722`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:665`

### English

## operation.5057.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.5057.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在得知此前难以形容的怀疑并非无中生有后，我们位于§Y[target_country.GetName]§!的辅助性特工表现得惊惧起来。$role_spymaster$[operation.leader.GetName]仅仅只是向他们透露了些许关于全局的信息，就足以打乱行动的运作。现在我们破坏[target_country.GetAdj]$MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$的能力将在接下来的一段时间内下降。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:666`

### English

Our auxiliary operatives in the §Y[target_country.GetName]§! have reacted with horror upon learning the truth of their once-intangible suspicions. $role_spymaster$ [operation.leader.GetName] revealed only a glimpse of the bigger picture to them, but it was sufficient to disrupt our supply lines. Our ability to subvert [target_country.GetAdj] $MOD_INTEL_ENCRYPTION_ADD$ is reduced for a time.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:724`

## manifesti.1.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.1.name&lang=en)

### 中文

狂欢的反对派

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:670`

### English

Carnival Protestors

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:730`

## manifesti.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

第一次与外星物种接触后，人民日益焦虑于社会可能将发生剧变，导致[this.GetName]各地爆发出了游行示威。示威者质疑长久以来的传统，挑战治理的基础，并要求适应这一启示重塑的未来。\n\n尽管这些运动是非暴力的，但其规模却给公共服务带来了巨大压力，扰乱了日常生活。然而，许多公民并不认为这些抗议活动仅仅是骚乱而已。他们认为这是一种清算，表明我们正眼睁睁地见证自己的身份在被改写。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:671`

### English

Protests have erupted across [this.GetName], driven by a growing anxiety over the perceived transformation of our society following first contact with an alien species. Demonstrators question long-standing traditions, challenge the foundations of governance, and demand adaptations to accommodate a future reshaped by this revelation.\n\nThough non-violent, the sheer scale of these movements has placed a strain on civic services and disrupted daily life. However, many citizens do not see these protests as mere disorder. They see them as a reckoning, a sign that our very identity is being rewritten before our eyes.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:731`

## manifesti.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的示威来得快去得也快。现在许多人把矛头指向了§H宣泄派§!，这个以挑战社会规范的挑衅性作品而闻名的神秘团体。虽然他们的参与尚未得到证实，但他们最新的作品都集中在所谓的第一次接触的后果上，这加剧了争议和动荡。\n\n虽然示威已经结束，但是§H宣泄派§!依然存在。他们的信息广为流传、影响持久。现在是决定我们如何应对的时候了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:682`

### English

The protests on [Root.GetName] have ceased almost as suddenly as they began. Many now point to §HThe Manifesti§!, a shadowy collective known for provocative works that challenge societal norms. While their involvement remains unconfirmed, their latest projects have fixated on the alleged consequences of first contact, fueling both controversy and unrest.\n\nThough the demonstrations have ended, §HThe Manifesti§! remain. Their message spreads, their influence lingers. The time has come to decide how we respond.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:743`

防患于未然

### English

Nipped in the Bud

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:752`

## manifesti.10.desc_militarist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.10.desc_militarist&lang=en)

### 中文

§H宣泄派§!不会再给我们添麻烦了。快速而强硬的镇压粉碎了这场运动，使组织四分五裂，信息噤声。他们所谓的“艺术”也被取缔了，领袖消失不见。\n\n秩序恢复了，人们下次见到这种鲁莽的意识形态时会三思而后行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:692`

### English

§HThe Manifesti§! will trouble us no longer. A swift and decisive crackdown has dismantled their movement, scattering their members and silencing their message. Their so-called 'art' has been seized, their leaders disappeared.\n\nOrder is restored, and the people will think twice before embracing such reckless ideology again.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:753`

## manifesti.10.desc_materialist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.10.desc_materialist&lang=en)

### 中文

感情没有价值，但资源有价值。宣泄派的所谓“项目”已经被没收、拆除，并被重新用于更有意义的地方。随着他们的集会点消失，这场运动失去了动力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:693`

### English

Sentiment holds no value, but resources do. The so-called 'projects' of the Manifesti has been confiscated, dismantled, and repurposed for more practical use. With their rallying points gone, the movement has lost momentum.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:754`

## manifesti.10.desc_spiritualist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.10.desc_spiritualist&lang=en)

### 中文

§H宣泄派§!的反抗不仅仅是叛逆，而是一种标志，是一条来自虚空本身的信息。我们应该倾听，而不是让他们噤声。他们的一位成员已经被选中加入我们的政府，将享受最舒适的生活，因为是他们引导我们才对宇宙有了更深的理解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:694`

### English

§HThe Manifesti's§! defiance is no mere rebellion but a sign, a message from the void itself. Rather than silence them, we shall listen. One among them has been chosen to join our governance, where they will enjoy the finest comforts as they guide us toward a deeper understanding of the cosmos.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:755`

## manifesti.10.desc_xenophobe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.10.desc_xenophobe&lang=en)

### 中文

只要失去了言语载体，反对意见便无法传播。关闭了行星范围通讯后，我们切断了这些反对者的协调能力。没有了外部势力的引导，他们的运动很快就会崩溃。\n\n不幸的是，通讯关闭也影响了执法部门完成任务的能力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:695`

### English

Dissent cannot spread if there is no voice to carry it. By shutting down planetary communications, we have severed the protesters' ability to coordinate. Without guidance from foreign elements, their movement is sure to collapse.\n\nUnfortunately, the communications shutdown has also impacted the ability of law enforcement to perform its duties.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:756`

## manifesti.10.desc_authoritarian

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.10.desc_authoritarian&lang=en)

### 中文

持不同意见也是家事。我们通过拘留主要煽动者的亲属来迫使§H宣泄派§!屈服。他们的意志被打破后，领头人也被拘留了，这场运动已经崩溃。\n\n秩序恢复了，我们的权威不容置疑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:696`

### English

Dissent is a family matter. By detaining the relatives of key agitators, we have forced §HThe Manifesti§! into submission. With their will broken and their leaders in custody, the movement has collapsed.\n\nOrder is restored, and our authority stands unquestioned.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:757`

## manifesti.10.desc_dismantled_exhibition

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.10.desc_dismantled_exhibition&lang=en)

### 中文

展览被悄悄拆除，创作者受到谴责，更具煽动性的作品被没收。我们通过官方渠道向其他国家保证，这种破坏性的言论并不反映我们的国家政策。\n\n虽然一些人谴责此举是文字狱，但大多数人现在明白了一个简单的事实。如果威胁到了帝国的稳定，言论自由就要受到限制。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:697`

### English

The exhibition was quietly dismantled, its creators reprimanded, and its more inflammatory pieces confiscated. Official channels assured our alien counterparts that such disruptive rhetoric does not reflect state policy.\n\nWhile some decry the move as censorship, most now understand a simple truth. There are limits to free expression when the stability of the empire is at stake.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:758`

## manifesti.10.desc_violent_protests

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.10.desc_violent_protests&lang=en)

### 中文

§H宣泄派§!的家人们被拘留了，而运动的领头人也因此很快被镇压。然而，公众的反应却不是顺从，而是愤怒。抗议活动愈演愈烈，不再局限于单纯的示威，而是演变为暴力骚乱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:698`

### English

The families of §HThe Manifesti§! have been detained, and with them, the movement's leadership has been effectively neutralized. Yet, instead of compliance, the public's response has been one of outrage. Protests have grown fiercer, no longer confined to mere demonstrations but erupting into violent unrest.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:759`

## manifesti.15.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.15.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种人为制造的语言开始在艺术中心和学术机构传播，这是对官方语言的刻意拒绝。这种由§H宣泄派§!创造的语言的使用者拒绝承认我们语言的合法性，认为它是不过一种在第一次接触之后就无法自诩正统的社会符号。\n\n行政官们警告称，越来越多的人拒绝以既定的方式进行沟通，这可能会加深分歧，破坏公共话语的稳定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:702`

### English

A fabricated language has begun spreading through art centers and academic institutions, a deliberate rejection of the official tongue. Created by §HThe Manifesti§!, its speakers refuse to acknowledge the legitimacy of our language, seeing it as a symbol of a society that can no longer define itself in the wake of first contact.\n\nOfficials warn that this growing refusal to communicate in established terms risks deepening divisions and destabilizing public discourse.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:763`

## manifesti.20.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.20.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H宣泄派§!已经公布了他们最为公开的展览的日期。这是一次位于[this.GetName]的全新且极其受欢迎的互动体验，邀请参观者操控他们自己的反射镜像，以及创造由扭曲的政治人物形象组成的拼贴画——其中一些甚至来自于§H其他的星际帝国§!。\n\n批评家们认为这些画作是我们对自己自我感的一次必要和严厉的审视。这次展览还激发了许多其他形式的讽刺艺术，其主题涵盖诸多国内议题和泛物种关系。\n\n我们的社会研究者掀起了激烈的讨论；一些保守的声音要求我们谨慎处理。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:709`

### English

§HThe Manifesti§! have unveiled their most public exhibition to date. A new and extremely popular interactive experience on [this.GetName] invites visitors to manipulate reflections and images of themselves, and to create distorted collages of political figures - some from §Hother galactic empires§!.\n\nCritics herald these pieces as casting a necessarily and harsh light upon our sense of self. The exhibition has also inspired a number of other satirical works both on domestic issues, and on pan-species relations.\n\nDebate amongst our social researchers is lively; more conservative voices urge caution.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:770`

宣泄主义的兴起

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:773`

## manifesti.25.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.25.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

关于所谓的“宣泄主义”启发了一个全新派系形成的留言四起。随着我们在第一次接触后对宇宙和自身在其中地位的理解的陷入质疑，它的支持者们开始挑战既定的规范。他们提倡激进的自我表达和对社会结构的根本重新评估。现有的派系抱怨称自己的集会受到了宣泄派煽动者的干扰，这些人对政府的无情挑战正在[Root.GetName]播下不和的种子。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:713`

### English

Rumors spread that a new faction is emerging, driven by the ideals of 'Manifestism.' In the aftermath of first contact, as our understanding of the universe and our place within it comes into question, its proponents challenge established norms. They advocate for radical self-expression and a fundamental reevaluation of societal structures. Existing factions complain that their gatherings are being disrupted by Manifestist agitators, whose relentless challenges to governance are sowing discord across [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:774`

## manifesti.30.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amanifesti.30.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y宣泄派§!发出的烦人嗡嗡声被噤声了，其消退之快，正如这帮子反动人士起事时一般。某些被我们约谈的行动人士宣称，他们的动机十分复杂，从纯粹的讽刺到有意识、有目的的反对都有。\n\n尽管在画廊和博物馆的活动热度还是前所未有的高，但是公众的注意力已经移动到了新的、更具有争议性的艺术团体身上。我们在继续筛选他们在这一次[root.GetAdj]文化历史上的古怪时刻收集到的数据。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:719`

### English

The buzz surrounding §YThe Manifesti§! faction has quietened, fading as quickly as the arrival of protests which started it. Some activists we spoke to claimed their motivations ranged from pure satire to conscientious objection.\n\nAttendance at galleries and museums has never been higher, but the public gaze has already moved on to newer, controversial groups of artists. We will continue to sift through the data gathered during this strange moment in [root.GetAdj] cultural history.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:780`

## operative_resurfaces_chain_desc

## envoy_events.100.name

### 中文

隐秘羞辱

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:781`

### English

Scandalous Insult

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:844`

## envoy_events.100.desc.regular

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aenvoy_events.100.desc.regular&lang=en)

### 中文

我们无意中从§H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§!抓获了一个代表，其把他们帝国对我们的真实感受泄露给另一个匿名团体。这相较于通常的政治诽谤更为过分：已称得上是§P公然的侮辱§!，看来我们在[scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj]社会中已经是成了被大肆嘲笑的对象。\n\n不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：外交手腕和我们的自尊心都要求我们坚持自己的立场。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:782`

### English

We have caught a delegate from the §H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§! in a rare blunder, letting slip their empire's true feelings about us to another, anonymous party. More than the usual political mud-slinging: these amount to an §Poutright insult§!, as it appears we are the subjects of fierce ridicule amongst [scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj] society.\n\nWhether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: diplomacy and pride would demand that we stand our ground.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:845`

## envoy_events.100.desc.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aenvoy_events.100.desc.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

一名来自§H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§!的代表无意中透露了他们的格式塔国家在背地里对我们的真实感受。对于一个格式塔意识而言，盘算政治诽谤这种事显得尤为狭隘，因而这些对我们来说称得上是§P荒谬且有力§!的侮辱。\n\n不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：外交手腕和我们的自尊心都要求我们坚持自己的立场，并反对这种离奇的[scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj]行为。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:783`

### English

A delegate from the §H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§! has let slip their gestalt's true feelings about us, apparently when in conference with other, anonymous parties. Given how petty it must be for a combined consciousness to even contemplate so-called 'political mud-slinging', these strike us as an §Pabsurd and potent insult§!.\n\nWhether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: diplomacy and pride would demand that we stand our ground against this bizarre [scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj] behavior.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:846`

## envoy_events.100.desc.hostile

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aenvoy_events.100.desc.hostile&lang=en)

### 中文

一名来自§H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§!的代表在与某匿名团体的会议上，竟敢说出他们那可怜的帝国对我们的真实感受。\n\n这种§P荒谬的侮辱§!企图贬低我们，不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：我们的自尊都要求我们不能容忍它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:784`

### English

A delegate from the §H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§! has dared to let slip their pitiful empire's true feelings about us, apparently while in conference with other, anonymous parties.\n\nThis §Pabsurd insult§! seeks to belittle us, and whether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: pride demands that we not stand for it.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:847`

## envoy_events.101.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aenvoy_events.101.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[from.GetName]§!说我们的一名官员的不轨行为让他们§P被冒犯§!。他们没有指出这位官员的名字，也没有描述侮辱的类型。相反，我们在收到了一阵怒骂后，通讯就突然中断了。\n\n这种罕见的外交破裂可能是因为一些其他势力的干预；也可能是纯粹的误解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:789`

### English

The §H[from.GetName]§! say they have §Ptaken offense§! at a misdemeanor carried out by one of our officials. They have not named the official, nor even described the nature of the insult. Instead we have received little more than a burst of indignation, and an abrupt end to communications.\n\nIt's possible that this rare breach in diplomacy is the work of some other, meddling party; it could just as easily be an honest misunderstanding.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:852`

## TOXIC_OPERATION_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATOXIC_OPERATION_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

[toxic_field_country.GetAdj]的居住环境对我们的特工有毒。通过研究毒性的效果，我们可以开发出一个疗法缓解这个情况，同时还能规避我们的特工在视觉上暴露给目标[toxic_field_country.GetIndividualNamePlural]的风险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:879`

### English

The [toxic_field_country.GetAdj] habitat is mildly toxic to our own operatives. By studying its effects, we can develop a remedy and so avoid the risks associated with having visibly-allergic [toxic_field_country.GetIndividualNamePlural] inside their hive.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:951`

### English

## NOISE_OPERATION_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANOISE_OPERATION_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

[excess_noise_country.GetName]为自己创造的环境产生了比我们预计还要多的静电噪声。我们的伪装无人机时不时经历数据丢失。通过研究这些非正常频域的频率，我们可以对我们的特工无人机进行重新调制，使得其能够维持高功能性并避免在力场中被检测到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:881`

### English

The environment which the [excess_noise_country.GetName] creates for itself generates more electrostatic noise than we had anticipated. Our disguised drones are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. By studying these errant frequencies, we can re-tune our operative drones to maintain higher function and avoid detection 'in the field'.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:953`

## resolution_custodian_form_empire_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_custodian_form_empire_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管监管人尽了极大的努力，星海共同体仍然因为内部各行其是而遭受严重削弱。设想一下，如果整个星系可以被一个强大的领袖团结起来，我们将无所不能。一个前所未有的和平而繁荣的时代近在咫尺。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:985`

### English

Despite the tremendous efforts of the Custodian, the Galactic Community is still undermined by internal division. Think of all that could be accomplished if the galaxy were united under strong leadership. An unprecedented era of peace and prosperity is within our reach.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1064`

## resolution_custodian_form_empire_tooltip

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:986`

### English

The §YGalactic Community§! changes into the §YGalactic Imperium§!.\n§RAll members leave any existing Federations.§!\n\n§RThe §Y[Root.GetName]§! becomes the §YImperial Core§!, shifting towards §YAuthoritarianism§! and adopting an §YImperial§! government. All incompatible §YCivics§! are removed.§!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1065`

### 中文

我们的星系面临严重威胁，摆在我们面前的只有一个简单的选择：同生，或共死。我们应该搁置争议，共享敌人的情报，同仇敌忾。

## resolution_custodian_galactic_mobilization_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_custodian_galactic_mobilization_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们星系的命运千钧一发。我们必须尽快动员巨量的舰队，即便征召民间的商业船员也在所不惜。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:997`

### English

The future of our galaxy is at stake. Massive fleets of war must be rapidly mobilized, even if it means the impressment of civilian merchant crews.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1078`

## resolution_custodian_galactic_standard

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_custodian_galactic_standard&lang=en)

### 中文

引入星海标准语

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:998`

### English

Introduce Galactic Standard

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1079`

## resolution_custodian_galactic_standard_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_custodian_galactic_standard_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海标准语是一种针对所有具有不同生理特征的智慧生物设计的简单易用的的新语言。为星海共同体所有职能部门制定统一用语有望避免一切的翻译事故。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:999`

### English

Galactic Standard is a new language that has been specifically designed for ease of use by all sapients regardless of their physiology. By introducing a single language to all official Galactic Community functions, it is hoped that translation mishaps may be avoided.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1080`

## resolution_custodian_anti_piracy

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_custodian_anti_piracy&lang=en)

### 中文

反海盗倡议

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1000`

### English

Anti-Piracy Initiative

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1081`

## resolution_custodian_anti_piracy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_custodian_anti_piracy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

猖獗的太空海盗行为威胁着全星系的经济健康。通过此倡议，所有共同体成员将受到有效的反海盗举措教育。同时我们还将举行联合军演开发战斗技巧，以在面对普遍缺乏纪律性的海盗和掠夺者的船员时获取优势。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1001`

### English

Rampant space piracy threatens to undermine the economic well-being of the entire galaxy. With this initiative, all Community members will be educated in effective anti-piracy measures. Joint efforts to develop combat tactics that take advantage of the general lack of discipline among pirate and marauder crews will also be undertaken.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1082`

## resolution_custodian_extend_custodianship

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_custodian_extend_custodianship&lang=en)

### English

## resolution_custodian_extend_custodianship_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_custodian_extend_custodianship_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

创造一个更好的星系是一件需要持续投入时间的伟大事业。如果有任何持续效应的事务需要完成，那么当前的监管人就需要连任。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1003`

### English

Making the galaxy a better place is a monumental task that takes time. The current Custodianship needs to be extended by another term if anything with lasting effects is to be accomplished.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1084`

## resolution_custodian_extend_custodianship_tooltip

## resolution_emperor_imperial_legions_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_emperor_imperial_legions_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

成为帝国军团士兵效忠星系是无上的荣耀。从全帝国的军队中万里挑一，帝国军团将被训练成为极度忠诚的地面部队。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1036`

### English

There is no greater honor than to serve the galaxy as an Imperial Legionnaire. Drawn from the cream of all military recruits across the entire Imperium, the Legions are drilled and conditioned into a fanatically loyal ground force.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1119`

## resolution_emperor_isd_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_emperor_isd_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

和平、稳定、秩序，这就是星海帝国成立所依托的要义。无论是犯罪、恐怖主义和分离主义，犯我帝国者，安全总局虽远必诛。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1038`

### English

Peace, stability, order - the very tenets on which the Galactic Imperium was founded. The ISD will hunt down criminals, terrorists, and seditionists wherever they may be hiding.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1121`

帝国贸易公司将会在帝国章程下运作，它的管理和董事会成员在星海帝皇的直接掌控之下。

## resolution_emperor_trial_of_advancement_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_emperor_trial_of_advancement_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

应当可以通过适格试炼来挑战帝国议会成员的席位，以免他们因将自身地位视作理所当然而懈怠。骄傲自满和软弱无力都必须从帝国的上层梯队中剔除。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1043`

### English

Lest they are taken for granted, it should be possible to challenge the members of the Imperial Council for their seats in a Trial of Advancement. The complacent and the meek must be weeded out from the upper echelons of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1127`

帝国议会的成员必须以效忠于他们的帝皇陛下为荣幸，而陛下则可自由地从他的忠诚的臣民中挑选。

### 中文

指派星海监管人

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1105`

### English

Galactic Custodian Appointed

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1196`

## custodian.2.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.2.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

终于，星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，我们被任命为§H星海共同体监管人§!。\n\n作为同侪之首，我们负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。我们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1106`

### English

At last, the Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In an official ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, we were appointed §HCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.\n\nAs the first among equals, we have been charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. We have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1197`

## custodian.2.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.2.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海参议院投票通过授予§H[custodian.GetName]§!紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，他们被任命为§H星海共同体监管人§!。\n\n作为同侪之首，[custodian.GetSpeciesName]政府负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。他们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1107`

### English

The Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the §H[custodian.GetName]§!. In a ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, they were appointed the official §HCustodians of the Galactic Community§!.\n\nAs the first among equals, the [custodian.GetSpeciesName] government is now charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. They have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1198`

## custodian.11.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.11.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们作为星海共同体监管人的任期已经结束。监管人职能终止，我们的特殊权力也解除了，当然我们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1112`

### English

Our term as the Custodians of the Galactic Community has reached its end. The Custodianship has been terminated and our special powers rescinded, although we have retained our seat on the Galactic Council.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1203`

## custodian.11.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.11.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着他们的任期结束，§H[former_custodians.GetName]§!放弃了他们作为星海共同体监管人的地位。他们的特殊权力也废除了，当然他们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1113`

### English

With their term at an end, the §H[former_custodians.GetName]§! has given up their status as the Custodians of the Galactic Community. Their special powers have been rescinded, and they are now considered a regular member of the Galactic Council.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1204`

## custodian.15.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.15.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们终于摆脱了吃力不讨好的监管人职位！让其他随便什么人去担心这帮忘恩负义的家伙们的未来吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1116`

### English

Finally we are rid of the thankless and futile Custodianship! Let someone else worry about the future of this ungrateful galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1207`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.15.b.desc&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1117`

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1208`

## custodian.17.a.desc

### 中文

星海参议院里忘恩负义的傻瓜们投票结束我们作为监管人的任期！我们被剥夺了所有的相关职责。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1123`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1214`

## custodian.17.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.17.b.desc&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1124`

### English

In a sudden and humiliating end to their Custodianship, the Galactic Senate majority has voted to immediate remove the §Y[From.GetName]§! from the office of Galactic Custodian. They have been stripped of their special Community powers.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1215`

## emperor.2.intro.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.2.intro.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是崭新秩序的黎明。腐朽的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布我们对这一新的泛星系政权有无可置疑的地位之后，我们现在又被称为§H[Root.GetName]§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1135`

### English

It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming our rightful place on the throne of this new pan galactic state, we are now known as the §H[Root.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1227`

## emperor.2.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.2.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一个面向全星系广播的极具奢华的加冕仪式上，在[Root.Capital.GetName]，[ruler.GetRegnalName]被加冕为[Root.GetRulerTitle]，于是一个新的帝国王朝开始了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1136`

### English

In a lavish coronation ceremony broadcast across the entire galaxy, a new imperial dynasty was established when [ruler.GetRegnalName] was crowned [Root.GetRulerTitle] on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1228`

## emperor.2.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.2.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这一社会建构将服务于我们的机械智能，从今往后亦被称为§H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!。这将会是一个控制整个星系诸多政治子实体的更高层级。我们的帝国臣民们将会适时地学会服从于我们的指令和我们的任一个无人机。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1137`

### English

This social construct will afford our Machine Intelligence, henceforth referred to as the §H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!, a much greater level of control over the galaxy's many sub-polities. Our imperial subjects will, in time, learn to obey our commands as well as any drone.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1229`

## emperor.2.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.2.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的蜂巢思维从今往后将被称为§H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!，这种社会结构使我们能够更大程度地控制星系中的诸多子政体。我们的帝国臣民迟早要学会服从我们以及任一子个体的命令。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1138`

### English

This social construct will afford our Hive Mind, henceforth referred to as the §H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!, a much greater level of control over the galaxy's many sub-polities. Our imperial subjects will, in time, learn to obey our commands as well as any drone.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1230`

## emperor.2.d.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.2.d.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

以§H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§!作为掩护，这种社会结构将会给予我们对星系的诸多子政权更深层次的控制力。我们的帝国臣民迟早要学会欣赏、默许荒野的智慧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1139`

### English

This social construct will afford us - in the guise of §H[Root.GetRulerTitle]§! - a much greater level of control over the galaxy's many sub-polities. Our imperial subjects will, in time, learn to appreciate the wisdom of acquiescing to the Wilderness.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1231`

## emperor.3.awakenedhive.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.3.awakenedhive.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是远古秩序的黎明。\n\n星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。古老而破碎的意识选择在这一时代复兴，违抗天命者都被绳之以法。谁都不知道这位新的[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]对星系抱有何等雄心壮志。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1150`

### English

It is the dawn of an Old Order.\n\nThe Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. The old and fragmented  consciousness chose this era to re-emerge. Those who would oppose their ascension have been put in chains. Who can say what aspirations the new [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has for the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1242`

## emperor.3.intro.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.3.intro.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是崭新秩序的黎明。陈腐的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是§H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。在宣布对这一新的泛星系政权的皇权之后，前监管人§H[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§!现在自称为§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1151`

### English

It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the §H[Root.GetGalEmpireName]§! has risen. After claiming the throne of this new pan galactic state, the former §H[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§! Custodians now refer to themselves as the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1243`

## emperor.3.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.3.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一个全星系广播的极具奢华的加冕仪式上，在[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]，[gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName]被加冕为[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，于是一个新的帝国王朝开始了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1152`

### English

In a lavish coronation ceremony broadcast across the entire galaxy, a new imperial dynasty was established when [gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName] was crowned [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1244`

## emperor.3.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.3.b.desc&lang=en)

它们的核心人工智能，又被称为[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，作为最高主宰统治着整个帝国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1153`

### English

Their central AI, known as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], rules as the supreme sovereign of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1245`

## emperor.3.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.3.c.desc&lang=en)

它们的集体智能，又被称为[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，作为最高主宰统治着整个帝国。

### English

Their linked consciousness, known as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], rules as the supreme sovereign of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1246`

## emperor.4.title

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.4.title&lang=en)

### 中文

宣告帝国成立

### English

## emperor.4.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.4.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

全星系的子民们，庆贺吧！你们被从星海共同体那令人窒息的官僚体系和争执不休的外交纷争中解放了。\n\n你们的星球如今尽在星海帝国的庇护之下。作为帝国的公民，你们被团结到了全星系最伟大而且最强大的国家之中。叛乱者受罚，而服从者有赏。要知道，[gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName][gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]会管照着你们。\n\n帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1160`

### English

Citizens of the galaxy, rejoice! You have been set free from the tyranny of the Galactic Community's stifling bureaucracy and bickering diplomats.\n\nYour worlds are now under the protection of the Galactic Imperium. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful nation the galaxy has ever seen. Sedition will be punished and obedience rewarded. Know that [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] [gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName] watches over you.\n\nLong live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1252`

## emperor.4.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.4.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

注意此布告！星海帝国取代了你原知的陈腐的星海共同体机构。你们的恒星政体已经被重整并收归到一个统一帝国的管辖之下。\n\n[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]作为帝国的中央处理器，你将学会如何以正确的方式执行它的命令。作为帝国的子民，你们被团结到了全星系有史以来最伟大而且最强大的政治实体之中。它的长治久安要求你们的服从和协作。\n\n帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1161`

### English

Attention! Heed this announcement. The Galactic Imperium has superseded the obsolete institution you knew of as the Galactic Community. Your individual stellar polities have been reorganized and are now grouped under a single overriding Imperial directory.\n\nThe [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] will serve as the Imperium's central processor, and you are instructed to execute its commands in a prompt manner. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful political entity the galaxy has ever known. Its continued success will require both obedience and cooperation.\n\nLong live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1253`

## emperor.4.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.4.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

全星系的自主智慧生物们，这是伟大的一天。你们很快将会从全知智能的引领中获益，同时还被恩准保留你们许多人所固守的个人主义谬误。\n\n你们的星球如今尽在星海帝国的庇护之下。作为帝国的子民，你们被团结到了全星系最伟大而且最强大的蜂巢之下。遵从[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的指示，永不背离它的规划——要知道这些规划是由全星系规模最大的意识的产物。\n\n帝国万岁！[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]万岁！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1162`

### English

Autonomous sapients of the galaxy, this is a great day. You will soon reap the benefits of being guided by vast all-seeing intelligence, while at the same time maintaining some of the fallacies of the individualism many of you cling to.\n\nYour worlds are now under the protection of the Galactic Imperium. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful Hive the galaxy has ever seen. Obey the directives of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] and do not stray from its designs - know that they are the product of a mind greater in scope than any other in this galaxy.\n\nLong live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1254`

## emperor.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]刚刚勒令星海帝国的所有组成国必须立即从任何他们可能所属的“废弃”的跨国联邦当中退出。帝国使团向我们保证，作为帝国的忠实成员，我们不再需要涉入这种“外交纠葛”当中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1165`

### English

The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has decreed that all constituent states of the Galactic Imperium are to immediately withdraw from any "obsolete" supranational federations they might be a part of. Imperial envoys have assured us that, as loyal members of the Imperium, we have no further use of such "diplomatic entanglements."

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1257`

## emperor.50.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.50.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

创建一支防卫星海帝国的无敌舰队已经被签署成为法令。新建立的§H帝国海军§!将从整个帝国的成员国中征召船员和后勤队伍，但其大部分军官仍由[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]组成。\n\n这一舰队直接听令于[gal_emperor.GetName]，所有的新兵将被要求宣誓效忠[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1176`

### English

The creation of a grand fleet for the defense of the Galactic Imperium has been signed into law. This new §HImperial Armada§! will conscript its ship crews and support personnel from within all the members of the Imperium, but a majority of its officer corps will consist of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\nThe Armada shall be under the direct control of the [gal_emperor.GetName], and all new conscripts will be required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1269`

## emperor.52.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.52.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

古旧的星海共同体的一切相关被一扫而空，取而代之的是新的帝国。作为这一重构的一部分，泛星系防卫军被更名为§H帝国海军§!。\n\n这一新的舰队将继承泛星系防卫军的多数军衔系统和构架，但将更换新设计的制服和军衔徽章，所有的现役人员将被要求向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]宣誓效忠。\n\n尽管舰队的船员和后勤队伍仍然将从帝国的成员国中招募，但[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName]军官的比例大幅提高了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1180`

### English

All references to the old Galactic Community are being swept away in the new Imperium, and as part of this reorganization, the Galactic Defense Force has changed its name to the §HImperial Armada§!.\n\nThis new fleet has inherited much of its rank structure and organization from the GDF, but new uniforms and insignia have been introduced, and all serving members are required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].\n\nWhile the Armada's ship crews and support personnel are still recruited from all members of the Imperium, the percentage of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName] officers has dramatically increased.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1273`

## emperor.55.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.55.name&lang=en)

### 中文

军团建立

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1181`

### English

The Founding of the Legions

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1274`

## emperor.55.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.55.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

第一§H帝国军团§!现在正在[gal_emperor.GetName]上征召组建。这支精英地面部队具有征募帝国任何一名公民成为士兵的权力。许多军事院校已经完成了对可靠人选的寻找，并且据信，只要发现了格外适任者，任何一位公民哪怕是儿童也会被招募。\n\n从残暴的训练科目和近乎对人格打碎重构的深度精神塑造中幸存下来的人才能顺利毕业成为帝国军团士兵。他们可靠的战斗技巧，无懈可击的纪律和对[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]近乎狂热的忠诚使得他们成为整个星系中最强有力的突击队。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1182`

### English

The first §HImperial Legions§! are now being assembled in the [gal_emperor.GetName]. This elite ground force has the legal authority to conscript citizens from all members of the Imperium. Many military academies are already being scouted for promising candidates, and there are reports that civilians - even children - are drafted if found to be unusually capable.\n\nThose who survive the brutal training program and its extensive mental conditioning - in which their personalities are largely rebuilt from scratch - graduate as Imperial Legionnaires. Their formidable fighting skills, unnerving discipline, and fanatic loyalty to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] make them some of the finest assault troops in the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1275`

## emperor.70.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.70.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

隶属于§H帝国安全总局§!的特工正在逐渐部署到帝国境内的所有星球，他们在表面上会协助当地执法部门维护治安，同时暗地里会调查严重犯罪并施加制裁。\n\n帝安局的另一个职能——通过帝国司法部直接向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]负责——是铲除“恐怖分子、叛党和分离主义者”，这些人会在暗地里破坏帝国的稳定和统一。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1187`

### English

Agents from the §HImperial Security Directorate§! are in the process of deploying to worlds all over the Imperium, where they will ostensibly aid local law enforcement agencies in the investigation and prosecution of serious crimes.\n\nAnother function of the ISD, which reports only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] through the Imperial Ministry of Justice, is to root out "terrorists, rebels, and seditionists" who threaten to undermine the stability of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1280`

## emperor.70.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.70.a&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1188`

### English

No one escapes Imperial justice.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1281`

## emperor.72.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.72.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着帝国的崛起，星系刑警组织被重新改组，其名称改变成了§H帝国安全总局§!。帝安局的特工们依旧能够将自己的权力扩张到帝国全境，但是他们现在只向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]报告。\n\n尽管帝安局的主要职能的一项依然是在帝国的星球上制裁犯罪，他们现在也负责猎杀那些会威胁到[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]统治的分离主义者、叛乱分子。部分各界人士担忧这个前身为警察组织的部门现在变成了血腥镇压的工具……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1189`

### English

With the rise of the Imperium, GALPOL is being reorganized and has changed its name to the §HImperial Security Directorate§!. The jurisdiction of ISD agents still extends across the entire Imperium, but as of now they report only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].\n\nWhile one of the primary responsibilities of the ISD is still to investigate and prosecute crime on Imperial worlds, they are now also used to hunt down seditionists and rebels who would challenge the rule of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. Some are voicing concern that the former police organization is turning into a tool of oppression...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1282`

## war_goal_wg_imperial_crusade_desc

### 中文

发动战争，以强迫敌人加入星海帝国。\n\n若是通过“维持现状”结束战争的话，我们所占据的恒星系如果包含至少一个行星则将会被释放成为帝国的一个新成员。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1222`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1323`

## resolution_galactic_empire_imperial_crusade_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_galactic_empire_imperial_crusade_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个星系中仍有未被星海帝国所囊括的荒蛮之地，这一现状是有待改善的。帝国发动的大远征，只要获得胜利，便可迫使这一议案的目标加入帝国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1224`

### English

The borders of the Galactic Imperium do not yet encompass the entire galaxy - this must be rectified. An Imperial Crusade will, if successful, force the target of this resolution to join the Imperium.

## emperor.101.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.101.name&lang=en)

### 中文

叛乱怒吼！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1251`

### English

Cry of Rebellion!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1355`

## emperor.101.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.101.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——§H星海帝国§!已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。也许再也不会有这么好的推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的机会了！现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个统一联邦的旗帜之下。\n\n由于[Root.GetName]在这场盛大的叛乱中打响了第一枪，各界纷纷请求我们在接下来的战争中领导这个伟大的联盟，毫无疑问这也是星系的一份。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1252`

### English

We have reached a pivotal moment - the §HGalactic Imperium§! is hovering on the brink of open revolt. There may never be a better time to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]! Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium are uniting under the banner of a single federation.\n\nAs it was the [Root.GetName] that orchestrated the opening shots of the rebellion, we have been asked to lead this great alliance in the upcoming war, which will no doubt be of galactic proportions.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1356`

## emperor.101.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.101.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这片星系将重获自由！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1253`

### English

Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1357`

## emperor.101.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.101.b&lang=en)

### 中文

不，我们对[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]忠心耿耿。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1254`

### English

No, we are loyal to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1358`

## emperor.102.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.102.name&lang=en)

### 中文

自由之死

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1255`

### English

The Death of Liberty

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1359`

## emperor.102.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.102.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管星海帝国濒临崩溃的迹象十分明显了，但它的任何一个成员都没有公开挑战[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的意愿。起义胎死腹中，而§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!反倒极大地增强了对星系的掌控。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1256`

### English

Despite the obvious signs that the Galactic Imperium was facing imminent collapse, none of its members were willing to openly challenge the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. The rebellion died in its infancy with a whimper, and the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§! has greatly strengthened its grip on the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1360`

## emperor.102.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.102.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经获悉他们试图通过煽动公开叛乱来痛击星海帝国当前的弱点，而这一尝试已宣告失败。当真正的起义时刻来临时，没有一位帝国成员敢于站出来直面[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，因此叛乱在还没开始的时候就结束了。\n\n这极大地挫伤了反叛运动，并且极大地增强了我们对星系的掌控。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1257`

### English

We have learned of a failed attempt to take advantage of the Galactic Imperium's present weakness by instigating open rebellion. When push came to shove, none of the members of the Imperium could summon the courage to challenge the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] directly, and so the revolt ended before it had even begun.\n\nThis is a great blow to the rebel movement, which has greatly strengthened our hold over the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1361`

## emperor.103.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.103.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——星海帝国已经已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个由§H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!领导的统一联邦的旗帜之下。同时，§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!则正召集忠诚且坚毅者不惜一切代价捍卫帝国。\n\n内战之火即将席卷全星系，而两边都在拉拢我们的加入。我们应当与谁并肩作战？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1260`

### English

We have reached a pivotal moment - the Galactic Imperium is hovering on the brink of open revolt. Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium, led by the §H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!, are uniting under the banner of a single federation. Meanwhile, the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§! is gathering loyalists determined to preserve the Imperium at any cost.\n\nCivil war is about to engulf the galaxy, and both sides have asked for our allegiance. Who shall we stand with?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1364`

## emperor.103.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.103.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们并不是唯一一个为了将星系从星海帝国的镣铐中拯救出来而斗争的——§H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!已经组建了一个由各义军国家组成的联盟，而§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!立马宣布他们是在公开叛乱！\n\n由于起义已经在进行，我们自己的行动取消了。我们是否应该公开宣布对义军进行支持？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1261`

### English

We are not the only ones fighting to free the galaxy from the shackles of the Galactic Imperium - the §H[rebel_leader.GetName]§! is already assembling a coalition of rebel nations, and the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§! has just declared them to be in a state of open revolt!\n\nWith the rebellion already well underway, our own operation to trigger one has been canceled. Should we officially declare our support for the rebels?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1365`

## joins_rebels

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ajoins_rebels&lang=en)

### 中文

我们同§Y义军§!并肩作战，反抗§Y帝制派§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1264`

## emperor.104.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.104.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是至暗时刻。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的腐化影响范围远超我们的想象，帝国中的其他成员没有一位敢于加入我们的公开起义！\n\n我们现在将独自对抗星海帝国的联合军队，因为后者已经因战争进行了动员。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1267`

### English

These are dark times. The corrupting influence of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] extends much further than we thought - none of the other members of the Imperium have had the courage to join us in open revolt!\n\nWe now stand alone against the combined might of the Galactic Imperium as it mobilizes for war.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1371`

## emperor.106.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.106.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

叛军利用了星海帝国当前的弱势，发动了一场挑战我们统治的公开叛乱！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1273`

### English

Insurgents are taking advantage of the present weakness of the Galactic Imperium to launch an open revolt against our rule!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1377`

## emperor.106.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.106.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

叛党们以§H[From.Root.GetAllianceName]§!的名义集结部队，并且有报道称，他们针对控制区域内的帝国官员进行了大量的抓捕活动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1274`

### English

The traitors are marshalling their forces under the banner of the §H[From.Root.GetAllianceName]§!, and there are reports of mass arrests targeting Imperial officials within their territory.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1378`

## emperor.106.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.106.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

他们煽动叛乱的企图碰了一鼻子灰，只有§H[From.GetName]§!的叛徒们站在了叛乱的一方。其他的帝国成员坚定不移地效忠于他们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。在忠实伙伴的帮助下，我们很快可以了结这场微不足道的叛变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1275`

### English

Their attempts to foment rebellion have largely met with failure, however - only the traitors of the §H[From.GetName]§! have sided with the rebels. The other members of the Imperium stand firmly with their [Root.GetRulerTitle]. With the aid of our loyalist friends, we must bring a swift end to this pathetic revolt.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1379`

## emperor.106.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.106.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国的臣属被谎言和宣传所动摇，站到了叛乱的一方。这种前所未有的背叛使得[Root.GetName]必须独自为守卫星系的稳定和秩序而战。我们一定不能使[Root.GetRulerTitle]蒙羞。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1276`

### English

Swayed by lies and propaganda, the subject nations of the Imperium have sided with the rebels. This unprecedented betrayal has left the [Root.GetName] standing alone in the defense of order and stability in the galaxy. We must not fail the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1380`

## emperor.106.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.106.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

乱党威胁要颠覆我们建立的新秩序，这是我们一直辛苦斗争取得的成果。不能再犹豫了，这样的行为一定出重拳，唯有如此这片星系才能恢复和平。\n\n§H为了星海帝国的上善之耀！§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1277`

### English

This rebellion threatens to undo the New Order that we have fought so hard to establish. It must be dealt with swiftly and decisively, so that peace can be restored to the galaxy.\n\n§HFor the greater glory of the Galactic Imperium!§!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1381`

## emperor.106.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.106.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这些叛军必须为他们的傲慢无礼付出代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1278`

### English

These rebels must pay for their insolence.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1382`

## emperor.107.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.107.name&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国内战

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1279`

### English

Civil War in the Imperium

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1383`

## emperor.107.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.107.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国被卷入了内战！若干成员站起来反抗[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的统治，他们以§H[rebel_leader.GetAllianceName]§!的名义团结一致。而由§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!领导的帝制派则还以颜色，并且誓要保卫帝国对星系的掌控。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1280`

### English

The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Several members have rebelled against the authority of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], gathering under the banner of the §H[rebel_leader.GetAllianceName]§!. Loyalists, led by the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!, have struck back and are determined to preserve the Imperium's hold over the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1384`

## emperor.107.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.107.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国被卷入了内战！§H[rebel_leader.GetName]§!正在发动反抗[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]统治的起义。而由§H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!领导的帝制派则还以颜色，并且誓要保卫帝国对星系的掌控。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1281`

### English

The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! The §H[rebel_leader.GetName]§! is rebelling against the authority of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. Loyalists, led by the §H[gal_emperor.GetName]§!, have struck back and are determined to preserve the Imperium's hold over the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1385`
