## emperor.108.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.108.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国被卷入了内战！它的成员们分成了两派，其中义军意图推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，而帝制派则为了延续帝国而战。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1286`

### English

The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Its members have divided into rebels, who seek to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], and loyalists, who fight to preserve the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1390`

## emperor.108.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.108.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的宗主§H[From.GetName]§!选择加入义军，因此我们别无选择只能一同加入！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1287`

### English

As our Overlord, the §H[From.GetName]§!, has sided with the Rebels, we have no choice but to join them as well!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1391`

## emperor.108.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.108.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的宗主§H[From.GetName]§!选择加入帝制派，因此我们别无选择只能一同加入！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1288`

### English

As our Overlord, the §H[From.GetName]§!, has sided with the Loyalists, we have no choice but to join them as well!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1392`

## emperor.108.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.108.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由于我们是[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的直接附属国，因此我们根本没有选择的余地，只能成为帝制派。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1289`

### English

As we are a direct subject of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], we have little choice in the matter - we have sided with the Loyalists.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1393`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1290`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1394`

## emperor.150.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.150.name&lang=en)

### 中文

粉碎叛乱！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1291`

### English

Rebellion Crushed!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1396`

## emperor.150.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.150.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

结束了！叛乱基本已经被粉碎，而全帝国忠诚的子民们则在欢庆我们的胜利。\n\n现在那些叛徒们已经束手就擒，我们得想想怎么料理他们。我们是要对他们网开一面还是让他们得到应有的惩罚呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1292`

### English

It is done! The rebellion has been utterly crushed, and loyal citizens throughout the Imperium are celebrating our victory.\n\nNow that the traitors have been brought to heel, we must decide how to deal with them. Should we show leniency or are they to be punished for their crimes?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1397`

## emperor.150.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.150.a&lang=en)

### 中文

欢迎他们回归帝国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1293`

### English

Let us welcome them back into the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1398`

## emperor.150.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.150.b&lang=en)

他们应当为傲慢无礼付出代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1294`

### English

They must be punished for their insolence.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1399`

## emperor.151.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.151.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

内战结束了！星海帝国的联合军队以迅雷不及掩耳之势击溃了叛国者们，星系恢复了往日的秩序。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1297`

### English

The civil war is over! Order has been restored to the galaxy, with the combined forces of the Galactic Imperium delivering swift justice to the rebel traitors.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1402`

## emperor.151.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.151.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当忠诚的帝国子民庆祝这场胜利时，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]决定采取宽容和解的政策。也许这种仁慈将会将过去的叛国者完全感化为忠诚而有用的帝国成员。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1298`

### English

As loyal Imperial citizens celebrate this victory, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has decided to adopt a policy of leniency and reconciliation. Perhaps this kindness will eventually turn the former rebels into loyal and productive members of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1403`

## emperor.151.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.151.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们获悉，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]决定要给叛徒们来个杀鸡儆猴。[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]举行了一场空前盛大的胜利大游行，而在游行的尾声，被活捉的叛军头目们则被公开执行死刑并向全帝国直播。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1299`

### English

We have learned that the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] is determined to make an example of the rebels. A victory parade of unprecedented scale is to be held on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName], and at its conclusion the mass execution of the surviving rebel leadership will be broadcast throughout the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1404`

荣耀归于帝国！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1300`

### English

Glory to the Imperium!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1405`

## emperor.152.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.152.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是星系的黑暗一日。尽管我们进了最大的努力，但我们的义举在帝制派面前仍然不堪一击。帝国的军队全线胜利，我们除了投降别无选择。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1304`

### English

It is a dark day for the galaxy. Despite our best efforts, the rebellion proved unable to withstand the onslaught of the Imperial loyalists. The forces of the Imperium prevailed on all fronts, and we have been left with no choice but to surrender.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1409`

## emperor.152.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.152.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们恢复了作为星海帝国一员的身份，但[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]显然采取了宽容和解的政策。我们不会再受到进一步的处罚。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1305`

### English

Our status as a member of the Galactic Imperium has been restored, but the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has apparently adopted a policy of leniency and reconciliation. We are not to be punished further.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1410`

## emperor.152.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.152.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们恢复了作为星海帝国一员的身份，但[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]显然决定要杀鸡儆猴给一度同叛军为伍的谋反分子看。在[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]举行的一场空前盛大的胜利大游行的尾声中，被活捉的叛军头目即所有的起义首领被公开执行死刑，而整个活动是向全帝国直播的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1306`

### English

Our status as a member of the Galactic Imperium has been restored, but the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has apparently decided to make an example of everyone who sided with the rebels. All Rebel leaders will be executed at the conclusion of the Imperial victory parade on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName] - an event that is to be broadcast throughout the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1411`

### English

## emperor.153.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.153.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

看起来星海帝国已经成功地撑过了它所面临的暴动风波。叛军已经被帝国军队完全击败，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]宣告在内战中获胜。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1310`

### English

It would seem that the Galactic Imperium has managed to weather the storm of insurrection it was facing. The rebels have been decisively defeated by Imperial forces, and the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has proclaimed victory in the civil war.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1415`

### English

## emperor.200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自由重新回到了全星系！星海帝国终于陨落了，最后一个帝制派也向日益壮大的义军投降了。\n\n随着[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]被罢黜，过去的§H星海共同体§!重回生机。时间将会证明重建起的制度是否能够防止下一位星系独裁者的诞生，但现在，过去帝国的疆域里的各个行星上同时掀起了庆祝活动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1313`

### English

Freedom has been restored to the galaxy! The Galactic Imperium has fallen, and the last of the Imperial loyalists have surrendered to the advancing Rebel forces.\n\nWith the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] deposed, the old §HGalactic Community§! has been resurrected. Time will tell if the reborn institution can prevent the rise of another galactic dictator, but for now, spontaneous celebrations have broken out on planets across the territory of the former Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1418`

## emperor.200.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.200.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这是值得铭记的一天。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1314`

### English

This is a day to remember.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1419`

## emperor.201.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.201.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国已经陷落了。我们帝国军队无力阻挡叛乱舰队进犯的步伐，而今天，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]也别无选择停止了抵抗。\n\n随着帝国的解体，§H星海共同体§!的腐朽机构又重新开始运作了。于是，星系又毅然决然地背离了秩序而拥抱了混沌……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1315`

### English

The Galactic Imperium has fallen. Imperial forces proved unable to stop the advance of the Rebel fleets, and today the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] had no choice but to capitulate.\n\nWith the Imperium dismantled, the old corrupt institution of the §HGalactic Community§! has been resurrected to take its place. And so the galaxy has turned decisively away from order, and embraced chaos...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1420`

## emperor.201.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.201.a&lang=en)

黑暗的一天。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1316`

### English

This is a dark day.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1421`

## emperor.202.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.202.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在叛军四面楚歌的围攻下，星海帝国陨落了。叛乱的渣滓们竟击败了帝国曾经强大无比的舰队，最后一位帝制派也背弃了我们的伟业。\n\n迫于一切帝制派抵抗分子的瓦解，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]别无选择只能退位。叛党们已经宣布过去的§H星海共同体§!再次启用，以填补帝国分崩离析后的巨大真空。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1317`

### English

Beset by traitors on all sides, the Galactic Imperium has fallen. The rebel scum have broken the Imperium's once-powerful fleets, and the last of the loyalists have deserted our cause.\n\nIn light of the collapse of all Imperial resistance, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has had no choice but to abdicate. The insurgents have already announced the resurrection of the old §HGalactic Community§! to fill the great void left by the disintegrating Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1422`

## emperor.202.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.202.a&lang=en)

### English

All is lost...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1423`

## emperor.203.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.203.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国陨落了。随着起义军在各个战线全面开花，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]最终退位。\n\n旧的星海共同体重新恢复了运作以替代分崩离析的帝国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1319`

### English

The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Rebel forces victorious on all fronts, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has abdicated.\n\nThe old Galactic Community has been restored in the collapsing Imperium's stead.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1424`

你已经没有必要继续作为帝国议会成员服侍。收拾好你的所有物品并清空场所。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1341`

### English

Your services in the Imperial Council are no longer needed. Gather your belongings and vacate the premises.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1450`

## 02_REMOVE_COUNCIL_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_REMOVE_COUNCIL_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

你未能履行对帝国和[From.GetRulerTitle]的职责。因此，你被剥夺了帝国议会席位。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1342`

### English

You have failed in your duties to the Imperium and the [From.GetRulerTitle]. As such, your seat on the Imperial Council has expired.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1451`

## 03_REMOVE_COUNCIL_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_REMOVE_COUNCIL_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetRulerTitle]已判决你不再适任帝国议会成员。这一席应该转让给一位更适合的人选。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1343`

### English

The [From.GetRulerTitle] has decreed that you no longer deserve your seat on the Imperial Council. It shall instead be bestowed on someone more... capable.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1452`

## emperor.250.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.250.name&lang=en)

### 中文

陷入僵局

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1344`

### English

Stalemate

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1454`

## emperor.250.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.250.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管帝国军队未能摧毁叛乱，他们至少设法阻止了叛军想推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有反叛分子都被保障了独立。\n\n也许这是最好的结果。这样的疾病必须要在腐烂开始扩散之前斩除，因为我们总有机会重新吧这些任性的恒星系收归回帝国的怀抱……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1345`

### English

While Imperial forces failed to destroy the insurgency, they at least managed to thwart the Rebels' attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.\n\nPerhaps it is for the best. A disease such as this must be cut out before the corruption has a chance to spread. We can always rebuild and return these wayward systems to the bosom of the Imperium at a later date...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1455`

## emperor.250.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.250.a&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国应当存续。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1346`

### English

The Imperium shall endure.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1456`

## emperor.251.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.251.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们没有达成推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的目的，但至少我们为自己的人民争得了自由。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有起义分子都被保障了独立。\n\n[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]毫无疑问会利用这个间隙重建帝国的军队，我们必须时刻提防帝国今后任何企图扩大影响力的尝试。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1347`

### English

While we have failed in our attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], we have at least secured freedom for our own people. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.\n\nThe [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] will no doubt use this respite to rebuild the Imperium's forces - we must guard against any future attempts by the Imperials to spread their influence at our expense.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1457`

## emperor.251.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.251.a&lang=en)

### 中文

终获自由。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1348`

### English

Freedom at last.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1458`

## emperor.252.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.252.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

内战在僵局中结束了，虽然证明了帝国无法战胜叛乱，但叛军推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图也失败了。\n\n在今天由双方签署的和平条约中，帝国的起义成员被获得了完全的独立。我们将会看到这是否会导致两个权力集团的长久和平……或是冷战。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1349`

### English

The Civil War has ended in stalemate. While the Imperium proved unable to vanquish the rebellion, the Rebels also failed in their attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].\n\nIn a peace treaty signed by both parties today, the rebelling members of the Imperium were granted full independence. We shall see if this results in a lasting peace between the two power blocs... or a cold war.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1459`

## emperor.300.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.300.name&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国的陷落

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1350`

### English

The Fall of an Empire

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1461`

## emperor.300.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.300.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国受到了致命的打击就此一蹶不振。由于其崩溃在即，我们现在可以恢复原有的§H星海共同体§!。\n\n让这个互相沟通理解的平台取代掉独裁暴政吧！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1351`

### English

The Galactic Imperium has been dealt a mortal blow from which it cannot recover. With its imminent collapse, we are now in a position to restore the old §HGalactic Community§!.\n\nLet it serve as platform of diplomacy and mutual understanding instead of tyranny!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1462`

## emperor.300.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.300.a&lang=en)

### 中文

星海共同体将会复生！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1352`

### English

The Community will be reborn!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1463`

## emperor.301.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.301.name&lang=en)

### 中文

星海共同体的重生

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1353`

### English

The Rebirth of the Community

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1464`

## emperor.301.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.301.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

战争的结束近在咫尺。帝国军的残部要么成建制地投降，要么在夜幕中溃逃散尽，这正是帝国正在凋亡的迹象。\n\n现在，§H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§!就已经开始了重建原有的§H星海共同体§!的工作。整个星系中，帝国的旗帜被撕毁或焚烧。而一个新的未来正展现在我们的眼前。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1354`

### English

The end is here. As the remaining Imperial forces surrender en masse or melt away into the night, it has become evident that the Imperium is dying.\n\nEven now, the §H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§! has begun the work of rebuilding the old §HGalactic Community§!. Imperial banners are being torn down or put to the flame across the galaxy. A new future is upon us.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1465`

## emperor.301.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.301.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们得谋得一席之地

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1355`

### English

We must find our place in it.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1466`

## emperor.302.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.302.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国陷落了。帝国军要么就地溃散要么成建制地投降，帝国的疆域被解放了。\n\n饱受战争之苦的前帝国的疆域中秩序正在逐渐恢复，§H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§!认为是时候重建原有§H星海共同体§!了。我们收到了一份成员邀请，是否加入呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1356`

### English

The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Imperial forces melting away or surrendering en masse, the Imperium's sovereign has abdicated.\n\nAs order is slowly restored to the war-torn systems of the former Imperium, the §H[dissolve_winner.GetName]§! has seen fit to resurrect the old §HGalactic Community§!. We have received a membership invitation. Should we join?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1467`

## emperor.302.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.302.a&lang=en)

### 中文

当然！是时候重新回到星系舞台了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1357`

### English

Of course! It is time to rejoin the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1468`

## emperor.302.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.302.b&lang=en)

不了。它不过是下一个帝国的温床罢了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1358`

### English

No. It could turn into another Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1469`

## emperor.310.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.310.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着帝国势力抵抗的瓦解，我们的§H[new_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§!盟友成功地夺取了王位，并且宣布登基为§H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!的统治者。胜利是我们的！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1360`

### English

With Imperial resistance crumbling, our §H[new_emperor.GetSpeciesName]§! allies have seized the throne and proclaimed themselves the rulers of the §H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!. Victory is ours!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1472`

## emperor.310.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.310.a&lang=en)

希望他们能记得我们的功绩。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1361`

### English

They will hopefully remember our role in this.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1473`

## emperor.311.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.311.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由§H[new_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!领导的军队彻底碾压了星海帝国的大部，最后的一个被围攻的帝国抵抗力量也刚刚投降。鉴于这一进展，[new_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]宣布登基为§H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!的新统治者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1362`

### English

Forces led by the §H[new_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! have overrun much of the Galactic Imperium, and the last pockets of Imperial resistance recently surrendered. In light of this development, the [new_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have proclaimed themselves the rulers of the §H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1474`

## emperor.311.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.311.a&lang=en)

新的帝国，新的主宰。

### English

A new empire and a new master.

## emperor.312.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.312.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝位到手了！在我们的首都[Root.Capital.GetName]，新的[Root.GetRulerTitle]昭示了§H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!的崛起。从今往后，星系的命运将掌握在我们的手里！\n\n鉴于这一里程碑式的事件，我们重新组织了政府，我们现在是新的§H[Root.GetName]§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1364`

### English

The throne is ours! At our capital on [Root.Capital.GetName], the new [Root.GetRulerTitle] has announced the rise of the §H[new_emperor.GetGalEmpireName]§!. Henceforth, the fate of the galaxy shall be decided by us!\n\nIn light of these momentous events, our government has been reorganized and we are now the new §H[Root.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1477`

星海帝国的瓦解

The Collapse of the Galactic Imperium

## emperor.401.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.401.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着§H[LastKilledCountryName]§!的毁灭，星海帝国瓦解了！\n\n在这一片混乱的局势下，原有的星海共同体重获新生，以给星系带去一点恢复秩序的假象。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1367`

### English

With the destruction of the §H[LastKilledCountryName]§!, the Galactic Imperium has collapsed!\n\nAmidst this chaos, the old Galactic Community has been reborn to bring some semblance of order to the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1481`

## emperor.371.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.371.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[attacking_country.GetName]§!攻击了§H[victim_country.GetName]§!！帝国的成员国收到外部势力的攻击需要[Root.GetRulerTitle]的立即反应。\n\n[Root.GetName]需要介入这场战争吗？帝国的其他成员都在翘首以盼。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1370`

### English

The §H[attacking_country.GetName]§! has attacked the §H[victim_country.GetName]§!! This attack on an Imperial member state by an outside power requires an immediate response from the [Root.GetRulerTitle].\n\nShould the [Root.GetName] intervene in this war? The rest of the Imperium is watching closely.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1485`

The cowardly attack on our nation by the §H[attacking_country.GetName]§! has prompted the [From.GetRulerTitle] to take swift action! Imperial fleets from the §H[From.GetName]§! are now moving to support us in this war.

## emperor.373.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.373.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们最近对一个星海帝国成员国§H[victim_country.GetName]§!的袭击，已经招致了[From.GetRulerTitle]迅速的反应！现在我们已经和§H[From.GetName]§!陷入了战争状态。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1377`

### English

Our recent attack on the §H[victim_country.GetName]§!, a member of the Galactic Imperium, has provoked an immediate response from the [From.GetRulerTitle]! A state of war now exists between us and the §H[From.GetName]§!.

## action.37.desc.restore_community.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.37.desc.restore_community.1&lang=en)

### 中文

拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……

There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1505`

## action.37.desc.restore_community.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.37.desc.restore_community.2&lang=en)

### 中文

记住我说的这句话……星海帝国的覆灭也将让我们在未来陷入万劫不复的境地。当全星系的威胁出现时，还有什么名义能让我们再度团结一致起来呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1390`

### English

Mark my words... the destruction of the Galactic Imperium has doomed us all. How else could we stand united under one banner against the horrors that threaten our galaxy?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1506`

## action.37.desc.restore_community.3

如果帝国的子民们能更加英勇地战斗，事情会到这个地步吗！你们全都是叛徒！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1418`

### English

Do you want us to grovel, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Beg, perhaps?\n\n§HNEVER!§!\n\nCome here if you dare, you vile [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]! I will impale you on this jagged piece of rubble!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1535`

## action.48.desc.fe_xenophile

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.48.desc.fe_xenophile&lang=en)

### 中文

哎，你这愚蠢的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。如果你能够悉听我们的教导的话，这样的事情是可以避免的！看看你们都做了什么。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1419`

### English

Oh, you foolish, foolish [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. This could have been avoided if only you had allowed us to guide you! Now look what you have done.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1536`

## action.48.desc.gal_emperor

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.48.desc.gal_emperor&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1420`

### English

Long live the [From.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1537`

## action.48.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.48.a&lang=en)

我们接受你们的投降。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1421`

### English

We accept your surrender.

## action.48.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.48.b&lang=en)

### 中文

他们在这场试炼中并不够格。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1422`

### English

They have been judged and found wanting.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1539`

## action.48.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.48.c&lang=en)

### 中文

又处理掉一个敌人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1423`

### English

Another enemy dealt with.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1540`

## action.48.d

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.48.d&lang=en)

### 中文

他们让我们别无选择……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1424`

### English

They left us no choice...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1541`

## action.48.e

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.48.e&lang=en)

### 中文

宇宙就是如此残酷。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1425`

### English

It is an unforgiving universe.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1542`

## action.48.f

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.48.f&lang=en)

获取成功。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1426`

Acquisition successful.

## action.48.g

[root.GetGestaltEntityName]伸展了。

The [root.GetGestaltEntityName] expands.

威胁解除。

## action.150.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.150.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们向帝国屈服，我们别无选择了……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1430`

### English

We yield to the Imperium. You have left us little choice...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1547`

## action.150.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.150.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

只有愚者才会试图挑战星海帝国的意志。我们投降。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1431`

### English

Only a fool would stand up to the might of the Galactic Imperium. We surrender.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1548`

## action.150.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.150.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们……我们宣誓向[Root.GetRulerTitle]效忠，并保证作为忠诚的帝国子民服务星海帝国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1432`

### English

We... we swear fealty to the [Root.GetRulerTitle], and pledge to serve the Galactic Imperium as loyal Imperial citizens.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1549`

## action.150.gestalt.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.150.gestalt.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们向[Root.GetRulerTitle]政权投降。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1433`

### English

We shall submit to the authority of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1550`

## action.151.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.151.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]欢迎你们加入星海帝国，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你现在已经成为了比[Root.GetName]更伟大事物的一部分。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1434`

### English

The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] welcomes you to the Galactic Imperium, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are now part of something far greater than the [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1551`

## action.151.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.151.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国已经展现了他们的强大力量。认清事实，继续抵抗是徒劳的，拥抱你的未来成为帝国的子民吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1435`

### English

The Galactic Imperium has demonstrated its might. Accept the futility of continued resistance, and embrace your future as Imperial citizens.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1552`

## action.151.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.151.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

很好。一切都如同[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]所预见的那样进行着。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1436`

### English

Good. Everything is proceeding as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has foreseen.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1553`

## action.152.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.152.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

暴政在今天胜利了，星系为此变得更加地黑暗。我们投降。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1437`

### English

Tyranny has prevailed this day, and the galaxy is a darker place for it. We surrender.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1554`

## action.152.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.152.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们帝制派或许赢得了这场战争，但帝国不会永存。自由之光迟早会重回星系！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1438`

### English

You Imperials may have won this war, but the Imperium cannot last forever. Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1555`

## action.152.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.152.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

求求你们……帝国赢了，叛乱结束了。我们只求获得宽大处理。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1439`

### English

Please... the Imperium has won. The rebellion is over. We ask only for mercy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1556`

## action.152.gestalt.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.152.gestalt.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

是我们输了。帝国比我们预期的还要强大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1440`

### English

We have failed. The Imperium was stronger than predicted.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1557`

## action.153.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.153.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

反叛的渣滓。这种背叛的行为不会被忘记的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1441`

### English

Rebel scum. This act of treachery will not soon be forgotten.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1558`

## action.153.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.153.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们这群愚蠢的家伙胆敢违抗[From.GetRulerTitle]。现在你们都得付出代价了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1442`

### English

You were fools to revolt against the [From.GetRulerTitle]. Now you have paid the price.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1559`

## action.153.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.153.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国没有叛乱的立足之地。你最好给我记清楚这点。\n\n[From.GetRulerTitle]万岁！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1443`

### English

Sedition will never be tolerated within the Imperium. You would do well to remember that.\n\nLong live the [From.GetRulerTitle]!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1560`

## action.153.gestalt.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.153.gestalt.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对[From.GetRulerTitle]的反对是徒劳的。接受你是这一个更伟大整体一部分的角色吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1444`

### English

Future opposition to the [From.GetRulerTitle] is futile. Accept your role within the greater whole.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1561`

## action.154.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.154.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国将会开启星系的一个黄金时代，而你们这些叛徒却弃之而去。那就随你们便吧，傻子们！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1445`

### English

The Galactic Imperium was the beginning of a golden age for the galaxy, and yet you traitors chose to throw it all away. Have it your way then, fools!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1562`

## action.154.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.154.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

够了！这个星系不配拥有我们打算创造的辉煌明天。就让帝国这么烧毁吧！让星系再次堕落到无政府和混乱的状态吧！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1446`

### English

Enough! This galaxy does not deserve the shining future we were building. Let the Imperium burn, then! Let the galaxy descend into anarchy and chaos once more!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1563`

## action.154.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.154.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们只是想为星系带来秩序和稳定，但也许混乱才是不可避免的宿命。你们赢了，叛军们！我们会让出帝位的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1447`

### English

We wanted only to bring order and stability to the galaxy, but perhaps chaos is inevitable in the end. Victory is yours, rebels! We shall abdicate the throne.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1564`

## action.154.gestalt.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.154.gestalt.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetRulerTitle]会投降的。我们没能成功预测你们的真实背叛程度，如今星系必须为此付出代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1448`

### English

The [From.GetRulerTitle] will yield. We failed to predict the true depth of your treachery, and now the galaxy must pay the price.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1565`

## action.155.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.155.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们对星系的暴政到头了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1449`

### English

Your tyranny over the galaxy is at an end, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1566`

## action.155.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.155.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

和星海帝国一起见鬼去吧！是时候复原星海共同体了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1450`

### English

Down with the Imperium! It is time to bring back the old Galactic Community!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1567`

## action.155.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.155.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

就让你们的覆灭成为未来任何一个想要想星系内称王称霸的家伙们的教训吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1451`

### English

Let your downfall be a lesson to any future would-be tyrants who seek to rule the entire galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1568`

## action.155.gestalt.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.155.gestalt.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们可耻的社会构造——星海帝国——已经不复存在了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1452`

### English

Your shameful social construct - the Galactic Imperium - is no more.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1569`

## action.156.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.156.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你已经证明了自己的强大，整个帝国悉听尊便……不过我们还是有利用价值的！比如……也许可以在帝国议会里觅得一席地……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1453`

### English

You have proved your strength, and the Imperium is yours... but we can still be of use to you! Perhaps... perhaps a position on the Imperial Council...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1570`

## action.156.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.156.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们成功夺取了皇位，但星系中背叛和欺诈横行。如果你想统治好星海帝国，最好牢记这件事。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1454`

### English

You have won your throne, but the galaxy is rife with traitors and pretenders. If you are to rule the Galactic Imperium, it would serve you well to remember that.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1571`

## action.156.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.156.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们……我们投降。你让我们别无选择。星海帝国的皇位是你们的了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1455`

### English

We... we yield. You have left us no other choice. The throne of the Galactic Imperium is yours.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1572`

## action.156.gestalt.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.156.gestalt.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetRulerTitle]……他不明白。事情不该会变成这样的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1456`

### English

The... the [From.GetRulerTitle] does not understand. This was not how events were meant to transpire.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1573`

## action.157.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.157.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

那我们就拿走啦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1457`

### English

We'll take it from here.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1574`

## action.157.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.157.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国是我们的了。从哪个污水坑里爬出来的就快快滚回去哪里吧，杂碎！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1458`

### English

The Galactic Imperium is ours. Scurry back to the dark pit from whence you came, wretch!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1575`

## action.157.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.157.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在你新的领主面前下跪吧！你的统治到头了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1459`

### English

Bow down before your new sovereign! Your reign is at an end!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1576`

## action.157.gestalt.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.157.gestalt.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

不允许你继续以不当的方式统治帝国。我们应该改善这一功能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1460`

### English

Your suboptimal rule of the Imperium must not be allowed to continue. We shall improve its functionality.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1577`

## action.158.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.158.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1461`

### English

There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1578`

## action.158.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.158.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

记住我说的这句话……星海帝国的覆灭也将让我们在未来陷入万劫不复的境地。当全星系的威胁出现时，还有什么名义能让我们再度团结一致起来呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1462`

### English

Mark my words... the destruction of the Galactic Imperium has doomed us all. How else could we stand united under one banner against the horrors that threaten our galaxy?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1579`

## action.158.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.158.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

如果帝国的子民们能更加英勇地战斗，事情会到这个地步吗！你们全都是叛徒！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1463`

### English

If the citizens of the Imperium had fought harder, this would not have come to pass! Traitors all!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1580`

## action.158.gestalt.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.158.gestalt.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们为星系带来了秩序，而你，却因为你显而易见无知而恐惧地抨击它。你都做了些什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1464`

### English

We imposed order on a chaotic galaxy, and you, in your predictable ignorance, lashed out in fear. What have you done?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1581`

## imperial_charter

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aimperial_charter&lang=en)

帝国特许经营权

### English

Imperial Charter

## imperial_charter_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aimperial_charter_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们拥有的帝国特许经营权允许我们在星海帝国境内的所有星球开设分部，在当地创设帝国特许口岸。这些分部办公室建筑能够为我们和星海帝国的统治者提供收入。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1466`

### English

Our Imperial Charter gives us the right to open branch offices on planets throughout the Galactic Imperium, where we can establish Imperial Concession Ports. These branch office buildings generate income for both us and the ruler of the Galactic Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1584`

## resolution_emperor_imperial_charter

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_emperor_imperial_charter&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国特许经营权

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1467`

### English

Imperial Charter

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1585`

## resolution_emperor_imperial_charter_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_emperor_imperial_charter_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

可以将帝国特许经营权授予寰宇企业，赋予他们特殊的津贴，以及在帝国境内的贸易权利。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1468`

### English

A Megacorporation can be granted an Imperial Charter, giving them special dispensations and trade rights throughout the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1586`

## resolution_emperor_imperial_charter_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_emperor_imperial_charter_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

这个寰宇企业不再需要商贸协定以在帝国境内的星球上设立分部。\n\n他们可以建造§Y帝国特许口岸§!分部办公室，能向自己以及帝国的统治者提供收入。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1469`

### English

This Megacorporation will no longer need Commercial Pacts to establish Branch Offices on planets in the Imperium.\n\nThey can build the §YImperial Concession Port§! branch office, which generates income to both them and the ruler of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1587`

## building_imperial_concession_port_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_imperial_concession_port_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

特许口岸享受治外法权，法律上视作星海帝国的御属领地。它不受当地税收和管理条例的约束。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1471`

### English

This concession port enjoys extraterritorial rights and is legally considered the sovereign territory of the Galactic Imperium. It is exempt from local taxes and regulations.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1589`

## emperor.60.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.60.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]出于感激，诏令参议院将§H帝国特许经营权§!授予§H[charter_corp.GetName]§!。这给予他们特殊权力，用以在帝国全境的各处行星上建立分部，而不用和行星的所属国签订商贸协定。\n\n我们可以料想到，这个寰宇企业马上也会在我们下辖的世界上开设分部，建立帝国特许口岸，而我们的司法权在此地不再有效。看来[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]为了拉动经济增长打造了一台强劲的引擎。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1477`

### English

After having curried favor with the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], §H[charter_corp.GetName]§! has now been granted an §HImperial Charter§! by the Senate. This gives them special dispensation to open branch offices on planets all over the Imperium, regardless of whether they have a commercial pact with the owner.\n\nWe can expect the megacorporation to establish Imperial Concession Ports in their branch offices on our worlds soon, where we will have no jurisdiction. It would seem the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has acquired a powerful new engine of economic growth.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1597`

Former Rebel

## former_rebel_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aformer_rebel_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在星海帝国爆发的最近一场内战中选择和叛军站在一边，因此我们的立场至今仍然惹人生疑。我们在帝国参议院的影响力受到了严重的削弱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1501`

### English

We sided with the Rebels during the recent civil war in the Galactic Imperium, and as such we are still regarded with suspicion. Our influence in the Imperial Senate is severely curtailed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1621`

## former_loyalist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aformer_loyalist&lang=en)

### 中文

前帝制派

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1502`

### English

Former Imperial Loyalist

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1622`

## former_loyalist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aformer_loyalist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在星海帝国的覆灭之战中选择和帝制派站在一边，因此我们的立场至今仍然惹人生疑。我们在星海共同体的影响力受到了严重的削弱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1503`

### English

We fought on the side of the Loyalists during the fall of the Galactic Imperium, and as such we are still regarded with suspicion. Our influence in the Galactic Community is severely curtailed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1623`

## former_emperor

### English

## former_emperor_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aformer_emperor_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

作为前星海帝国的末代统治者，我们一夜之间成为了整个星系的弃子。由于我们被不公正地视作暴君，我们在星海共同体的影响力受到了极大的削弱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1505`

### English

As the former ruler of the late Galactic Imperium, we have suddenly become a pariah to much of the galaxy. Unjustly seen as tyrants, our influence in the reborn Galactic Community has been greatly diminished.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1625`

## EMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你正在和这片星海的统治者对话。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1506`

### English

You are speaking to the ruler of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1627`

## EMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对帝国抱有一个大计划。你当拭目以待。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1507`

### English

We have grand designs for the future of the Imperium. You'll see.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1628`

## EMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国理当为这个星系带来一段稳定和繁荣的纪元。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1508`

### English

The Galactic Imperium shall bring an era of peace and stability to the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1629`

## EMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们打造的帝国将会经受住岁月的磨砺。万年之后，此时此刻会被铭记为一个纪元的开端。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1509`

### English

The Imperium we are building shall stand the test of time. Ten thousand years from now, this will be recognized as the era when it all began.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1630`

## EMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

哈？[Root.GetRulerTitle]公务缠身，你必须予以理解。毕竟整个星系都需要妥善治理。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1510`

### English

Yes? The [Root.GetRulerTitle] is very busy, as I'm sure you can understand. There is an entire galaxy to administrate.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1631`

## EMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

自此往后，整个星系都将永远统一在一个旌旗之下。想想我们能实现何等的伟业！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1511`

### English

Henceforth, the galaxy shall forever stand united under one banner. Think of all that can be accomplished!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1632`

## EMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国将会成为席卷整个星系的滚滚铁流。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你是在螳臂当车。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1512`

### English

The Galactic Imperium will one day stretch across the entire galaxy. You are only delaying the inevitable, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1633`

## EMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你是否向[Root.GetRulerTitle]宣誓效忠了？择日不如今日。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1513`

### English

Have you come to swear fealty to the [Root.GetRulerTitle]? It's about time.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1634`

## EMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

很不幸，星系的一隅依然未被纳入星海帝国的版图之内。这个错误最终一定会被修正，一定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1514`

### English

It is unfortunate that there are still backwards regions of the galaxy beyond even the Galactic Imperium's reach. This will be rectified, eventually.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1635`

## EMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你的顺从将会得到回报，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们应当团结一心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1515`

### English

Your obedience will be rewarded, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are all in this together.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1636`

## EMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国的公民永远在[Root.GetRulerTitle]的宫廷内受到欢迎。我们该如何为您效劳？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1516`

### English

Imperial citizens are always welcome in the Court of the [Root.GetRulerTitle]. How can we help you?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1637`

## EMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]虽小，确是星海帝国尤其重要的一份子。请放心，[Root.GetRulerTitle]没有遗漏你。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1517`

### English

The [From.GetName] is a small but vital part of the Galactic Imperium. Rest assured that the [Root.GetRulerTitle] has not forgotten you.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1638`

## EMPEROR_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

只有蠢材才会选择站在统治星海之人的对立面。

### English

Only a fool would get on the bad side of the ruler of the galaxy.

## EMPEROR_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你在[Root.GetRulerTitle]面前屡教不改、傲慢无礼，这样的行为无法容忍。

Your continued insolence in the presence of the [Root.GetRulerTitle] will not be tolerated much longer.

Kneel before the [Root.GetRulerTitle], knave!

## EMPEROR_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_HOSTILE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你竟胆敢忤逆[Root.GetRulerTitle]？何等的傲慢！

### English

You DARE oppose the [Root.GetRulerTitle]? The sheer arrogance!

## EMPEROR_HOSTILE_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_HOSTILE_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

你意识到你在跟谁说话了吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1522`

### English

Do you even realize who you are talking to?

## EMPEROR_HOSTILE_GREETING_06

### 中文

你们那软弱的政府又能说出什么粗鄙之语，又有什么资格代表[Root.GetRulerTitle]的利益？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1523`

### English

What could your pitiful government possibly have to say that would be of interest to the [Root.GetRulerTitle]?

## EMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

### English

The future of this galaxy will be shaped by the combined might of the Galactic Imperium, not the pitiful likes of the [From.GetName].

Only your sheer insignificance has saved you from utter destruction at the hands of the Galactic Imperium... so far.

## EMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

### 中文

凡暗中忤逆[Root.GetRulerTitle]者，当如虫豸一样被灭绝殆尽。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1527`

### English

Those who plot against the [Root.GetRulerTitle] are exterminated like the vermin they are.

## EMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

### 中文

在星海帝国，叛徒的惩戒是十分严苛的。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，牢记这一点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1528`

### English

Traitors are dealt with harshly in the Galactic Imperium. Remember that, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1649`

## EMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

### 中文

暗中煽动行为和不忠对帝国的稳定危害颇大，必须要出重拳。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1529`

### English

Sedition and disloyalty are grave threats to the stability of the Imperium, and will be dealt with accordingly.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1650`

## EMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你赢得了[Root.GetRulerTitle]的偏爱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1530`

### English

You have won the favor of the [Root.GetRulerTitle], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1651`

## EMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

很高兴在帝国的宫廷内遇见[Root.GetRulerTitle]的好友。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1531`

### English

It is good to see friends of the [Root.GetRulerTitle] at the Imperial Court.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1652`

## EMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetRulerTitle]永远愿意抽出时间面见[From.GetName]的代表。有什么能够帮助你的吗，我的朋友？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1532`

### English

The [Root.GetRulerTitle] will always find the time to attend to representatives of the [From.GetName]. What can we help you with, friends?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1653`

## EMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetRulerTitle]永远感激你的真挚和忠诚，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1533`

### English

The [Root.GetRulerTitle] has always appreciated your candor and honesty, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1654`

## EMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将永远会在帝国宫廷受到欢迎。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1534`

### English

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are always welcome at the Imperial Court.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1655`

## EMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_FRIENDLY_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

对于成日埋头于处理管理星海帝国要务的我们来说，你的出现如沐春风，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。贵安。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1535`

### English

You are a welcome distraction from the myriad administrative tasks necessary to rule the Galactic Imperium, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. How are you today?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1656`

## EMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国的加盟国能够从[From.GetName]处学得许多。或许某一天，你也能考虑一下加入我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1536`

### English

The constituents of the Galactic Imperium could learn much from the [From.GetName]. Perhaps you would consider joining us, some day.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1657`

## EMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你乃是星海帝国的挚友。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1537`

### English

You are true friends of the Galactic Imperium, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1658`

## EMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_OUTSIDER_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管很遗憾你方尚且不是帝国的公民，[Root.GetRulerTitle]对伟大的[From.GetName]仍然抱持着钦佩与尊敬。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1538`

### English

Though you are regretfully not Imperial citizens, the [Root.GetRulerTitle] has nothing but admiration and respect for the great [From.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1659`

## EMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]乃是星海帝国的一枚基石。如果没有你方，帝国随即就会分崩离析。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1539`

### English

The [From.GetName] is one of the cornerstones of the Galactic Imperium. Without you, it could very well all fall apart.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1660`

## EMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]乃是帝国公民的典范。你们真是为帝国的其他人树立了一个榜样。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1540`

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are model Imperial citizens. You are truly setting an example for the rest of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1661`

## EMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPEROR_TO_SUBJECT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

在你们的帮助下，星海帝国将会统一整个星系，并将其打造为所有智慧生物的明日之所。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1541`

### English

With your help, the Galactic Imperium will unify the galaxy and make it a better place for all sapients.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1662`

## SUBJECT_TO_EMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASUBJECT_TO_EMPEROR_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1617`

### English

This empire represents a clear and undeniable threat to the future of the entire galaxy. It must be contained and destroyed by the Galactic Imperium before it is too late.

## crisis.4100.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4100.1&lang=en)

### 中文

作为星海监管人，[custodian.GetName]呼吁共同体的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1622`

### English

As Galactic Custodians, the [custodian.GetName] has called upon all Community members to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory: "The galaxy will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1746`

## crisis.4100.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4100.2&lang=en)

### 中文

参议院的代表们呼吁共同体的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击，他们对外公示道：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1623`

### English

Representatives from the Senate have called upon all Community members to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory, declaring that "the galaxy will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1747`

## crisis.4101.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4101.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国参议院通过了一项议案，宣布§H[new_crisis.GetName]§!是一切智慧生命体的威胁、是一场全星系范围的危机。从结果来说，[new_crisis.GetName]在今日同整个星海帝国开战了。\n\n在一场自[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]对外播放的公开演讲中，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]呼吁帝国的全体成员国对舰队进行总动员，并针对[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]的领域发动联合攻击：“直到[new_crisis.GetSpeciesName]威胁被彻底地、一劳永逸地扫除干净，否则星系不会见证真正的和平。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1625`

### English

The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution declaring the §H[new_crisis.GetName]§! a threat to all sapient life and a crisis of galactic proportions. As a consequence, the [new_crisis.GetName] finds itself in a state of war with the entirety of the Imperium.\n\nIn a public announcement transmitted from [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName], the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] called upon all members of the Imperium to mobilize their fleets and launch a concerted attack on [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] territory: "The galaxy and the Imperium will not know peace until the [new_crisis.GetSpeciesName] menace has been dealt with once and for all."

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1749`

## crisis.4105.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4105.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

由于意识到了我们展现出来的威胁，星海共同体的可怜虫们通过了一项议案，对我们的行动进行了谴责，并宣布我们为§Y“全星系范围的危机”§!。星海共同体的成员国展现出了极其罕见的团结，联合了所有力量，并向我们宣战。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1627`

### English

Recognizing the threat we pose, the wretched members of the Galactic Community have passed a resolution condemning our actions and declaring us a §Y"crisis of galactic proportions."§! In a rare moment of unity, the members of the Community have all joined forces and declared war on us.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1751`

## crisis.4105.desc.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4105.desc.c&lang=en)

### 中文

星海共同体内那些腐败的蠢材通过了一项议案，宣布我们是“天灾”，是“全体智慧生命体的威胁”。依据这些荒谬绝伦的倡议，[Root.GetName]和整个星海共同体现在已经处于战争状态。\n\n这场战争将一直持续下去，除非我方或者共同体被彻底地碾为尘末……或者星海共同体废除这项议案。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1634`

### English

The corrupt fools in the Galactic Community have passed a resolution declaring us a "crisis" and a "threat to all sapient life." In light of these absurds allegations, a state of total war now exists between the [Root.GetName] and the entirety of the Galactic Community.\n\nThis war will continue until either us or the Community have been utterly destroyed... or they repeal the resolution.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1758`

## crisis.4111.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4111.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

星海参议院已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有共同体成员国均接到指令原地待命。针对我们的军事行动停止了……暂时如此。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1651`

### English

The Galactic Senate has repealed the resolution declaring us a "galactic crisis" and all Community members have been ordered to stand down. Military actions against us have ceased... for now.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1775`

## crisis.4112.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.4112.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

指定§H[former_crisis.GetName]§!为“星系危机”的议案如今已被帝国参议院废止。作为结果，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]正式下令停止一切针对[former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的帝国军事行动。现在，和平已经降临了星系的这一隅。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1655`

### English

The resolution designating the §H[former_crisis.GetName]§! as a "galactic crisis" has been repealed by the Imperial Senate. Consequently, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has ordered an immediate cessation of all ongoing Imperial military operations targeting the [former_crisis.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1779`

## crisis.4113.desc

星海帝国已经废止了宣布我们为“星系危机”的议案，所有帝国军队均接到指令原地待命。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]下令中止一切针对我们的敌对行动……暂时如此。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1656`

### English

The Galactic Imperium has repealed the resolution declaring us a "crisis" and all Imperial forces have been ordered to stand down. Their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has commanded the cessation of all hostilities against us... for now.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1780`
