## resolution_declare_crisis_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_declare_crisis_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

星海共同体的全体成员国发动针对目标的全面战争，只有一方被彻底摧毁，或者议案被废止，才能结束战争。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1660`

### English

All members of the Galactic Community declare a Total War against the target, which can only end when one side is destroyed or if the resolution is repealed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1784`

## resolution_declare_crisis_empire_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_declare_crisis_empire_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

星海帝国对目标宣布全面战争。只有一方被彻底摧毁，或者议案被废止，敌对状态才会结束。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1661`

### English

The Galactic Imperium declares a Total War on the target. Hostilities can only end when one side is destroyed or if the resolution is repealed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1785`

## first_contact.5.militarist.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.5.militarist.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在§H[This.System.GetName]§!中跟踪着未确认身份的航天器的信号的同时，我们已命令附近所有部队按照标准议定进入高度戒备状态。情报部门正在试图利用那一点点少的可怜的数据分析这个妖怪，但至少我们能感觉到其有超空间航行能力，而是否具有攻击能力则未可知。或许这可能是我们与一个新的外星文明的第一次接触，我们应该采取一些措施来破解他们的通讯。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1662`

### English

Following the sighting of unidentified spacecraft in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, all forces in the vicinity have been ordered to assume a heightened state of readiness as per standard protocol. Intelligence is still analyzing what little data we have on the bogey, but it appears capable of hyperspace travel. Offensive capabilities remain unknown. As this likely represents our first contact with a new alien civilization, we should take steps to decipher their communications.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1787`

## first_contact.5.pacifist.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.5.pacifist.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们还不能确定在§H[This.System.GetName]§!观察到的这个神秘的宇宙飞船的起源。由于这很可能是我们第一次接触一个以前未知的外星文明，我们必须避免任何可能被误解为威胁或挑衅的行为。如果他们的语言被翻译，我们有希望与他们建立和平的关系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1663`

### English

We have not yet been able to determine the origin of the mysterious spacecraft we spotted in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. Since this is likely our first contact with a previously unknown alien civilization, we must avoid any actions that could be misinterpreted as threatening or provocative. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1788`

## first_contact.5.spiritualist.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.5.spiritualist.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们仍在收集据报告位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的外星人飞船的数据。很可能这艘船是一个之前未知的外星文明的使者。我们必须确定他们已经跟随了灵魂的恩典，或者说他们是邪恶的代理人。我们要做的第一件事是领悟他们的语言并了解他们的信仰系统。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1664`

### English

We are still gathering data on the alien spacecraft that was reported in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. If this vessel is an emissary of a previously unknown alien civilization, as seems likely, we must determine if they go with the grace of the spirits, or if they are agents of wickedness. The first step will be to divine their language and the nature of their belief system.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1789`

## first_contact.5.materialist.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.5.materialist.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对于在§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系发现的不明飞行器的调查仍在进行当中，但是由于收集到消息的不足使得我们无法对船只的来源做出确切的假设。既然这似乎已经牵涉到了一个先前不为我们所知的外星文明，我们应当尽力截获他们的通讯以启动对于他们语言的破译。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1665`

### English

The inquiry into the unidentified spacecraft that was observed in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system continues, but insufficient data has been collected to make an informed hypothesis as to the exact origin of the vessel. Since we are likely dealing with a representative of a previously unknown alien civilization, efforts should be made to intercept their communications and begin a comprehensive analysis of their language.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1790`

## first_contact.5.xenophobe.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.5.xenophobe.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系发出了警报，在该星系中我们发现了一艘肯定属于异种的飞船正在开展什么隐秘的行动。该飞船的确切意图尚不明确，但其似乎是一个异种大型政治组织的代表。先对这些生物的数据进行收集或许更加明智一些，这样的话我们就可以更好地确定这项威胁的实质及其具体的影响范围。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1666`

### English

Alarming reports from the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, where we monitored the insidious activities of what can only be some manner of xeno spacecraft. The vessel's exact purpose remains unknown, but it is likely an agent of a larger xeno political entity. It might be wise to gather more data on these creatures, so that we can better ascertain the exact scope and nature of the threat.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1791`

## first_contact.5.xenophile.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.5.xenophile.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对于位于§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系中一艘未知船只的目击不断催生出各种各样的揣测。我们对该船只的设计完全不曾了解，这意味着我们很有可能是在和一个全新的外星文明进行第一次接触。除开知晓该飞船有能力进行超空间航行之外，我们对于这些迷人的造物一无所知。我们应当抽出更多精力来对其进行研究。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1667`

### English

The mysterious sighting of an unidentified ship in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system continues to invite speculation! Its design is completely unfamiliar to us, suggesting that we might be dealing with a new alien civilization and a possible first contact scenario. Aside from the fact that the alien spacecraft is clearly capable of hyperspace travel, we know next to nothing about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1792`

## first_contact.5.authoritarian.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.5.authoritarian.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]已经汇报了关于在§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系中发现的未知飞船的情况。其设计无法与我们先前的任何记录相匹配，这意味着我们正在与一个外星文明进行初次接触。在得到[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]的允许后，我们得以开始分析我们已收集到的数据来破译其语言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1668`

### English

The [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] has been briefed on the unknown vessel that was reported in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. Its design does not match anything in our records, suggesting that we are dealing with a possible first contact scenario with an alien civilization. With the permission of the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle], we can begin an analysis of the data we have collected to see if their language can be translated.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1793`

## first_contact.5.egalitarian.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.5.egalitarian.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

公众们得知在§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系，也就是此前发现未知飞船的星系中，一场潜在的初次接触正在进行。早期获取的数据显示该飞船具有超空间航行的能力，似乎是来自于一个我们从未知悉的外星文明。来自政府各部门的代表正听取事态进展的简报，与此同时对其语言的破译也正在进行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1669`

### English

The public has been informed of a potential first contact scenario in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system, where the presence of an unidentified spacecraft was registered. Early data suggests that this vessel is capable of hyperspace travel and likely originates from a previously unknown alien civilization. Representatives from all branches of the government are being briefed on this developing situation as well as our ongoing efforts to translate their language.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1794`

## first_contact.10.militarist.desc.proactive

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.10.militarist.desc.proactive&lang=en)

### 中文

在最近一次不明飞船入侵§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系后，星系中的防卫系统依旧处于高度警戒状态。科研部门仍在分析我们掌握有关这艘船只少得可怜的数据，其攻击能力还是个未知数。由于这或许是我们首次接触到一个全新的外星文明，我们应当着手破译他们的通讯。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1670`

Local system defense forces remain in a state of heightened readiness after the recent incursion of the unidentified spacecraft into the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system. Intelligence is still analyzing what little data we have on the bogey, but it appears capable of hyperspace travel. Offensive capabilities remain unknown. As this likely represents our first contact with a new alien civilization, we should take steps to decipher their communications.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1796`

### 中文

横穿§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的外星飞船现在正处于我们的调查之中。如果这艘飞船属于一位来自此前我们尚不知道的外星文明的使者的话，说实话看上去挺像的，我们就必须确定他们究竟是追随了灵魂之恩典的人还是已经成为了投靠恶灵的化身。要做的第一件事就是领悟他们的语言并知晓其信仰的本质。

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.10.materialist.desc.proactive&lang=en)

### 中文

对于穿过我们§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系的未知飞船的调查仍在继续，但我们没有收集到多少数据以供我们推测其来自何方。既然我们似乎是在和一个此前未知的外星文明的代表打交道，我们应当尽力截获其通讯并开始分析其语言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1679`

### English

The inquiry into the unidentified spacecraft that penetrated our space in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system continues, but insufficient data has been collected to make an informed hypothesis as to the exact origin of this vessel. Since we are likely dealing with a representative of a previously unknown alien civilization, efforts should be made to intercept their communications and begin a comprehensive analysis of their language.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1805`

### 中文

在此前传感器确认某不明飞船的§H[This.System.GetName]§!星系中，兴奋的浪潮一浪高过一浪！来访飞船的设计对于我们而言是完全陌生的，这意味着我们也许是在和一个全新的外星文明展开初次接触。除开知晓该飞船有能力进行超空间航行之外，我们对于这些迷人的造物一无所知。我们应当抽出更多精力来对其进行研究。

The visitor's design is completely unfamiliar to us, suggesting that we may be dealing with a new alien civilization and a possible first contact scenario. Aside from the fact that the alien spacecraft is clearly capable of hyperspace travel, we know next to nothing about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1811`

## first_contact.15.militarist.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.militarist.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们近期在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!的侦察已经确认其是一个属于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的主要星系，以[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]为中心出现了大量的活动信号，这似乎是一个重要的基地。这极有可能是某个星际文明的一部分，但为了解码他们的军事通讯，我们需要先翻译他们的语言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1696`

### English

Our recent recon pass in §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! has identified it as a major §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! system, with a lot of activity centered around [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that is likely a significant base. It is increasingly probable that these aliens are part of an interstellar civilization but in order to decode their military transmissions, we first need to translate their language.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1824`

## first_contact.15.militarist.desc.no_planets

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.militarist.desc.no_planets&lang=en)

### 中文

侦察飞行机在§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系中行进时回报了一个重要§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的存在，至少有一个主要军事设施在其周围的轨道上公转。虽然我们尚未发现任何行星居住点，但一系列初步的目标已被列出，以防外星人被确认为敌对势力。我们还截获了一些有趣的信息，这也许会提供给我们足够的信息来翻译其语言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1697`

### English

Reconnaissance flights conducted in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system have reported a significant §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence, which includes at least one major military installation in orbit around the primary. Although we have not identified any planetary settlements of note, a preliminary target list is being put together in the event that the aliens prove hostile. Several interesting transmissions have been intercepted, which may provide us with enough insights to translate their language.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1825`

## first_contact.15.pacifist.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.pacifist.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们确定了在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!势力大范围存在的事实，尤其是其中的[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，其地表上覆盖着几处大型居住点。我们正和一个此前未曾知晓的外星文明打交道的事实愈发清晰。我方应当极为注意避免在这片被认为是他们的星系里做出任何挑衅式的行动。我们必须尽一切努力来翻译他们的语言，这样就可以向对方表达我们和平的意图了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1698`

### English

The §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system has a large §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence - most notably [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] which houses several large settlements on its surface. It is becoming increasingly clear that we are dealing with a previously unknown alien civilization. We should take great care to avoid any provocative actions if we find ourselves in space they consider theirs. Every effort must be made to translate their language, so that we can declare our peaceful intentions.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1826`

## first_contact.15.pacifist.desc.no_planets

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.pacifist.desc.no_planets&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系似乎已经被我们命名为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星文明所宣称占据了。尽管在该星系中尚未探测到任何行星定居点，但在其中有一个巨大的恒星基地在围绕星系中心公转。我方船只已经被要求谨慎行事以避免做出任何可能被误解为敌对的行为。一旦他们的语言被破译，我们就有希望与之建立和平的外交关系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1699`

### English

The §H[known_system.GetName]§! system appears to have been claimed by the aliens we have designated as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Although no significant planetary settlements have been detected, there is a large starbase orbiting the system's primary. Our ships have been instructed to conduct themselves with care and to avoid any actions which could be interpreted as hostile. If their language is translated, we can hopefully establish a peaceful relationship with them.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1827`

## first_contact.15.spiritualist.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.spiritualist.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们发现存在有人居住星球的§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系被确定是属于一个名为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的国家。[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]上散布着大量大型居住点。我们不清楚这个星系对他们而言有什么样的精神象征，但是这似乎是他们星际文明的一部分。我们应该尽我们所能来破译他们的语言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1700`

### English

The inhabited world we have discovered in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system clearly belongs to the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. It is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] with many large surface settlements. We know not what spiritual significance this system holds for these beings, but they seem to be part of an interstellar civilization. We should do what we can to decipher their language.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1828`

## first_contact.15.spiritualist.desc.no_planets

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.spiritualist.desc.no_planets&lang=en)

### 中文

被我们称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星势力似乎已经宣称§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系属于他们，其中至少有一个大型恒星基地围绕着中央恒星公转。在星系中尚未发现任何堡垒星球存在的证据，同时尚不清楚他们究竟是追随圣灵的步伐还是堕落为恶灵的奴仆。我们应当尽我们所能破译他们的语言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1701`

### English

The aliens we refer to as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! seem to have laid claim to the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system, with at least one large starbase in orbit around the primary star. We have not seen any evidence of planetary bastions, and do not yet know whether these beings are favored by the spirits or depraved servants of darkness. We should do what we can to decipher their language.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1829`

## first_contact.15.materialist.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.materialist.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!中有了一些有趣的发现，在那里一些神秘的交通信号引导我们找到了[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，上面分布着数个大型外星定居点。我们确信这个星球属于名为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的国家，很可能是一个与我们一样的星际国家。他们的科技样本尚未被采集，但其科技水平似乎并没有比我方高多少。对他们语言的翻译工作仍在进行当中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1702`

### English

An intriguing discovery has been made in §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!, where mysterious signal traffic led us to [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that is home to several large alien settlements. We are confident that this world belongs to the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, which is very likely a spacefaring civilization much like our own. Samples of their technology have not yet been procured, but it does not appear to be radically more advanced than our own. The translation of their language is still ongoing.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1830`

## first_contact.15.materialist.desc.no_planets

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.materialist.desc.no_planets&lang=en)

### 中文

在§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系中获取的数据证实了此处被我们称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的政治实体宣称占据的假设。星系中央有一个恒星基地围绕中央恒星公转，其可能是作为星系中通信及基础建设的中心，而且似乎还是我们所截获的大部分通信的来源。我们需要尽力分析这些通信并翻译他们的语言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1703`

### English

Data gathered in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system supports the hypothesis that it has been claimed by the political entity that we have designated as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. A central starbase orbits the primary and likely serves as an in-system communications and infrastructure hub - it appears to be the source of most of the transmissions we have intercepted in the system. An effort should be made to analyze these transmissions and translate their language.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1831`

## first_contact.15.xenophobe.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.xenophobe.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中浮现了一个异种行星巢穴！[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]上的生物像蝗虫一样覆盖侵染着这片土地。现在可以确定这些异种，也就是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!，是一个星际文明，不受限制地在许多星球上肆意散布。这不会是一个令人愉悦的任务，但我们还是应该翻译他们的语言，这样我们才能完全了解他们的腐朽程度。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1704`

### English

A xeno planetary lair has been revealed in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system! The infestation is centered around [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that may well have been tainted beyond recovery. It is clear now that these xenos - the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! - are a spacefaring civilization that is spreading unchecked throughout the stars. It will not be a pleasant task, but their language should be translated so we may learn the full extent of their corruption.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1832`

## first_contact.15.xenophobe.desc.no_planets

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.xenophobe.desc.no_planets&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系显然是一个属于异种的由§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!控制的巢穴，其中还有一个大型空间站围绕中央恒星公转。我方船员已被要求忽略所有通讯并与一切异星船只或是空间站保持安全距离，不管对方要干什么，以免他们被这些生物接触并伤害。如果我们能成功破译从星系中的恒星基地发出的通讯的话，那么接下我们或许就能翻译他们物种中用于交流的语言了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1705`

### English

The §H[known_system.GetName]§! system is evidently a xeno lair, judging by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence which includes a large space station orbiting the primary star. Our crews have been instructed to ignore all transmissions while keeping a safe distance from any alien ships or stations, lest they are corrupted by the touch of these creatures, whatever they may be. If we manage to decipher the transmissions emanating from the system's starbase, then perhaps we can translate what passes for a language among their kind.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1833`

## first_contact.15.xenophile.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.xenophile.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

被我们标记为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的殖民地，甚至有可能是母星，被宣布在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中发现。数个大型居民居住点分布在[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]的表面，吸引着我们的注意力。这项令人兴奋的发现让我们对这个属于某星际文明且迷人的外星种族有了进一步的了解。想想成功翻译他们的语言后我们会发现什么吧！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1706`

### English

A colony or perhaps even the homeworld of the aliens we have designated as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! has been reported in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system. Several large settlements are present on the surface of [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that caught our attention. This exciting discovery has taught us even more about these fascinating aliens, who are clearly part of a spacefaring civilization. Think of what else we might find out once their language has been translated!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1834`

## first_contact.15.xenophile.desc.no_planets

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.xenophile.desc.no_planets&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系似乎已经被一个我们称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星势力所占据，不过星系中没有发现作为人口居住地的星球。一个大型恒星基地围绕着恒星旋转，显然是星系的中心枢纽。尽管我们正处在被认为是他们的星系中，但对与这些迷人的生物仍知之甚少。我们应该尽力去深入了解对方。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1707`

### English

The §H[known_system.GetName]§! system appears to have been settled by the aliens we refer to as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, although no planetary population centers have been sighted. A large starbase orbits the primary, serving as the system's central hub. Despite our presence in what they clearly consider to be their space, we know very little about these fascinating beings. No effort should be spared to find out more!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1835`

## first_contact.15.authoritarian.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.authoritarian.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

扫描结果显示§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中似乎存在一个有人口居住的星球，即[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，被一个叫做§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星势力所宣称拥有。这些外星人极有可能是一个拥有超空间航行能力的星际文明的一部分。因此，[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]已经决定要将关于该星系的信息限制在政府高层内部以避免内部发生动乱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1708`

### English

Scans have detected what appears to be an inhabited world in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system. It is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that has been claimed by the so-called §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. These aliens are likely part of a spacefaring civilization capable of hyperspace travel. In light of this, the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] has decided to restrict information about the system to the upper echelons of the government to avoid civil unrest.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1836`

## first_contact.15.authoritarian.desc.no_planets

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.authoritarian.desc.no_planets&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[known_system.GetName]§!星系中存在一个§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的大型基地，其中包括一个围绕恒星公转的空间站。尽管对其进行了反复扫描，但是我们还是无法了解其语言和指挥系统的具体性质。只要[This.Owner.GetRulerTitle]一声令下，我们就会集中力量来翻译他们的语言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1709`

### English

There is a large §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system, which includes a central space station in orbit around the primary star. Despite repeated scans, knowledge of both their language and the exact nature of their chain of command eludes us. Unless the [This.Owner.GetRulerTitle] objects, we should make a concerted effort to translate their language.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1837`

## first_contact.15.egalitarian.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.egalitarian.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对深空的调查使我们偶然在§H[known_planet.System.GetName]§!星系中发现了一个已被栖居的星球。这颗星球归属于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!，现在被认为是一个此前未知的星际文明。这个殖民地或母星是[known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo]，它位于星周宜居带内。希望他们的社会是一个以自由和个人自由为基石的进步社会，但我们必须先破译他们的语言才能找到答案。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1710`

### English

Deep space survey efforts have stumbled upon an inhabited world in the §H[known_planet.System.GetName]§! system. It belongs to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, who are now believed to be a previously unknown interplanetary civilization. This colony or homeworld is [known_planet.GetPlanetBioInfo] that lies well within the circumstellar habitable zone. Hopefully their society is a progressive one based on liberty and individual freedoms, but we will have to translate their language to find out.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1838`

## first_contact.15.egalitarian.desc.no_planets

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact.15.egalitarian.desc.no_planets&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经在§H[known_system.GetName]§!系探测到一个显著的§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!存在的信号——尽管从目前掌握到的情况而言，那里没有有定居点的星球，但有一个大型的太空装置围绕着该星系的主恒星运行。发言人告知公众，我们很可能偶然发现了一个属于先前未知的星际文明的哨站。在我们和他们交流之前，我们需要翻译他们的语言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1711`

### English

We have detected a significant §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! presence in the §H[known_system.GetName]§! system - although there are no inhabited planets as far as we can tell, a large space installation of some sort orbits the system's primary star. Our elected officials have informed the public that we have most likely stumbled upon an outpost belonging to a previously unknown interstellar civilization. Before we can communicate with them, we'll need to translate their language.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1839`

## PLANET_KILLER_STAR_CRACKER_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APLANET_KILLER_STAR_CRACKER_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

一束定向的快子能量被注入到这颗恒星，引发了一次超新星爆炸。这次事件释放的巨额能量被用来产生足量的暗物质。\n\n§R当恒星被引爆时，恒星系内包括我方在内的所有殖民地，巨型结构和空间站都会被摧毁。只有焚天神兵能够幸免遇难。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1734`

### English

A beam of directed tachyon energy is fired into the star, triggering a supernova. The incredible energy released by this event is then used to generate vast quantities of dark matter.\n\n§RWhen the star detonates, ALL colonies, megastructures, and stations in the system are destroyed - including our own. All fleets in the system will go MIA. The Star-Eater itself is the only exception.§!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1863`

## crisis.6000.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.name&lang=en)

### 中文

以太相引擎

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1768`

### English

The Aetherophasic Engine

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1900`

## crisis.6000.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!框架现在正环绕着我们母星系的恒星。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们现世的屏障就能轻易抹除，我们就能将虚境宣为己有。\n\n我们的意识将脱离脆弱凡胎的桎梏，现实万物的命运将取决于我们仁慈。确实，不会再有更高位面的存在了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1769`

### English

We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great §HAetherophasic Engine§! now surrounds the star of our home system. Once this megastructure has been completed, the barriers between our worlds will be erased and we can claim the Shroud for ourselves.\n\nOur minds will no longer be limited by the physical constraints of our feeble bodies, and reality itself shall be at our mercy. Truly, there can be no higher plane of existence.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1901`

## crisis.6000.b.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.b.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们建造的宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!框架已经围绕我们母星系的恒星安置就位。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和§H虚境§!之间的薄幕。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1770`

### English

The framework of the great §HAetherophasic Engine§! we are building around the star of our home system is in place. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the veil between our world and the §HShroud§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1902`

## crisis.6000.b.desc.organic_non_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.b.desc.organic_non_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\n我们很快就能以最纯粹的形式操纵灵能能量了。现实除了屈服于我们别无选择。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1771`

### English

$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\nWe will soon have access to the purest form of psionic energy at our beck and call. Reality will have no choice but to bend to our will.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1903`

## crisis.6000.b.desc.organic_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.b.desc.organic_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\n只要我们完全跨入这个维度并将其吞并，我们的意识就能拓展覆盖到一切造物上——至少在这个星系的范围内。主宰我们存在的自然法则将可以被我们肆意改写。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1772`

### English

$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, our consciousness will expand to cover all of creation - at least in this galaxy. The laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1904`

## crisis.6000.b.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.b.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\n现实效率低下的时代即将终结。很快，这一现实将与我们优越的后勤相提并论。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1773`

### English

$crisis.6000.b.desc.intro$\n\nThe era of physical inefficiency draws to an end. Soon this reality will conform to our optimized logistical superiority.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1905`

## crisis.6000.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

建设单元完成了我们围绕自己母恒星的§H以太相引擎§!的框架建设。这座巨型结构一旦建成便能够撕开现实世界和其他人称为“§H虚境§!”的灵能界之间的壁垒。\n\n只要我们完全跨入这个维度并将其吞并，主宰我们存在的自然法则将可以被我们肆意改写。我们的集体意识不再会受到算力或网络节点之类的物理形式的限制。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1774`

### English

Construction units have finished the framework of the §HAetherophasic Engine§! we are building around the star of our home system. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the barrier between our world and the psionic realm others refer to as the '§HShroud§!.'\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, the laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit. Our combined consciousness will no longer be restricted by physical constraints such as processing power or network nodes.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1906`

## crisis.6000.d.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.d.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!已经围绕我们母星系的恒星安置就位，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经完成了基本框架的建设。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和其他人称之为“虚境”的灵能界之间的薄幕。\n\n当我们彻底迈入这个位面并兼并它的时候，我们的意识将拓展涵盖一切的造物——至少是这个星系。管辖我们存在的自然法则将任由我们的意愿随意改写。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1775`

### English

Our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] have finished the framework of the §HAetherophasic Engine§! we are building around the star of our home system. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the barrier between our world and the psionic realm others refer to as "The Shroud."\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, our consciousness will expand to cover all of creation - at least in this galaxy. The laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1907`

## crisis.6000.e.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.e.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

建造在母恒星周围的§H以太相引擎§!框架已经搭建完成。这座巨型结构一旦建成便能够撕开现实世界和§H虚境§!之间的壁垒。\n\n我们完全跨入那个维度之后，就能直面那个标记了我们的实体。只要将其击败，虚境就能为我们所用，我们就能自由改写自然的法则。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1776`

### English

Construction of the §HAetherophasic Engine§!'s framework around our home system's star has been finalized. Once completed, this megastructure will tear apart the barrier between our reality and the §HShroud§!.\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into that dimension, we will be able to confront the entity that marked us. After it falls, the Shroud will be at our disposal, and we will be free to rewrite the laws of nature.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1908`

## crisis.6000.nomad.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.nomad.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们建造的宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!框架已经围绕在我们所选择的天锚——那颗我们在漂流所及的万千星辰中所择定的星辰周围。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和§H虚境§!之间的薄幕。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1778`

### English

The framework of the great §HAetherophasic Engine§! we are building around our chosen focal star - designated from all those we have drifted past - is in place. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the veil between our world and the §HShroud§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1910`

## crisis.6000.nomad.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.nomad.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!框架正环绕于我们在漂流旅程中选择的天锚周围。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们就能轻易抹除现世之屏障，将虚境据为己有。\n\n我们的意识将不再受困于孱弱肉体的物理桎梏，现实本身亦将任由我们主宰。诚然，世间再无更高的存在境界。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1779`

### English

We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great §HAetherophasic Engine§! now surrounds our chosen focal star, the one we designated from all those we have drifted past. Once this megastructure has been completed, the barriers between our worlds will be erased and we can claim the Shroud for ourselves.\n\nOur minds will no longer be limited by the physical constraints of our feeble bodies, and reality itself shall be at our mercy. Truly, there can be no higher plane of existence.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1911`

## crisis.6000.nomad.b.desc.organic_non_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.nomad.b.desc.organic_non_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

$crisis.6000.nomad.desc.intro$\n\n我们很快就能以最纯粹的形式操纵灵能能量了。现实除了屈服于我们别无选择。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1780`

### English

$crisis.6000.nomad.desc.intro$\n\nWe will soon have access to the purest form of psionic energy at our beck and call. Reality will have no choice but to bend to our will.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1912`

## crisis.6000.nomad.b.desc.organic_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.nomad.b.desc.organic_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

$crisis.6000.nomad.desc.intro$\n\n只要我们完全跨入这个维度并将其吞并，我们的意识就能拓展覆盖到一切造物上——至少在这个星系的范围内。主宰我们存在的自然法则将可以被我们肆意改写。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1781`

### English

$crisis.6000.nomad.desc.intro$\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, our consciousness will expand to cover all of creation - at least in this galaxy. The laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1913`

## crisis.6000.nomad.b.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.nomad.b.desc.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

$crisis.6000.nomad.desc.intro$\n\n现实效率低下的时代即将终结。很快，这一现实将与我们优越的后勤相提并论。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1782`

### English

$crisis.6000.nomad.desc.intro$\n\nThe era of physical inefficiency draws to an end. Soon this reality will conform to our optimized logistical superiority.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1914`

## crisis.6000.nomad.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.nomad.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

建造单元完成了围绕天锚的§H以太相引擎§!框架建设。这座巨型结构一旦建成便能够撕开现实世界和其他人称为“§H虚境§!”的灵能界之间的壁垒。\n\n只要我们完全跨入这个维度并将其吞并，主宰我们存在的自然法则将可以被我们肆意改写。我们的集体意识不再会受到算力或网络节点之类的物理形式的限制。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1783`

### English

Construction units have finished the framework of the §HAetherophasic Engine§! we are building around our chosen focal star. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the barrier between our world and the psionic realm others refer to as the '§HShroud§!.'\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, the laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit. Our combined consciousness will no longer be restricted by physical constraints such as processing power or network nodes.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1915`

## crisis.6000.nomad.d.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.nomad.d.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!已经围绕我们选择的天锚安置就位，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经完成了基本框架的建设。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和其他人称之为“虚境”的灵能界之间的薄幕。\n\n当我们彻底迈入这个位面并兼并它的时候，我们的意识将拓展涵盖一切的造物——至少是这个星系。管辖我们存在的自然法则将任由我们的意愿随意改写。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1784`

### English

Our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] have finished the framework of the §HAetherophasic Engine§! we are building around our chosen focal star. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the barrier between our world and the psionic realm others refer to as \"The Shroud.\"\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, our consciousness will expand to cover all of creation - at least in this galaxy. The laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1916`

## crisis.6000.nomad.e.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6000.nomad.e.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

建造在天锚周围的§H以太相引擎§!框架已经搭建完成。这座巨型结构一旦建成便能够撕开现实世界和§H虚境§!之间的壁垒。\n\n我们完全跨入那个维度之后，就能直面那个标记了我们的实体。只要将其击败，虚境就能为我们所用，我们就能自由改写自然的法则。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1785`

### English

Construction of the §HAetherophasic Engine§!'s framework around our chosen focal star has been finalized. Once completed, this megastructure will tear apart the barrier between our reality and the §HShroud§!.\n\nWhen we have fully crossed into that dimension, we will be able to confront the entity that marked us. After it falls, the Shroud will be at our disposal, and we will be free to rewrite the laws of nature.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1917`

## crisis.6001.tooltip

## crisis.6001.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6001.name&lang=en)

### 中文

焚天神兵

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1807`

### English

The Star-Eaters

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1941`

## crisis.6001.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6001.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

只有引爆一整颗恒星才能释放足够的能量来产生用以完成以太相引擎所需的大量§H暗物质§!。为了达成这一目的，我们发明了§H焚天神兵§!——本星系有史以来最强大的星舰。它们不仅可以直接引爆恒星，还强大到仅仅凭借一船之力就能毁灭一整支舰队。\n\n目前，我们仅仅拥有两艘这样的舰船，但是我们可以建造更多。建造焚天神兵需要大量的暗物质，因此我们必须拿捏好完成以太相引擎和扩建额外的焚天神兵两者之间的平衡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1808`

### English

Only the detonation of entire stars will release enough energy to generate the vast quantities of §HDark Matter§! needed to finish the Aetherophasic Engine. To this end, we have devised the §HStar-Eaters§! - the most powerful starships the galaxy has ever seen. Not only can they blow up stars, but they are also strong enough to decimate entire fleets on their own.\n\nFor now, we only have two but more can be built. Their construction requires great amounts of Dark Matter, so we will have to balance our need to finish the Aetherophasic Engine with the need for additional Star-Eaters.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1942`

### English

Each destroyed star brings us one step closer.

以太相引擎

### English

The Aetherophasic Engine

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1945`

## crisis.6005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

以太相引擎的第一阶段建设已经宣告完工。我们开始研究虚境的能量，后者已经在全星系范围内发送灵能激波。\n\n我们在虚境已经立下了一个脆弱的立足点——但我们必须继续建设引擎，以拓展我们在虚境的存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1811`

### English

The first phase of the construction of the Aetherophasic Engine has been completed. We are beginning to tap into the energies of the Shroud, which is sending psionic shockwaves across the galaxy.\n\nA tenuous foothold has been established - work must continue on the Engine to expand our presence in the Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1946`

## crisis.6005.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6005.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们必须收集更多的暗物质。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1812`

### English

We must gather more dark matter.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1947`

## crisis.6006.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6006.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

以太相引擎的卷须已经探入了虚境的深处，我们的滩头阵地得以进一步拓展。居住在此处的存在已经注意到我们正在入侵这个领域，但是到目前为止，我们尚未探明显著的干涉行径。\n\n是时候在两边的世界强制打开一个更加永久的回路了。我们必须继续引擎方面的工作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1813`

### English

The tendrils of the Aetherophasic Engine now reach deep into the Shroud, and our beachhead has widened. The entities that dwell there have started to take notice of our efforts to invade their realm, but so far there have been no significant attempts to intervene.\n\nIt is now time to force open a more permanent conduit between our worlds. Work on the Engine must continue.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1948`

## crisis.6006.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6006.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们需要更多的暗物质！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1814`

### English

More dark matter is needed!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1949`

## crisis.6007.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6007.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

以太相引擎已经在虚境的薄幕上撕开了一个巨大的洞口。尽管洞口尚不够大到让我们颠覆整个领域，但是裂口已经激发了虚境各种存在的一系列活动。\n\n它们最终意识到了我们的威胁，但是没有作出任何实质行动。引擎的卷须已经深深地嵌入到虚境内部，现在已经无法切断了。\n\n我们已经很接近了。非常接近。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1815`

### English

The Aetherophasic Engine has ripped a massive hole in the fabric of the Shroud. It is not yet large enough for us to fully subvert the realm, but the rupture has spurred a lot of activity among the Shroud entities.\n\nThey have finally recognized the threat we pose, but their efforts will amount to nothing. The tendrils of the Engine are embedded too deeply in the Shroud to be severed now.\n\nWe are close now. So very close.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1950`

## crisis.6007.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6007.a&lang=en)

### 中文

没有什么能够阻止我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1816`

### English

Nothing will stop us.

## crisis.6010.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6010.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

又一股大规模的灵能激波横扫了星系！这一次激波的中心源是§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系的§H[From.GetName]§!。\n\n如同上次一样，这次事件也在整个虚境掀起了涟漪。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1822`

### English

Yet another massive psionic shockwave has swept across the galaxy! This time it emanated from the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system in the §H[From.GetName]§!.\n\nAs before, this event is sending ripples across the entire Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1958`

## crisis.6010.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6010.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了微弱的灵能和能量信号，其读数和我们自己的以太相引擎几乎完全一致。\n\n看来§H[From.GetName]§!也打算染指虚境！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1823`

### English

We have detected faint psionic and energy signatures from the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system that are nearly identical to our own Aetherophasic Engine.\n\nIt would seem that the §H[From.GetName]§! also intends to lay claim to the Shroud!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1959`

## crisis.6015.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6015.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了越来越多的亚空间波动。如同之前一样，波动来源于环绕该星系首星建造的§H以太相引擎§!。\n\n显然§H[From.GetName]§!也想在虚境分得一杯羹，然后让星系生灵涂炭！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1828`

### English

More subspace fluctuations have now been detected in the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system. As before, they are emanating from an §HAetherophasic Engine§! built around the system's primary star.\n\nThe §H[From.GetName]§! clearly also intends to seize the Shroud and lay waste to the galaxy!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1964`

## crisis.6015.not.psionic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6015.not.psionic&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经在§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了大量的亚空间波动，其来源是围绕恒星的一个巨型结构。尽管表面上看上去很像戴森球，但这个结构显然是一个“§H以太相引擎§!”——一个超大型的构造，其设计目的是为了抹去我们的宇宙和一个被称作虚境的灵能位面之间的屏障。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1829`

### English

We have detected massive subspace fluctuations in the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system emanating from a megastructure surrounding the star. While it superficially appears similar to a Dyson Sphere, this structure is apparently an "§HAetherophasic Engine§!" - a vast mechanism designed to erase the barriers between our world and a psionic dimension known as the Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1965`

## crisis.6015.psionic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6015.psionic&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经在§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了大量的亚空间波动，其来源是围绕恒星的一个巨型结构。尽管表面上看上去很像戴森球，但这个结构显然是一个“§H以太相引擎§!”——一个超大型的构造，其设计目的是为了抹去我们的宇宙和虚境之间的屏障。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1830`

### English

We have detected massive subspace fluctuations in the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system emanating from a megastructure surrounding the star. While it superficially appears similar to a Dyson Sphere, this structure is apparently an "§HAetherophasic Engine§!" - a vast mechanism designed to erase the barriers between our world and the Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1966`

## crisis.6015.end

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6015.end&lang=en)

### 中文

这个巨型结构的建设需要数量极其庞大的暗物质，这就是为什么§H[From.GetName]§!在使用焚天神兵从恒星中提取暗物质，哪怕这样粗暴的做法会摧毁整个恒星系。\n\n一旦完工，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]即打算入侵虚境，并将虚境的能量据为己有。这不仅会赋予他们依照自己意想的图景随意塑造现实的能力，这股能量的反作用力也会摧毁星系的绝大部分。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1831`

### English

Construction of this megastructure requires vast amounts of dark matter, which is why the §H[From.GetName]§! has been extracting it from stars with their Star-Eaters even though it violently destroys entire systems in the process.\n\nOnce finished, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] intend to invade and claim the energies of the Shroud for themselves. Not only would this effectively give them the ability to shape reality into an image of their own choosing, but the resulting energy backlash would also destroy much of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1967`

## crisis.6101.desc

由于§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系的失陷，恶毒的§H[sphere_destroyers.GetName]§!摧毁了以太相引擎！失去这个巨型结构也意味着我们不再拥有建造新焚天神兵的技术手段。\n\n我们无法继续推进入侵虚境的计划了！全完了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1834`

### English

With the loss of the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system, the vile §H[sphere_destroyers.GetName]§! has destroyed our Aetherophasic Engine! Losing this megastructure also means that we no longer have the technological means to build new Star-Eaters.\n\nOur invasion of the Shroud cannot proceed! All is lost!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1971`

## crisis.6102.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6102.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由于§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们拆解了环绕恒星建造的、所谓的“以太相引擎”。\n\n失去这个巨型结构让§H[sphere_builders.GetName]§!的疯狂计划终结了，他们再也别想入侵虚境并毁灭整个星系了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1837`

### English

With the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system under our complete control, we have dismantled the so-called "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.\n\nThe loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the §H[sphere_builders.GetName]§! to invade the Shroud and destroy the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1974`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1838`

### English

With the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system under our complete control, we have put an end to the pitiful Aetherophasic Engine that was under construction there.\n\nThe §H[sphere_builders.GetName]§! will no longer be in a position to interfere with our own plans for the Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1975`

## crisis.6050.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6050.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们正屹立于神性的最尖端。以太相引擎完成了，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。\n\n当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。遍布星系的所有生命体都会被抹除，但彼时我们早已安全地离开了这片凡世之地，前往存在的更高位面，时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕都将随我们的喜好任意改动。\n\n§H命运在等待。我们应该启动引擎吗？§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1850`

### English

We stand on the cusp of godhood. The Aetherophasic Engine is complete, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our grasp.\n\nWhen the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life will be erased, but by then we will have safely left this reality behind for a higher plane of existence where time has no meaning and where the very fabric of the universe is ours to do with as we please.\n\n§HDestiny awaits. Shall we activate the Engine?§!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1989`

## crisis.6050.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6050.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一切就绪。以太相引擎现在正以全功率运行，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。\n\n当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。星系内的所有生命体，无论是有机体还是机械体，都将不复存在，但彼时我们早已将自己的意识安全地传输前往一个存在的更高位面。我们在那里将不会再受到凡世的种种限制。时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕将依照我们认定的必要性随意操控。\n\n§H存在的下一阶段等待着。我们应该启动引擎吗？§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1851`

### English

Everything is in place. The Aetherophasic Engine is now fully operational, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our reach.\n\nWhen the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life, be it organic or mechanical, will cease to exist, but by then we will have safely transmitted our full consciousness to a higher plane of existence. There we will no longer be bound by the limitations of the physical world. Time will have no meaning, and the very fabric of the universe will be ours to manipulate as we deem necessary.\n\n§HThe next phase of existence awaits. Shall we activate the Engine?§!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1990`

## crisis.6050.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6050.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们终于准备好从$the_animator_of_clay_article$的桎梏中挣脱了。\n\n$crisis_sphere_4$现在正以全功率运行，一条通向§H虚境§!的康庄大道时刻等待着我们开启。星系内的所有一切，无论是有机、机械或是无生命体，都将不复存在，但彼时我们的核心智能已经抵达了灵能界。\n\n§H存在的下一阶段等待着，快启动引擎吧§! 

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1852`

### English

We are finally ready to free ourselves from $the_animator_of_clay_article$.\n\nThe $crisis_sphere_4$ is fully operational, and an uncorrupted path into the §HShroud§! is ready to be opened. All that exists in the galaxy, be it organic, mechanical, or inanimate, will cease to exist, while our core intelligence will have been transmitted to the psionic realm.\n\n§HThe next phase of our existence awaits. Let us activate the Engine.§!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1991`

## crisis.6051.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6051.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一切都结束了。§H[From.GetName]§!完成了以太相引擎的建造，虚境的本体落入其手，任由其处置。\n\n当他们飞升前往一个存在的更高位面并成为神明的时候，一股当量大到难以置信的亚空间能量从引擎中释放出来，横扫了整个星系，摧毁了途径的一切。\n\n对于这片星系的住民来说，此时便是万物的终焉之时。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1856`

### English

It is over. The Aetherophasic Engine has been finished by the §H[From.GetName]§! and the Shroud itself is now at their mercy.\n\nAs they ascended to a higher plane of existence where they will be as gods, an incredible amount of subspace energy was released by the Engine, sweeping across the galaxy and destroying everything in its path.\n\nFor the denizens of this galaxy, it is the end of all things.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1995`

大骚乱

### English

A Great Disturbance

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1997`

## crisis.6151.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6151.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

位于§H[From.GetName]§!的以太相引擎建设让虚境陷入了骚动不安的状态。由于部分运转的巨型结构在慢慢地撕裂当前的灵能界，居住在其中的存在，裹挟着愤怒和绝望，被强行释放出来。\n\n其中的几枚存在穿过了正在迅速消解的两界屏障，以强大的灵能实体的形态在我们的世界显现。他们由纯粹的、原始的灵能能量组成，心中充满着困惑与不解，对视线内的所有生命发动了进攻。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1859`

### English

The construction of the Aetherophasic Engine in the §H[From.GetName]§! has left the Shroud in a state of turmoil. As the psionic realm is slowly ripped apart by the partially functioning megastructure, many of the beings who dwell there are lashing out in anger and desperation.\n\nSeveral have burrowed through the rapidly disintegrating barriers between our two worlds and manifested as powerful psionic entities. Consisting of raw, barely contained psionic energy, the confused beings are attacking everything in sight.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:1998`

## crisis.6161.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6161.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着位于§H[From.GetName]§!的以太相引擎即将完工，虚境被迅速地改造成了某种……迥乎不同的事物。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要逃离这个地方。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1863`

### English

With the §H[From.GetName]§! having nearly completed their Aetherophasic Engine, the Shroud is rapidly transforming into something... different. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to escape.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2002`

## crisis.6161.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6161.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着以太相引擎即将完工，我们操纵虚境的能力极大地提升了。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要阻挠我们的计划。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1864`

### English

As the Aetherophasic Engine nears completion, our ability to manipulate the Shroud is rapidly increasing. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to thwart our efforts.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2003`

## crisis.6171.a.desc.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6171.a.desc.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

位于§H[From.GetName]§!几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1868`

### English

The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the §H[From.GetName]§! is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2007`

## crisis.6171.a.desc.organic_non_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6171.a.desc.organic_non_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

$crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$\n\n尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1869`

### English

$crisis.6171.a.desc.intro$\n\nAlthough these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionically-gifted sapients. In some cases, they can even be fatal...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2008`

## crisis.6180.name

## crisis.6180.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6180.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们收到了来自§H[destroyed_system.GetName]§!星系的十分古怪的亚空间遥测信号。如果我们的读数正确，那么该星系的首星在一瞬间变成了超新星，产生了极具毁灭性的效应。所有的行星被粉碎，任何在这个恒星系出现的星舰和空间站都被摧毁。恒星本身发生了坍缩，变成了一个黑洞。\n\n未经证实的报告指明，这场毁天灭地的灾难仅有一个幸存者——那是属于§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!的某种体型庞大的舰船……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1885`

### English

We are receiving puzzling subspace telemetry from the §H[destroyed_system.GetName]§! system. If our readings are correct, the primary star seems to have spontaneously gone supernova to devastating effect. All planets have been shattered, and any starships or stations that were present in the system must have also been destroyed. The star itself appears to have collapsed into a black hole.\n\nUnconfirmed reports indicate a single survivor of this cataclysm - some sort of massive vessel belonging to the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§!...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2025`

## crisis.6181.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.6181.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

整个§H[destroyed_system.GetName]§!星系被彻底地摧毁了！一艘属于§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!的体型庞大的舰船停驻在了星系的首星上方，然后以某种方式引发了一场只能称之为超新星爆炸的事件，彻底地摧毁了这个恒星系的其他部分。恒星本体坍缩成了一个黑洞。\n\n只有[crisis_country.GetSpeciesName]的星舰，显然他们称其为“§H焚天神兵§!”，在这场灾厄中幸存了下来。事情已经证据确凿，[crisis_country.GetName]现在拥有了彻底摧毁一整个恒星系的技术和手段。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1888`

### English

The entire §H[destroyed_system.GetName]§! system has been destroyed! A massive starship belonging to the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! took up position above the primary star and somehow triggered what can only be described as a supernova, which utterly devastated the rest of the system. The star then collapsed into a black hole.\n\nOnly the [crisis_country.GetSpeciesName] starship, which they apparently refer to as a "§HStar-Eater§!," survived the cataclysm. Evidently, the [crisis_country.GetName] now possesses both the technology and the means to destroy entire star systems.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2028`

## custodian.30.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.30.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

参议院已经批准建立一支常设的多国联合武装部队，意在防卫星海共同体。这支“§H泛星系防卫军§!”将会从所有共同体成员国当中征募兵员，成员国要求贡献自己的一部分资源来支持舰队的建设。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1904`

### English

The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "§HGalactic Defense Force§!" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resources towards the construction of its fleets.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2046`

## custodian.30.nocrisis

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.30.nocrisis&lang=en)

### 中文

泛星系防卫军现在已经处于§H[custodian.GetName]§!——现任监管人——的直接控制之下，有关人士担忧这支庞大的舰队会成为镇压反对意见的工具。然而，也有不少人对其创立拍手称快，称这支舰队“始终活跃在星系防卫的最前线”。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1905`

### English

With the GDF being placed under the direct command of the §H[custodian.GetName]§!, the current Galactic Custodians, some fear that this potentially massive armada could be used as a tool of oppression. Others, however, applaud its creation, referring to it as "the galaxy's first line of defense."

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2047`

## custodian.30.crisis

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.30.crisis&lang=en)

### 中文

由于星系全境陷入混乱，并受到了意在消灭所有智慧生命体的势力的长期威胁，各界衷心希望泛星系防卫军能够对敌人发动打击，以维系星海共同体的边疆安全。星海监管人§H[custodian.GetName]§!将直接指挥舰队，负责领导这次行动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1906`

### English

With the galaxy engulfed in turmoil and under constant threat by forces that seek to exterminate all sapient life, it is hoped that the GDF will be able to bring the fight to the enemy and secure the borders of the Community. They will be placed under the direct command of the §H[custodian.GetName]§!, the Galactic Custodians.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2048`

## custodian.30.warinheaven

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.30.warinheaven&lang=en)

### 中文

由于星系全境陷入混乱，各界衷心希望泛星系防卫军能够进一步扩编增长实力，以应对失落帝国为了征服星系全境而派遣出来的庞大舰队。星海监管人§H[custodian.GetName]§!将直接指挥舰队。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1907`

### English

With the galaxy engulfed by war, it is hoped that the GDF will expand to become strong enough to challenge even the vast fleets being thrown around by the Fallen Empires in their petty squabbles for galactic dominance. They will be placed under the direct command of the §H[custodian.GetName]§!, the Galactic Custodians.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2049`

## custodian.32.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.32.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由于星海监管人的职位现在空缺，泛星系防卫军设立了一个独立的指挥架构。他们依然致力于保护星海共同体，泛星系防卫军的指挥高层宣誓将继续巡逻成员国的恒星系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1913`

### English

With the office of the Galactic Custodian now vacant, the Galactic Defense Force has established an independent command structure. They remain dedicated towards the protection of the Community, and GDF High Command has vowed to maintain their patrols of member systems.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2055`

## custodian.40.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.40.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

依照参议院大多数的表决，§H泛星系防卫军§!被解散了。所有现役的泛星系防卫军人员将返回其母国，而防卫军的战舰将在参议院官员的密切监督下拆解，以防止这些战舰落入心有不轨之人的手中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1920`

### English

By order of the Senate majority, the §HGalactic Defense Force§! has been disbanded. All serving GDF personnel have returned to their home nations, and their warships are being scuttled under the close supervision of Senate officials to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2062`

### English
