Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2063`

## war_in_heaven.7.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awar_in_heaven.7.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自从§H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§!以及他们的宿敌§H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!觉醒以来，这两个巨人总会偶尔爆发小规模冲突，或者相互施展诡谋以争夺影响力，希望借此试探对方的实力。这样的行为导致了一系列逐渐升温的对峙，最终演变成在某个遥远的星系一支[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]舰队和他们的[From.GetSpeciesName]对手爆发了公开的交火。这一冲突现在已经升级成为§H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§!和§H[From.GetName]§!之间的全面战争。\n\n双方都勒令§H星海帝国§!必须立刻解散，其独立的成员国必须在战争中选择一边。今天的稍早时刻，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院发表了讲话，态度明确地拒绝了这一无理要求。星系目前陷入了一场规模庞大的三方战争，其规模之大，前所未有，闻所未闻。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1922`

### English

Ever since the awakening of the §H[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]§! and their ancient §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§! rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly terse confrontations, finally erupting in an open battle between a [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] fleet and their [From.GetSpeciesName] counterparts in a remote system. The conflict has now escalated into full-blown war between the §H[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! and the §H[From.GetName]§!.\n\nBoth sides are demanding the immediate dissolution of the §HGalactic Imperium§! and for its individual members to pick a side in the war. Earlier today, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] addressed the Imperial Senate and categorically rejected their demands. The galaxy now finds itself in a massive three-way war on a scale never before witnessed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2065`

## war_in_heaven.7.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awar_in_heaven.7.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这将成为帝国的荣光时刻！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1923`

### English

This shall be the Imperium's finest moment!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2066`

## war_in_heaven.7.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awar_in_heaven.7.b&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国会获胜吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1924`

### English

Will the Imperium prevail?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2067`

## war_in_heaven.7.tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awar_in_heaven.7.tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y[FirstSleeper.GetName]§!和§Y[From.GetName]§!向§Y星海帝国§!§R宣战§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1925`

### English

The §Y[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! and the §Y[From.GetName]§! §Rdeclare war§! on the §YGalactic Imperium§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2068`

## war_in_heaven.13.desc3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awar_in_heaven.13.desc3&lang=en)

### 中文

在先祖帝国之间的兵燹之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。我们已经收到了其他帝国的通讯，他们决定建立一个§H不结盟组织§!，明确挑起反抗战争双方的大旗。\n\n由于我们是现任星海监管人，他们决定邀请我们成为这支联盟势力的盟主。我们一旦接受，就几乎确定会同时跟两大觉醒的帝国开战，但至少我们还有盟友支援，不用独自面对两大先祖帝国的威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1926`

### English

Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of fighting the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a §HLeague of Non-Aligned Powers§! with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war.\n\nAs we are the current Galactic Custodians, we have been asked to lead this league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2069`

## requires_no_war_in_heaven

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arequires_no_war_in_heaven&lang=en)

### 中文

§R天堂之战已经让局势相当混乱了，当前情况不能宣告建立星海帝国。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1927`

### English

§RConditions are too chaotic to proclaim the Galactic Imperium during the War in Heaven.§!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2070`

## operation.6000.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6000.name&lang=en)

### 中文

渗透开始

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1928`

### English

Infiltration Begins

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2072`

## operation.6000.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6000.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的情报分析师将潜在目标的表单合并到一块之后，我们的独行特工开始渗透[target.GetName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1929`

### English

As our intelligence analysts put together lists of potential targets, individual operatives are beginning to infiltrate the [target.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2073`

## operation.6000.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6000.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工现在正在渗透[target.GetName]，但是他们必须额外小心，以免引起帝国安全总局的注意。我们的情报分析师已经把潜在目标的表单合并到了一起。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1930`

### English

Our operatives are now infiltrating the [target.GetName], but great care must be taken to avoid drawing the attention of the Imperial Security Directorate. A list of potential targets is being put together by our intelligence analysts.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2074`

## operation.6005.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6005.name&lang=en)

### 中文

建立掩护

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1931`

### English

Establishing Cover

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2075`

## operation.6005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

成功在[target.GetName]内部建立起联络之后，我们的特工现在开始建立起自己的掩护身份。目标列表现在已经缩小到十几个显要的候选人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1932`

### English

After successfully linking up inside the [target.GetName], our operatives are now working to establish their cover identities. The target list has been narrowed down to a dozen promising candidates.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2076`

## operation.6010.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6010.name&lang=en)

### 中文

目标决定

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1933`

### English

Target Determined

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2077`

## operation.6010.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6010.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经定位了一名位于[target.Capital.GetName]上的帝国显贵，其名为§H[operation_target.GetName]§!，其职权虽然不大但是对于维系帝国对星系的控制力至关重要。如果我们能抹除这名目标，那么我们就能充分地昭告，对[target.GetRulerTitle]阿谀奉承之辈永远别想安全无虞。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1934`

### English

We have identified an Imperial dignitary on [target.Capital.GetName] by the name of §H[operation_target.GetName]§! that serves a small but critical role in maintaining the Imperium's yoke on the galaxy. Eliminating this target would amply demonstrate that no lackey of the [target.GetRulerTitle] is safe.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2078`

## operation.6010.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6010.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经定位了一个位于[target.Capital.GetName]之上的自律[target.GetIndividualName]，其功能是维系[target.GetRulerTitle]和其帝国属民之间的联系。若能对这个[target.GetIndividualName]进行抹杀，那将是我们对抗星海帝国取得的微小却又至关重要的胜利。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1935`

### English

We have identified an autonomous [target.GetIndividualName] on [target.Capital.GetName] that functions as a liaison between the [target.GetRulerTitle] and its Imperial subjects. The elimination of this [target.GetIndividualName] would be a small but important victory in the fight against the Galactic Imperium's tyranny.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2079`

## operation.6010.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6010.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一个位于[target.Capital.GetName]之上的自律无人机，其功能是维系[target.GetRulerTitle]和其帝国属民之间的连结能力。使这个无人机永久地离线能够打击帝国的内部联络——至少是在替代无人机被编程之前。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1936`

### English

There is an autonomous drone on [target.Capital.GetName] that operates in a liaison capacity between the [target.GetRulerTitle] and its Imperial subjects. Permanently offlining this drone would hamper the Imperium's internal communication - at least until a replacement is programmed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2080`

## operation.6010.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6010.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[operation_target.GetName]§!，一名帝国安全总局的[agent_origin.GetSpeciesName]特工，对于[operation_target.GetHerHis]的工作有着不同寻常的热枕。[operation_target.GetSheHeCap]亲自负责逮捕了数百名“异见分子”——其中的几名为我们工作。时机已经到了，这名帝安局特工的光辉前程应该戛然而止，并一劳永逸地彻底终止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1937`

### English

§H[operation_target.GetName]§!, a [agent_origin.GetSpeciesName] agent of the Imperial Security Directorate, is particularly apt at [operation_target.GetHerHis] job. [operation_target.GetSheHeCap] [operation_target.GetIsAre] personally responsible for the arrest of hundreds of "dissidents" - several of whom were working for us. It is time for this ISD agent's illustrious career to come to a premature and very permanent end.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2081`

## operation.6010.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6010.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国海军是[target.GetRulerTitle]的利剑，长悬于帝国成员国的头顶之上，随时准备着以迅雷不及掩耳之势将任何叛乱的苗头抹杀。\n\n我们已经定位了一名特别的舰队情报军官，一名[agent_origin.GetSpeciesName]人，名字为§H[operation_target.GetName]§!，此人负责多项反骚乱行动。这名军官的暴毙将对对方造成重创。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1938`

### English

The Imperial Armada is the sword of the [target.GetRulerTitle], constantly hovering over the heads of Imperium's members and ready to come thundering down at the slightest sign of rebellion.\n\nWe have identified a particular Armada intelligence officer, a [agent_origin.GetSpeciesName] by the name of §H[operation_target.GetName]§!, who oversees many of their anti-insurgency operations. The demise of this officer is long overdue.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2082`

## operation.6010.6.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6010.6.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[target.Capital.GetName]有一座[target.GetRulerTitle]的特别纪念碑，其安全出现了可乘之机。如果我们可以摧毁这座纪念碑，那我们就能向全星系昭示，反叛运动甚至有能力直击帝国的心脏地段。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1939`

### English

Security is lax around a particular monument of the [target.GetRulerTitle] on [target.Capital.GetName]. Destroying this monument will prove to the galaxy that the rebel movement can strike even at the very heart of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2083`

## operation.6010.7.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6010.7.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工想方设法获得了进入下水道网络的权限，能够通往帝国安全总局在当地的办事处。只要炸药管够，我们就能够把这栋帝安局的建筑还有里面的工作人员一口气送上天。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1940`

### English

Our operatives have managed to secure access to a network of underground sewage tunnels running underneath a local branch office of the Imperial Security Directorate. With enough explosives, it should be possible to bring down the entire ISD building along with any agents inside it.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2084`

## operation.6010.8.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6010.8.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国海军在整个星海帝国各处的行星上设立了征募中心。在各个征兵处，征兵官正忙着将来自各个成员国的愣头青登记成大兵。这些傻大个马上就会被灌满谎言，还要发誓效忠[target.GetRulerTitle]。\n\n摧毁一个这样的征募中心将向各界发送一个强烈的讯息，那就是背叛自己的种族，同帝国沆瀣一气，其代价将会十分沉重。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1941`

### English

The Imperial Armada has established recruitment centers on planets across the Galactic Imperium. At these sites, their recruiters fill the Armada's ranks with the gullible youth of the Imperium's numerous member states. These naive fools are then fed lies and conditioned to obey the [target.GetRulerTitle].\n\nDestroying one of these centers would send a powerful message that betraying your own kind and siding with the Imperium carries a steep price.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2085`

## operation.6010.9.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6010.9.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经定位了一个位于[target.Capital.GetName]之上的亚空间传输器，帝国使用这个东西向整个星海帝国展开宣传攻势。如果我们的特工能够从源头改变传输信号，哪怕仅仅只是一会，我们就能够通过官方的帝国亚空间输送载体传送我们自己的宣传材料。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1942`

### English

We have located a Subspace Transmitter on [target.Capital.GetName] that is used to transmit Imperial propaganda across the Galactic Imperium. If our operatives can divert these transmissions at the source, even for a brief moment, we could transmit our own material on the official Imperial subspace carrier wave.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2086`

## operation.6015.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.name&lang=en)

### 中文

行动成功

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1943`

### English

Operation Succeeds

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2087`

## operation.6015.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在等待数日之后，狙击小队的一名特工逮到了一个完美时机，在极远的距离一击穿透§H[operation_target.GetName]§!办公室的窗户将[operation_target.GetHerHis]射杀。在任何人注意到目标死亡之前，小队就拆卸了步枪，并有条不紊地转移到了撤离点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1944`

### English

After waiting several days for the right moment, one of our sniper teams eliminated §H[operation_target.GetName]§! at extreme range by firing through the window of [operation_target.GetHerHis] office. The team then dismantled their rifle and were well on their way to the extraction point before anyone had even noticed the target was down.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2088`

## operation.6015.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在旁观者看来，§H[operation_target.GetName]§!最近在一场悲惨的车祸中丢掉了[operation_target.GetHerHis]的性命，载具在[operation_target.GetSheHe]开动的那一刻爆炸了。帝国官方怀疑是有人在暗中搞事，但是那些精心摆放的炸药压根就没剩下来，没法通过这件事追查到我们的特工身上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1945`

### English

To those bystanders who witnessed the event, §H[operation_target.GetName]§! recently lost [operation_target.GetHerHis] life in a tragic hover car accident when the vehicle [operation_target.GetSheHe] [operation_target.GetWasWere] traveling in seemed to spontaneously explode. Imperial authorities likely suspect foul-play, but there is not enough of the carefully placed explosive remaining to link our operatives to the deed.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2089`

## operation.6015.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过研究目标私人住所的监控系统，我们发现前门的控制面板存在一个安全纰漏。我们的特工把这个面板捣鼓了一下，确保下一次被人使用时会触发一个强烈的放电。§H[operation_target.GetName]§!回家之后操作了这个面板，结果，[operation_target.GetSheHe]就被突然释放的电流裂解成了地上的一滩灰，只留下[operation_target.GetHerHis]的护卫在原地目瞪口呆。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1946`

### English

Surveillance of the target's personal residence revealed a security flaw in the control panel used to open the front door. Our operatives rigged the panel to trigger a powerful energy discharge when used. When §H[operation_target.GetName]§! returned home shortly afterwards and used the panel, [operation_target.GetSheHe] disintegrated into a pile of ash right in front of [operation_target.GetHerHis] astonished escort detail.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2090`

## operation.6015.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个战术刺杀小队试图伏击目标和其护卫，在经过一段简单的、一边倒的交火之后，所有目标[from.target.GetIndividualNamePlural]都被击杀。我方的所有特工都安然无恙地脱离，现在处于潜伏状态，等到局势放松之后再进行安全地撤离。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1947`

### English

A tactical kill team managed to ambush the target and its escort, successfully eliminating all of the [from.target.GetIndividualNamePlural] after a brief and one-sided firefight. All of our operatives escaped unharmed and are now laying low until conditions allow for their safe extraction.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2091`

## operation.6015.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

目标随身的猎寻者无人机让正面进攻变得不可能，因此我们需要寻找替代方案。我方特工重编了一个自动化轨道货船，让其看上去是在驶离繁忙的[target_country.Capital.GetName]轨道空间前往帝国别处执行任务，实际上却是同目标无人机的私人穿梭机相撞。引发的爆炸轰天震地，目标无人机的记忆核心一个渣滓都没留下给人打捞。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1948`

### English

The target's hunter-killer drone escort made a frontal attack impossible, so an alternate approach was required. Our operatives reprogrammed an automated orbital freighter to collide with the target drone's personal shuttle as it was leaving the busy orbital space of [target_country.Capital.GetName] for a mission elsewhere in the Imperium. The resulting explosion was powerful enough that no trace of the drone's memory core remained to be salvaged.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2092`

## operation.6015.6.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.6.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工以外科手术式的精准排放好小型炸药网，引爆后严重破坏了位于[target_country.Capital.GetName]上[target_country.GetRulerTitle]纪念碑的支撑结构。宏伟的雕像缓缓倒下，砸在地上化为了数不尽的碎片。当地政府赶到现场的时候，我们的特工已经在前往撤离点的路上了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1949`

### English

With surgical precision, the network of small explosives planted by our operatives severed the supports of the monument to the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] on [target_country.Capital.GetName]. The massive statue then slowly toppled from its platform and shattered into a million pieces as it hit the ground. By the time the local authorities arrived on the scene, our operatives were already on their way to their exfiltration points.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2093`

## operation.6015.7.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.7.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当深埋地下的炸药引爆的时候，整栋帝安局建筑都化成了灰，徒留地上一个新近形成的大坑，以及到处倒坍的砾石。等到帝安局增援部队赶到并在这片区域建立一个警戒区的时候，我们的特工早已逃之夭夭，去往了其他的星球。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1950`

### English

When the underground explosives were detonated, the entire ISD office building disappeared into the newly formed crater and collapsed on itself. By the time ISD reinforcements arrived to establish a cordon around the area, our operatives had been safely relocated offworld.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2094`

## operation.6015.8.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.8.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由我们的特工精心掩埋在募兵中心四周的炸药网被引爆，所有的炸药在同一时刻触发了引信。伤亡惨重。尽管帝国海军总能在帝国疆域的其他地方拉到新兵蛋子，但至少这次行动被视作一次标志性的打击，足够让[target_country.GetRulerTitle]心有余悸一段时间了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1951`

### English

A network of carefully concealed explosives planted by our operatives around the Recruitment Center detonated as one when their trigger was fired. Casualties were heavy, and although the Imperial Armada is certain to find the recruits it needs elsewhere in the Imperium, this is at least a symbolic blow that will be felt by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] for some time.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2095`

## operation.6015.9.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.9.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在接入亚空间传输器之后，我们的特工上传了一段[target_country.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院前作公开演讲的鬼畜版本。在这个版本中，演讲包含了粗俗和下流的词句，让各位参议员大感迷惑，演讲最终以帝皇陛下[target_country.ruler.GetHerHis]本人的自爆结束。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1952`

### English

After interfacing with the Subspace Transmitter, our operatives uploaded a doctored version of the latest public address made by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] before the Imperial Senate. In this version, the speech contains vulgar and obscene language directed at the bewildered Senators, eventually concluding with [target_country.ruler.GetHerHis] Imperial Majesty's spontaneous combustion.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2096`

## operation.6015.10.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.10.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在接入亚空间传输器之后，我们的特工上传了一段[target_country.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院前作公开演讲的恶搞版本。在这个版本中，演讲包含了粗俗和下流的词句，让各位参议员大感迷惑，演讲最终以[target.GetGovernmentName]揭发了一个缇扬奇企图颠覆帝国的阴谋结束。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1953`

### English

After interfacing with the Subspace Transmitter, our operatives uploaded a doctored version of the latest public address made by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] before the Imperial Senate. In this version, the speech contains vulgar and obscene language directed at the bewildered Senators and it concludes with the [target.GetGovernmentName] announcing its discovery of a massive Tiyanki plot to overthrow the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2097`

## operation.6015.11.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6015.11.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在接入亚空间传输器之后，我们的特工上传了一段[target_country.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院前作公开演讲的鬼畜版本。在这个版本中，演讲包含了粗俗和下流的词句，让各位参议员大感迷惑，演讲最终以机械智能宣布自己将立即把意识传输到参议院大楼的某个饮料分发器上结束。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1954`

### English

After interfacing with the Subspace Transmitter, our operatives uploaded a doctored version of the latest public address made by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] before the Imperial Senate. In this version, the speech contains vulgar and obscene language directed at the bewildered Senators and it concludes with the Machine Intelligence announcing the imminent transfer of its entire consciousness into a random beverage dispenser somewhere in the Senate complex.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2098`

## operation.6016.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.name&lang=en)

### 中文

恐怖分子削弱帝国权威！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1955`

### English

Terrorists Undermine Imperial Authority!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2099`

## operation.6016.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

身份不明的特工近期刺杀了一名位于[Root.Capital.GetName]上的帝国要员！行凶者躲避了追捕，但我们深信这场刺杀是一系列企图动摇星海帝国并削弱我们权威的精心策划行动的一部分。某一位星海帝国的成员国可能就是幕后主谋！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1956`

### English

Unidentified agents recently assassinated an Imperial dignitary on [Root.Capital.GetName]! The perpetrators eluded capture, but we believe the assassination is part of a concerted effort to destabilize the Galactic Imperium and undermine our authority. One of the Imperium's member states is likely behind this!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2100`

## operation.6016.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一名身居高位的帝国安全总局官员最近被不明势力的特工刺杀了！帝安局的分析师认为这一行动是星海帝国的某位成员国尝试削弱[Root.GetRulerTitle]的权威，很可能一场公开的叛乱已经在私下里开始谋划了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1957`

### English

A high-ranking officer of the Imperial Security Directorate was recently assassinated by agents working for an unknown power! Analysts at the ISD think it likely that this is an attempt by one of the Imperium's member states to undermine the authority of the [Root.GetRulerTitle], and perhaps set the stage for an open revolt against our rule!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2101`

## operation.6016.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一名身居高位的帝国海军情报官员最近被不明势力的特工刺杀了！这一可耻的恐怖主义行径很有可能出自某位不忠的星海帝国成员国，而它很有可能还在盘算着什么大计划削弱我们的权威。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1958`

### English

A high-ranking intelligence officer in the Imperial Armada was recently assassinated by agents acting on behalf of an unknown power! This shameful act of terrorism is likely part of a larger effort to undermine our authority by a disloyal member state of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2102`

## operation.6016.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

不满分子最近消灭了一个我们的自律眼线！尽管单个[root.GetIndividualName]的毁灭尚不足以引起[Root.GetRulerTitle]的关注，但是该[root.GetIndividualName]肩负着帝国派往多个臣属国的大使的功能。这一行动目的在于动摇星海帝国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1959`

### English

Dissidents recently eliminated one of our autonomous liaisons! The termination of a single [root.GetIndividualName] is typically not worth the attention of the [Root.GetRulerTitle], but this [root.GetIndividualName] served an important function as an Imperial ambassador to many of our subject nations. This action has sought to destabilize the Galactic Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2103`

## operation.6016.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

身份不明的骚乱活动近期切断了我们同一名无人机的连结。这个特殊的单元负责协调[Root.GetRulerTitle]同帝国各成员国之间的活动。一个替代单元正在被写入程序，但是当下这个无人机的损失会削弱我们对整个帝国的掌控。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1960`

### English

Unidentified insurgents recently terminated one of our drone liaisons. This particular unit was responsible for coordinating activities between the [Root.GetRulerTitle] and the Imperial member states. A replacement is being programmed, but for now the loss of this drone will weaken our control of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2104`

## operation.6016.6.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.6.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个[Root.GetRulerTitle]的大型纪念碑最近在[Root.Capital.GetName]被炸上了天！这次胆大妄为的攻击行径直击星海帝国的心脏，是在试图削弱我们的统治。尽管目前还没逮捕嫌疑人，爆炸装置的精妙结构暗实某个政府的特工在背后主导这一切——很可能就是来自帝国成员国中的一个。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1961`

### English

A large monument to the [Root.GetRulerTitle] was recently blown up on [Root.Capital.GetName]! This brazen attack at the very heart of the Galactic Imperium can only be an attempt to undermine our rule. Although no suspects have been arrested, the sophistication of the explosive device suggests a government agency was behind this - likely from one of the Imperium's member states.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2105`

## operation.6016.7.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.7.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最近某个外国特工发动了一次炸弹袭击，帝国安全总局的一处办事处被炸毁。这样的恐怖主义行为对帝安局在整个帝国内的公共形象造成了损害——如果他们连自己都不能保护，怎么能指望他们的特工在帝国全境贯彻[Root.GetRulerTitle]的统治呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1962`

### English

A branch office of the Imperial Security Directorate was destroyed in a recent bombing perpetrated by foreign agents. This act of terrorism has done serious harm to the public image of the ISD throughout the Imperium - if they can't even protect themselves, how are their agents supposed to enforce the rule of the [Root.GetRulerTitle]?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2106`

## operation.6016.8.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.8.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国海军的一处募兵中心最近成为了恐怖主义炸弹袭击的目标，尸横遍野。尽管这场袭击对帝国海军的征兵计划几乎没有造成任何影响，但这场炸弹袭击可以视作一个信号，告诫帝国各成员国的帝国公民不要向[Root.GetRulerTitle]宣誓效忠。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1963`

### English

One of the Imperial Armada's recruitment centers was the recent target of a terrorist bombing that left many dead. Although the actual impact on the Armada's recruitment efforts should be negligible, the bombing seems to have been intended as a message to discourage Imperial citizens in the Imperium's member states from offering their services to the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2107`

## operation.6016.9.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.9.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

代表意见势力活动的特工最近骇入了[Root.Capital.GetName]上的一处大型亚空间传输器。在我们恢复控制之前，这些谋反分子利用帝国的官方亚空间载波向整个星系传输了一段“叛军宣言”！这一令人尴尬的恐怖主义行径在整个帝国所有成员的众目睽睽之下削弱了我们的权威。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1964`

### English

Agents acting on behalf of a dissident power recently hacked into a large Subspace Transmitter on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Before our control could be restored, the subversives transmitted a "proclamation of rebellion" across the galaxy using an official Imperial subspace carrier wave! This embarrassing act of terrorism has undermined our authority in the view of the members of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2108`

## operation.6016.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6016.a&lang=en)

### 中文

渣滓一般的二五仔。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1965`

### English

Rebel scum.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2109`

## operation.6100.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6100.name&lang=en)

### 中文

接头

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1966`

### English

Linking Up

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2111`

## operation.6100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我方特工正在试图同其他叛乱团体和政府的线人接头，分享我们推翻帝国政权的共同目标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1967`

### English

Our operatives are attempting to link up with other rebel groups and governments that share our goal of overthrowing the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2112`

## operation.6105.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6105.name&lang=en)

### 中文

解除威胁

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1968`

### English

Threat Neutralization

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2113`

## operation.6105.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6105.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有关我们即将掀起叛乱的消息必须严密保守，不能让帝国及其麾下特工知道，越久越好。帝国的反谍报线人在整个星系范围内都成了被针对的目标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1969`

### English

Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Imperial counterespionage assets are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2114`

## operation.6105.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6105.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有关我们即将掀起叛乱的消息必须严密保守，不能让帝国及其麾下特工知道，越久越好。帝国安全总局的反谍报线人在整个星系范围内都成了被主动针对的目标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1970`

### English

Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Assets of the Imperial Security Directorate are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2115`

## operation.6110.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6110.name&lang=en)

### 中文

线人就位

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1971`

### English

Positioning Assets

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2116`

## operation.6110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝制派和[target.GetRulerTitle]的其他宵小之辈在每一个帝国成员国境内都占据着数量上的优势。线人在叛乱爆发的时候必须就位，一旦行动，就要控制住、亦或是直接抹除掉这些帝制派分子。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1972`

### English

Imperial loyalists and other lackeys of the [target.GetRulerTitle] are present in great numbers in each of the Imperium's member states. Assets need to be in place to immediately seize or otherwise neutralize these loyalists the moment the rebellion breaks out.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2117`

## operation.6115.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6115.name&lang=en)

### 中文

最终准备

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1973`

### English

Final Preparations

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2118`

## operation.6115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一切都已就绪。特工已经出现在了帝国的每一个成员国境内，同当地对起义行动表示同情的势力相互协作。剩下的就看，当帷幕拉开的时候，他们是否能够说动政府支持我们的事业。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1974`

### English

Everything is nearly in place. Operatives are present in every member state of the Imperium, coordinating with whatever local elements are sympathetic to the rebel movement. It remains to be seen whether they can sway their governments to support our cause when push comes to shove.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2119`

## operation.6120.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6120.name&lang=en)

### 中文

万事俱备

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1975`

### English

Ready to Commence

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2120`

## operation.6120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

是时候了。暗藏在整个星系各处的特工都在等待密码指令，并根据指令行动。星海帝国的落幕之战就从此时奏响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1976`

### English

It is time. Concealed operatives all over the galaxy are waiting for the code phrase that will send them into action. This is the beginning of the end of the Galactic Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2121`

尝试联络

Making Contact

## operation.6200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工正在甄别并试图同§H[target.GetName]§!国内的犯罪团伙接触，他们很容易被我们的援助影响到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1978`

### English

Our operatives are working to identify and make contact with criminal elements inside the §H[target.GetName]§! that would be susceptible to our assistance.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2124`

## operation.6201.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6201.name&lang=en)

### 中文

建立联络

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1979`

### English

Contact Established

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2125`

## operation.6201.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6201.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们同一群虽然聒噪，但是很能打的[target.GetSpeciesName]海盗接上了头。这群暴力的亡命徒很乐意接受我们的武备和舰船，不过一旦放跑之后我们就没办法控制他们了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1980`

### English

We have made contact with a rowdy but promising group of [target.GetSpeciesName] pirates. These violent cutthroats are more than willing to accept our weapons and ships, although we'll have no way of controlling them once they're set loose.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2126`

## operation.6201.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6201.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们同一小群脱离了§H[target.GetName]§!中央智能的故障单位接上了头。这些高度不稳定且难以预测的[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很乐意接受我们的武备和舰船，不过一旦放跑之后我们就没办法控制他们了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1981`

### English

We have made contact with a small group of malfunctioning units who have isolated themselves from the central intelligence of the §H[target.GetName]§!. These highly unstable and unpredictable [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more than willing to accept our weapons and ships, although we'll have no way of controlling them once they're set loose.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2127`

## operation.6201.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6201.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们同一小群拥有罕见基因突变、可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连结而不会陷入休眠的子个体接上了头。这些暴力且难以预测的突变[target.GetGestaltEntityName]很乐意接受我们的武备和舰船，不过一旦放跑之后我们就没办法控制他们了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1982`

### English

We have established contact with a small group of mutated outcasts who have somehow managed to sever their link to the [target.GetGestaltEntityName] without perishing. These violent and unpredictable mutants are more than willing to accept our weapons and ships, although we'll have no way of controlling them once they're set loose.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2128`

## operation.6202.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6202.name&lang=en)

### 中文

货运送达

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1983`

### English

Shipments Made

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2129`

## operation.6202.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6202.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

货运武器和抹除标记的舰船由我方特工负责走私进入§H[target.GetName]§!，并确保不会追溯到我们身上。我们已经准备好将它们交付给海盗了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1984`

### English

Weapon shipments and unmarked ships that can't be traced back to us have been smuggled into the §H[target.GetName]§! by our operatives. We are ready to hand them over to the privateers.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2130`

## operation.6205.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6205.name&lang=en)

### 中文

活跃的私掠行径

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1985`

### English

Privateers Active

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2131`

## operation.6205.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6205.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

被我们武装起来的海盗已经在§H[privateer_system.GetName]§!恒星系站稳了脚跟，他们立马就开始针对当地的货运船只。我们的分析师期望§H[target_country.GetName]§!很快就会分兵处理这股国境内的不稳定威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1986`

### English

The privateers we armed have established themselves in the §H[privateer_system.GetName]§! system, and they have immediately begun targeting local shipping. Our analysts expect that the §H[target_country.GetName]§! will soon have to divert forces to deal with this destabilizing threat within their borders.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2132`

## operation.6205.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6205.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们资助舰船和武器后，一群流亡的[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在§H[privateer_system.GetName]§!恒星系站稳了脚跟。他们立马将恒星系内一切不属于他们的东西视为威胁，我们的分析师期望§H[target_country.GetName]§!很快就会分兵处理这股不稳定的势力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1987`

### English

The rogue [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that we supplied with ships and weapons have established themselves in the §H[privateer_system.GetName]§! system. They are designating everything in the system that does not belong to them as a threat, and our analysts expect that the §H[target_country.GetName]§! will soon have to divert forces to deal with this destabilizing element.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2133`

## operation.6205.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6205.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们资助舰船和武器后，一群[target_country.GetSpeciesName]的变异体在§H[privateer_system.GetName]§!恒星系站稳了脚跟。他们从此地出发，开始捕食一切触及范围内的资源和养分，我们的分析师期望§H[target_country.GetName]§!的中央蜂巢意识很快就会分兵处理这股国境内的不稳定威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1988`

### English

The [target_country.GetSpeciesName] mutants that we supplied with ships and weapons have established themselves in the §H[privateer_system.GetName]§! system. From there they are preying on everything within their reach in their struggle for resources and nutrients. Our analysts expect that the central hive consciousness of the §H[target_country.GetName]§! will soon have to divert forces to deal with this destabilizing threat within its borders.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2134`

## operation.6206.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6206.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[privateer_system.GetName]内的敌军！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1989`

### English

Hostiles in [privateer_system.GetName]!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2135`

## operation.6206.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6206.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一支高度武装的私掠船队出现在了§H[privateer_system.GetName]§!恒星系！和其他海盗没什么区别，这群乌合之众立马开始针对我们通过这个恒星系的货运船只。我们的情报部门高度怀疑他们收到了境外势力资助的舰船和武器。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1990`

### English

A group of heavily armed privateers has established a presence in the §H[privateer_system.GetName]§! system! Little more than pirates, these lowlifes have immediately begun targeting our shipping passing through the system. Intelligence strongly suspects that they were supplied with ships and weapons by an outside power.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2136`

## operation.6206.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6206.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一小群故障的单位已经脱离了[Root.GetName]的主体智能，并躲进了我们境内的§H[privateer_system.GetName]§!恒星系！这些单位已经无可救药，并开始利用境外势力资助的舰船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，掠夺零件和资源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1991`

### English

A small group of malfunctioning units have separated themselves from the main intelligence of the [Root.GetName], and sought refuge in the §H[privateer_system.GetName]§! system inside our space. These units have become irredeemably corrupted, and they now use crude spacecraft supplied to them by a foreign power to raid everything in the system for spare parts and resources.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2137`

## operation.6206.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6206.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一小群拥有一种罕见基因突变的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]，可使它们切断与[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的影响范围太远，这些离群的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内§H[privateer_system.GetName]§!恒星系。它们使用的武器和舰船一定是来自于某个境外势力！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1992`

### English

A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the [target.GetGestaltEntityName] without being rendered comatose. As these rogue [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] would perish if they ventured too far from the [target.GetGestaltEntityName]'s influence, they have established themselves in the §H[privateer_system.GetName]§! system within our borders. The weapons and ships they are using must have been supplied by a foreign power!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2138`

## operation.6206.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6206.a&lang=en)

### 中文

谁会对此事负责？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1993`

### English

Who is responsible for this?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2139`

## operation.6207.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6207.name&lang=en)

### 中文

海盗已经被雇佣

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1994`

### English

Privateers Already Engaged

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2140`

## operation.6207.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6207.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

那些我们用于针对§H[target_country.GetName]§!的私掠船队已经切断了同我们的联系，并且通过其他地方运输的资源继续破坏。\n\n$operation.6207.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1995`

### English

The privateers we were working with in the §H[target_country.GetName]§! have cut ties with us, and have begun wreaking havoc using materiel from some other source.\n\n$operation.6207.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2141`

## operation.6207.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6207.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们提供武器和船只的[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经切断了同我们的联系，开始接触其他人以获取资源并继续掠夺。\n\n$operation.6207.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1996`

### English

The rogue [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that we supplied with ships and weapons have cut ties with us, and have begun wreaking havoc using materiel from some other source.\n\n$operation.6207.desc.outro$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2142`

## operation.6207.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6207.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

我们没法探明是什么势力在背后暗流涌动，但是看来他们和我们的目的一致。我方自己的行动在这里唐突地中止了，但我们依然收到报告，[target_country.GetAdj]的航道如同我们计划的那样被打乱了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1997`

### English

We cannot identify whoever is behind this effort, but it seems they shared our goals. Our own operation ends abruptly here, but reports indicate the [target_country.GetAdj] shipping lanes are being disrupted all the same.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2143`

## operation.6250.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6250.name&lang=en)

### 中文

追踪领袖

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1998`

### English

Pursuing Leads

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2144`

## operation.6250.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6250.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

位于§H[target.GetName]§!的特工正积极工作，辨识并追踪那些潜在能提供支持的领袖。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:1999`

### English

Operatives within the §H[target.GetName]§! are actively working to identify and pursue leads that could potentially be used to gain favors.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2145`

## operation.6251.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6251.name&lang=en)

### 中文

突破点

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2000`

### English

Promising Angle

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2146`

## operation.6251.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6251.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经发现了一个突破点，可以用来进行勒索。特工们正在进行进一步调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2001`

### English

A promising angle has been discovered which could be used for extortion purposes. Operatives are investigating.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2147`

## operation.6252.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6252.name&lang=en)

### 中文

获得敏感信息

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2002`

### English

Sensitive Information Acquired

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2148`

## operation.6252.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6252.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

穿过敌国的层层监控之后，我方特工成果获取了一些涉及到一名[target.GetSpeciesName]政府高官的敏感信息。如果这些信息被公之于众，那么将会造成极大的尴尬。\n\n我们已经准备好谨慎地接触这名官员，试探是否可以在某些替代方案上达成一致。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2003`

### English

Through their surveillance efforts, our operatives have managed to obtain sensitive information regarding a certain high-ranking [target.GetSpeciesName] government official. If it were to be released to the general public, this information would prove very embarrassing.\n\nWe are ready to discreetly approach this official to see if some sort of alternate arrangement can be worked out.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2149`

## operation.6252.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6252.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我方的某位特工成功获取到了一份老旧的数据文件，里面包含了[target.GetSpeciesName]对数个外国势力发动入侵的计划。尽管这些计划早已过时，且完全是纸上谈兵，但是其中有几个地方详细地演示了如何逮捕或处决目标帝国的政治领导阶层。\n\n放出这些计划毫无疑问会让§H[target.GetName]§!处于尴尬的境地，我们的特工已经准备好接触对方政府以期达成某项协议。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2004`

### English

One of our operatives has secured an old data file containing [target.GetSpeciesName] invasion plans for several foreign powers. Although the plans are obsolete and seem to have been entirely hypothetical, there are several detailed scenarios that involve the arrest or execution of the target empire's political leadership.\n\nAs the release of these plans could potentially be embarrassing for the §H[target.GetName]§!, our operatives are ready to approach their government to work out a deal.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2150`

## operation.6252.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6252.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经了解到，[target.GetSpeciesName]的某位政府高官从国防预算中拿了一小部分资金，放进了自己的腰包。如果这则信息被公之于§H[target.GetName]§!的大众，那么这个是个大号丑闻。\n\n我们的特工已经准备好谨慎地接触这名高官，看是否我们可以在某些地方取得共识……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2005`

### English

We have learned that a certain high-level [target.GetSpeciesName] government official has been secretly siphoning off a small amount of credits from their defense budget for personal use. If this information were to become public knowledge in the §H[target.GetName]§!, it would cause quite a scandal.\n\nOur operatives are ready to discreetly approach this official to see if some sort of arrangement can be worked out...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2151`

## operation.6252.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6252.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的监视网发现，[target.GetSpeciesName]的一名资深外交官正与一名[scandal_species.GetSpeciesName]使馆雇员陷入桃色关系。尽管有关这桩关系的具体细节我们尚未了解，但是这一事件存在本身，一旦被捅破，将会对这位外交官和该国政府造成极大的困扰。\n\n我们的特工已经准备就绪，开始谨慎地接触这名外交官，以期达成某项共识。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2006`

### English

Our surveillance efforts have revealed that a high-ranking [target.GetSpeciesName] diplomat is engaged in an affair with a [scandal_species.GetSpeciesName] embassy staff member. The exact details of this relationship elude us, but its mere existence would be highly embarrassing to both the diplomat and their government if it were shared with the general public.\n\nWe have operatives standing ready to approach the diplomat in a discreet attempt to reach an agreement.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2152`

## operation.6252.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6252.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工获得了铁证，[target.GetSpeciesName]政府的一名杰出成员，同国境内的某个海盗组织保持着十分活跃的联系。在我们看来，这名官员一直在向这些海盗透露国内贸易路线的机密信息。\n\n如果我们能对这些证据保持沉默，想必这名政府官员会对我们感恩戴德……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2007`

### English

Our operatives have obtained evidence that a distinguished member of the [target.GetSpeciesName] government has ties to a pirate organization active within their borders. From what we can tell, this official has been feeding these pirates sensitive information about internal trade routes.\n\nIf we were to keep this evidence to ourselves, the government official would likely be very grateful...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2153`

## operation.6252.6.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6252.6.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[target.GetName]§!对于周边帝国的政治领袖保留了极其翔实的文件，这些文件中的很多内容都包含了机械智能对自己的有灵同僚作出的详细而带有诋毁意味的评价。我们的特工成功获取了这些文件中一部分的拷贝。\n\n如果这些文件被分享到[target.GetName]的邻国，它们的名声肯定会大幅受损。我们的特工已经准备好提出一项协议了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2008`

### English

The §H[target.GetName]§! maintains extensive files on political leaders in neighboring empires, many of which contain detailed and disparaging remarks regarding their mental faculties from the machine intelligence's point of view. Our operatives have managed to secure copies of some of these files.\n\nThe reputation of the [target.GetName] would likely suffer if these files were shared with their neighbors, but our operatives are ready to propose a different arrangement.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2154`

## operation.6252.7.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6252.7.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个§H[target.GetName]§!的自律无人机领袖表现出了一些古怪的行为，并竭尽全力不让其同僚发现。无论导致的原因是编程缺陷还是基础人格的渐进突变，如果机械智能主体注意到这件事，它将面临重新格式化。\n\n我们可以同这个无人机见面，并承诺保留我们的观察数据，以期换取它的协助……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2009`

### English

An autonomous drone leader within the §H[target.GetName]§! is exhibiting peculiar behavior that it seems to go to great lengths to hide from its peers. Whether this is caused by faulty programming or the gradual maturation of a rudimentary personality, the drone likely faces reformatting if the central machine intelligence were to take notice.\n\nWe could approach the drone and promise to keep our observations to ourselves in exchange for favors...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2155`

## operation.6252.8.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6252.8.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[target.GetName]§!对于周边帝国的政治领袖保留了极其翔实的文件，这些文件中的很多内容都包含了[target.GetGovernmentName]对自己的有灵同僚作出的详细而带有诋毁意味的评价。我们的特工成功获取了这些文件中一部分的拷贝。\n\n如果这些文件被分享到[target.GetName]的邻国，它们的名声肯定会大幅受损。我们的特工已经准备好提出一项协议了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2010`

### English

The §H[target.GetName]§! maintains extensive files on political leaders in neighboring empires, many of which contain detailed and disparaging remarks regarding their mental faculties from the [target.GetGovernmentName]'s point of view. Our operatives have managed to secure copies of some of these files.\n\nThe reputation of the [target.GetName] would likely suffer if these files were shared with their neighbors, but our operatives are ready to propose a different arrangement.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2156`

## operation.6252.9.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6252.9.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工观测到，某个[target.GetName]的自律领袖表现出来的一些行为，暗实它已经脱离了[target.GetGovernmentName]的意志开始追逐自己个体的目标，比如秘密地获取少量的物质财产。如果[target.GetGestaltEntityName]注意到这件事，这个[target.GetIndividualName]的下场会十分严重。\n\n我们可以同这个[target.GetIndividualName]见面，并承诺保留我们的观察数据，以期换取它的协助……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2011`

### English

As observed by our operatives, one of the autonomous leaders in the [target.GetName] has been exhibiting behavior that suggests it sometimes strays from the will of the [target.GetGovernmentName] in pursuit of personal goals, such as the secret acquisition of small material possessions. If the [target.GetGestaltEntityName] learned of this, the repercussions for this [target.GetIndividualName] would be severe.\n\nWe could approach the [target.GetIndividualName] and promise to keep our observations to ourselves in exchange for a few favors...

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2157`

## emperor.350.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.350.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H星海帝国§!的暴君妄想将自身的意志强加于我们身上！在他们[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的赐福之下，帝国参议院已经通过了一项议案，指定我们作为一场§H大远征§!的目标。\n\n除非我们可以抵挡住接踵而至的入侵，否则我们就要被迫并入星海帝国，屈服于[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的淫威之下。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2034`

### English

The tyrants of the §HGalactic Imperium§! seek to impose their will on us! With the blessing of their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], the Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that makes us the target of an §HImperial Crusade§!.\n\nUnless we can somehow defeat this impending invasion, we will be forced into the Imperium and subordinated to the whims of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2184`

### English

## emperor.351.name

### 中文

发动大远征

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2036`

### English

Imperial Crusade Commences

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2186`

## emperor.351.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.351.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着针对§H[crusade_target.GetName]§!的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。对于旁观者而言，看上去任何外部势力想要抗衡帝国的联合舰队力量都无异于痴人说梦，但是接下来的战斗才会决定最终的结果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2037`

### English

Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the §H[crusade_target.GetName]§! begins. To many observers, it seems unfathomable that any outside power could hope to prevail against the combined might of the Imperium, but the coming battles will determine the outcome.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2187`

## emperor.351.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.351.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着针对§H[crusade_target.GetName]§!的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。这个失落帝国已经延续了近千年，然而[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]却满怀自信，认为帝国的联合舰队力量能够让它在年轻种族面前俯首称臣。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2038`

### English

Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the §H[crusade_target.GetName]§! begins. This Fallen Empire has endured for millennia, yet the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] seems confident that the combined might of the Imperium will be enough to finally bring it under the heel of the younger races.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2188`

## resolution_emperor_pax_galactica_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_emperor_pax_galactica_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了帝国的永续繁盛，我们绝不能陷入无意义的内斗之中。不允许成员国之间发动战争。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2045`

### English

For the Imperium to prosper, it must not tear itself apart in pointless infighting. Wars between members cannot be permitted.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2195`

## resolution_emperor_pax_galactica_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_emperor_pax_galactica_tooltip&lang=en)

星海帝国的成员国，包括其统治者，不能相互开战，除非是适格试炼。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2046`

### English

Members of the Imperium, including its ruler, may not declare war on each other aside from Trials of Advancement.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2196`

## resolution_emperor_repeal_pax_galactica_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_emperor_repeal_pax_galactica_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国倘若屈服于和平主义，就将滑向毁灭的深渊。来自内部的冲突终将使我们变得更加强大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2048`

### English

The Imperium is doomed if it surrenders to pacifism. Internal conflict will ultimately make us stronger.

星海帝国治下的和平

## emperor.360.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.360.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国参议院已经通过了一项决议，旨在禁止星海帝国成员国之间的战争。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]勒令立刻停止所有违反这项新法律的战争。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2051`

### English

The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that forbids wars between the member states of the Galactic Imperium. All wars in violation of this new law have been brought to an immediate conclusion by order of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2201`

## emperor.360.a

### English

Peace it is then.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2202`

## operation.6300.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6300.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过伪装成帝国低级职员或是官僚，我们的特工现已成功渗透进§H[target.GetName]§!内部。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2055`

### English

Concealed as low-level Imperial officials and bureaucrats, our operatives are now infiltrating the §H[target.GetName]§!.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2205`

## operation.6305.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6305.name&lang=en)

### 中文

公开批评家

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2056`

### English

Outspoken Critic

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2206`

## operation.6305.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6305.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的特工盯上了一位长期热衷于公开批判帝国的特使，并着手处理这危险的星星之火。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2057`

### English

Our operatives are shadowing an envoy that has long been an outspoken critic of the Imperium. Work is underway to deal with this dangerous firebrand.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2207`

## operation.6310.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6310.name&lang=en)

### 中文

行动准备就绪

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2058`

### English

Operation Ready

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2208`

## operation.6310.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6310.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这位目标小心行事，尽可能表现得不像是在发表公开反动言论，但他的所作所为的确在损害我们的权威。单纯的外交声明挽回不了他们，不过我们有的是办法来对付这些叛乱分子。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2059`

### English

The target is careful not to make statements that could be interpreted as fomenting open sedition against the Imperium, but their activities are still undermining our authority. Diplomatic eloquence will not save them in the end - there are other ways of dealing with rebels.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2209`

## operation.6310.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6310.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经收集到了足够多的证据来清除目标了。由于其反动颠覆的行径，他们不受外交豁免权的保护，并将作为帝国的敌人在帝国法院的审判席上受审。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2060`

### English

We have gathered enough evidence to move against the target. Their subversive activities negate whatever diplomatic immunity they may have enjoyed - they will be tried and sentenced in an Imperial court as an Enemy of the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2210`

## operation.6310.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6310.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[target.GetName]§!通过外交手段削弱帝国权威的主导者是一个自律[target.GetIndividualName]。我方特工确信抹除这位个体将消解反动者在帝国参议院中对于[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2061`

### English

The efforts of the §H[target.GetName]§! to diplomatically undermine the Imperium largely hinge on the activities of a single autonomous [target.GetIndividualName]. Our operatives are confident that the elimination of this envoy will negate whatever seditionist influence the [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have in the Imperial Senate.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2211`

## operation.6315.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6315.name&lang=en)

### 中文

特使伏诛

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2062`

### English

Envoy Neutralized

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2212`

## operation.6315.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6315.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国代理人成功在§H[target_country.GetName]§!将该反动特使逮捕。目标被迅速引渡到[Root.GetName]，在快速审判后被判处死刑。这就是抹黑[Root.GetRulerTitle]的代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2063`

### English

Imperial agents were successful in their attempt to apprehend the subversive envoy in the §H[target_country.GetName]§!. The target was quickly transported to the [Root.GetName], and after a swift trial they were sentenced to death. Such is the price for besmirching the good name of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2213`

## operation.6315.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6315.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一支隶属于帝国安全总局的战术小队成功在§H[target_country.GetName]§!拘押了这位反动特使。特勤干员迅速将其引渡至[Root.GetName]，其在快速审判后被判处死刑。这就是抹黑[Root.GetRulerTitle]的代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2064`

### English

A tactical team from the Imperial Security Directorate was successful in its attempt to apprehend the subversive envoy in the §H[target_country.GetName]§!. The ISD agents quickly transported the target to the [Root.GetName], and after a swift trial they were sentenced to death. Such is the price for besmirching the good name of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2214`

## operation.6315.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6315.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一场精心准备的伏击后，埋伏好的帝国特工们将目标乱枪击毙，并在当地执法机关反应过来前迅速逃离。尽管§H[target_country.GetName]§!怀疑我们一手策划了枪击，但他们并没能找到证据。这将给那些蔑视[Root.GetRulerTitle]的人敲响警钟。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2065`

### English

In a carefully planned ambush, concealed Imperial operatives gunned down the target and then made their escape before the local authorities could respond. Although the §H[target_country.GetName]§! likely suspects our involvement, there is no proof for them to find. This will send a powerful message to those who would defy the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2215`

## operation.6315.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6315.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一场精心准备的伏击后，一支来自帝国安全总局的战术小队将目标乱枪击毙，并在当地执法机关反应过来前迅速逃离。尽管§H[target_country.GetName]§!怀疑我们一手策划了枪击，但他们并没能找到证据。这将给那些蔑视[Root.GetRulerTitle]的人敲响警钟。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2066`

### English

In a carefully planned ambush, a tactical assault team from the Imperial Security Directorate gunned down the target and then made their escape before the local authorities could respond. Although the §H[target_country.GetName]§! likely suspects our involvement, there is no proof for them to find. This will send a powerful message to those who would defy the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2216`

## operation.6315.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6315.a&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国的正义得以伸张。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2067`

### English

Imperial justice has been served.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2217`

## operation.6316.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6316.name&lang=en)

### 中文

失去特使

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2068`

### English

Envoy Lost

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2218`

## operation.6316.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6316.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国特工不久前以“意图推翻帝国”的罪名逮捕了一位我们的特使！特使在我们有关部门介入前就被快速引渡至§H[From.GetName]§!，并在一场简短的审判后被判处死刑。\n\n$operation.6316.ending$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2069`

### English

Imperial agents recently arrested one of our envoys for "crimes against the Imperium"! The envoy was swiftly transported to the §H[From.GetName]§! before our own authorities could react, and after a brief show trial a death sentence was meted out.\n\n$operation.6316.ending$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2219`

## operation.6316.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6316.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一支来自帝国安全总局的强袭小队刚刚以“意图推翻帝国”的罪名拘捕了一位我们的特使！特勤干员们在我们有关部门介入前迅速将其引渡至§H[From.GetName]§!。经过一场简短的审判后，特使被宣判死刑。\n\n$operation.6316.ending$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2070`

### English

A strike team from the Imperial Security Directorate recently arrested one of our envoys for "crimes against the Imperium"! The ISD agents swiftly transported the envoy to the §H[From.GetName]§! before our own authorities could react, and after a brief show trial a death sentence was meted out.\n\n$operation.6316.ending$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2220`

## operation.6316.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6316.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的一位特使刚刚在[Root.Capital.GetName]被暗杀！凶手逃脱了追捕，但鉴于该特使是[From.GetRulerTitle]及帝国的公开批评家，谁最有策划这次暗杀的动机已经再清楚不过了。\n\n$operation.6316.ending$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2071`

### English

One of our envoys was recently assassinated on [Root.Capital.GetName]! The perpetrators eluded capture, but our envoy was an outspoken critic of the [From.GetRulerTitle] and the Imperium - it is very clear who had the most to gain by their demise.\n\n$operation.6316.ending$

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2221`

## operation.6316.ending

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6316.ending&lang=en)

### 中文

这位特使的死亡使得我们之前在参议院内的游说成果功亏一篑。我们需要一些时间来重建必要的外交平台以继续左右帝国的公共舆论。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2072`

### English

The death of this envoy has severely compromised our lobbying efforts in the Imperial Senate. It will be some time before we regain the necessary diplomatic platforms needed to sway public opinion in the Imperium.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2222`

## operation.6316.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6316.a&lang=en)

### 中文

难道“外交豁免权”只是一张厕纸吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2073`

### English

Does "diplomatic immunity" mean nothing now?

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2223`

## undermining_efforts_stalled

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aundermining_efforts_stalled&lang=en)

特使牺牲

### English

Envoys Thwarted

## undermining_efforts_stalled_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aundermining_efforts_stalled_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国特工通过消灭一位我方的重要特使从而对我们的外交使团造成了严重打击。我们当前在帝国参议院中的地位不足以左右帝国的公共舆论。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2075`

Imperial agents have struck a blow against our diplomatic corps with the elimination of an important envoy. We now lack the necessary standing within the Imperial Senate to sway public opinion against the Imperium.

## operation.6320.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6320.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们扰乱§H[target_country.GetName]§!以削弱帝国权威的行动受挫！[target_country.GetAdj]的反情报部门一定已经监视了我们的一举一动——我们所有的密探全部失联。\n\n[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经向帝国参议院提交了我们行动的证据。我们的外交官正竭力否认每一点，但显然，这尴尬的解释一定会在[Root.GetRulerTitle]面前显得苍白无力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2081`

### English

Our operation to disrupt the ability of the §H[target_country.GetName]§! to undermine the Imperium has been compromised! [target_country.GetAdj] counterintelligence must have been monitoring our every move - all of our operatives have gone silent.\n\nThe [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have presented evidence of our operation to the Imperial Senate. Our diplomats are denying everything, of course, but this embarrassing incident will reflect poorly on the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2231`
