## operation.6321.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aoperation.6321.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.Capital.GetName]的几名帝国间谍试图让我们的特使们闭嘴——更具体来说，阻止他们削弱帝国的权威——这一企图最近被我方瓦解了。\n\n我们将这一帝国参议院策划的肮脏阴谋公之于众。当然，[From.GetRulerTitle]的那群马屁精对一切予以否认，但这一事件毫无疑问将抹黑帝国试图对外宣传的那副团结鸿图。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2084`

### English

Several Imperial agents were recently neutralized on [Root.Capital.GetName] while engaged in an apparent attempt to silence our Envoys - more specifically, to prevent them from undermining the authority of the Imperium.\n\nWe have exposed the details of this dastardly plot to the Imperial Senate. The lackeys of the [From.GetRulerTitle] are denying everything, of course, but this incident will distort the image of unity the Imperium is trying to project.

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2234`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2235`

## custodian.51.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.51.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海共同体的可敬成员们……智慧生物同胞们。\n\n星海正格外黑暗。我们面临的生死危机史无前例。为了挺过接下来的猛攻，我们必须如同明天我们将不复存在一般战斗，因为，我们也许真的没有明天了。\n\n在你们选举我们成为星海监管人时，我们宣誓要捍卫星系，拼尽一切来兑现承诺……但这并非一场我们独自能够赢得的战役。我们吁请全体成员国搁置异见，与我们并肩反击§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!的进攻！只要齐心协力，我们定能展现星海的完整威力，抵御共同的敌人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2086`

### English

Honorable members of the Galactic Community... fellow sapients.\n\nThis is an exceedingly dark time for our galaxy. The existential threat we face is without precedent. To survive the coming onslaught, we must fight like there is no tomorrow, for in truth, that may be the case.\n\nWhen you elected us as your Galactic Custodians, we swore an oath to defend our galaxy and we will do everything in our power to uphold that promise... but this is not a battle we can win alone. We call on all members to put aside their differences and join us as we strike back at the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§!! Together we will show them the full might of our galaxy as it stands united against a common foe!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2236`

## emperor.91.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.91.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝国的公民们。我们一起经历了很多的苦难，但是今日帝国面临空前绝后的严峻挑战。我们的星系正被§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!威胁——他们与其他敌人不一样——若放任不管，他们将终结我们所知的一切智慧生命。\n\n但是我们的前途并非绝望！星海帝国正在全力进行总动员以驱赶这些入侵者。我们的国家不再在腐朽的共同体下各自为政，而是在全星系有史以来最伟大的帝国的旗帜下团结一致。\n\n在[From.GetRulerTitle]领导下团结起来吧！大战即将来临，但比以往更加强大的星海帝国终会摆脱困境！荣耀就在前方！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2089`

### English

Citizens of the Imperium. We have endured much together, but today the Imperium is faced with what may be its greatest challenge yet. Our galaxy is beset by the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! - a foe unlike any other - which if left unchecked will be the end of sapient life as we know it.\n\nBut do not despair! The Galactic Imperium is mobilizing its full might to drive back these invaders. Our nations are no longer fractured under a corrupt Community, but united under the banner of the greatest empire the galaxy has ever seen.\n\nRally to your [From.GetRulerTitle]! A great war is upon us, but the Imperium shall emerge from it stronger than ever! Glory awaits!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2239`

## custodian.53.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acustodian.53.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海已四面楚歌！§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!盯上了我们的军队，但我们毫无能长时间抵抗的希望！\n\n作为星海的监管人，保护全体共同体成员不受外界的威胁是您应尽的职责，请尽您所能地提供援助吧！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2090`

### English

The galaxy is under attack! Our forces have engaged the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§!, but we have little hope of holding them off for long!\n\nAs the Galactic Custodians, it is your duty to defend all Community members from external threats! Please, send all the help you can!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2240`

## emperor.93.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aemperor.93.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

帝皇陛下，星海正处于前所未有的险境之中。我们的军队正遭受§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!的严重威胁。一旦我方被击败，他们一定会吞并帝国的剩余部分！\n\n作为[Root.GetRulerTitle]，保护帝国全体国民是你应尽的职责。我们恳请您即刻出兵！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/nemesis_content_l_simp_chinese.yml:2092`

### English

Your Imperial Majesty, the galaxy is in grave danger! Our forces are beset by the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! and once they are done with us, they will surely overrun the rest of the Imperium!\n\nAs the [Root.GetRulerTitle], it is your duty to defend all Imperial citizens. We implore you to send help immediately!

Source: `localisation/english/nemesis_content_l_english.yml:2242`
